sanskrit: saṃnidhattāṃ ca me vāṇī bhuvanatrayavanditā sevitaṃ bhūtasaṃghaiśca bhūtapreta piśācakaiḥ tadā brahmā samutthāya praṇamya stutavānprabhum prasīda jagatāṃ nātha ! prasīdānandadāvyaya ! sahasrapādayuktāya śarvāya paramātmane huṃkārāya namastubhyaṃ vaṣaṭkārāya te namaḥ sarvajñāya śaraṇyāya sadyo jātāya te namaḥ anantāsana saṃyuktamanantāyānta kāriṇe yogapīṭhāntarasthāya yogine yogadāyine parāya parameśāya nirguṇāya namo'stute adhvānadāyine tubhyaṃ ṣaḍadhvāya namo'stute pratyāhārasthitānāṃ tu pratiṣṭhānāṃ sthitāya ca dhāraṇābhyāsa yuktānāṃ purastātsaṃsthitāya ca dhyeyāya dhyeyagamyāya dhyeyādhyeyāya te namaḥ samādhinā'dhigamyāya samādhānāya te namaḥ sahasrākṣaradevāya ayutākṣararūpiṇe * * * * * * * ṇi tvayāntamapurā prabho pitāmaha mahāprājña ! mayā nigaditā śṛṇu aṣṭāṣṭau ca sthānāni śṛṇu ca tapodhana naimiśe devadevaśa gayāyāṃ prapitāmaha puṣkare jaraje gandhiṃ viśvantavimaleśvaram ujjayinyāṃ mahākālyaṃ mahākāṭe madotkaṭam rudrakoṭyāṃ mahāyogī mahāliṃgaṃ sthaleśvare svarṇākṣe sahasrākṣaṃ vṛṣe ca vṛṣabhadhvajam sūryaṃ kanakhale caiva bhadrakarṇe sadāśivam

ūrdhvaretāstri siddhāyāṃ kāraṇḍe tu kapardinam dhyāne śuddheśvaraṃ caiva gāyatryā muktakeśvara samaliṃgaṃ virasthāṇuṃ kapāliṃ karavīrake dīpte marukeśvaro jñeyaṃ nepāle tu paśoḥ patim gaṃgāsāre amara * * * * mokāramare jaṭilaṃ vāmeśvaraṃ caiva saumyaṃ ca kakudeśvarau japyeśvare triśūlaṃ ca śrīśaile tripurāntakam hemakūṭe virūpākṣaṃ bhūbhuvaṃ gandhamādane dānavānāṃ vadhārthāya vārāhaṃ vinyakeśvare laṃkāyāmardhadevaisaṃ pātāle hāṭakeśvaram aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṃ tu nāmāni mayā proktāni te'nagha iti vīratantre aṣṭaṣaṣṭisthāna (kathanaṃ nāma) prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ tantrāṇāmudbhavaṃ kiṃcittatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho tanoti vipulānarthāntatvamantra samāśritān kāmikaṃ yogajaṃ cintyaṃ kāraṇaṃ cājitaṃ tathā vijayaṃ caiva niśvāsaṃ svāyaṃbhuvaṃ tathānalam candrajñānaṃ ca bimbaṃ ca prodgītaṃ lalitaṃ tathā kiraṇaṃ vātulaṃ caiva aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃhitāḥ kāmikaṃ caiva viprendra trividhaṃ bhedamucyate cintyaṃ ca ṣaḍvidhaṃ proktaṃ saptadhā kāraṇaṃ bhavet suprabhedasya vikhyātaṃ bhedamanyanna vidyate vimalaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa aṃśumānsuprabhedakam vīraṃ ca rauravaṃ caiva makuṭaṃ vimalaṃ tathā svāyaṃbhuve viśeṣeṇa tadvidhena pravakṣyate vīratantraṃ ca viprendra trayodaśaṃ bhedamucyate

makuṭākhyaṃ mahātantraṃ dvividhenābhidhīyate candrajñānaṃ ca bimbaṃ ca caturdaśavidhaṃ bhavet prodgītākhyaṃ mahātantraṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ bhedamucyate siddhatantraṃ ca viprendra caturvidhena cocyate śarvoktaṃ tu mahātantraṃ paṃcabhedena cocyate kiraṇākhyaṃ mahātantraṃ navadhā bhedamucyate tantrakāyaṃ pravakṣyāmi tava snehādviśeṣataḥ jaṭāmakuṭasaṃyuktaṃ devavanmukhamucyate mukhaṃ prati triṇetraṃ syātsarvāṃgalakṣaṇairyutaḥ tatra kāyaṃ mahāproktaṃ sarvakāmārthasādhanam caturdaśāṃgulaṃ vāpi paṃcadaśāṃgulaṃ tu vā aṣṭādaśāṃgulaṃ vāpi navadaśāṃgulaṃ tu vā dvāviṃśatirvā viprendra kārayeddeśikottamaḥ utsedhaṃ cāṣṭadhā hitvā ekāṃgulaṃ caiva vistaram tribhāgaṃ tu caturbhāgaṃ madhye suṣiramucyate śeṣamāyamiti proktaṃ guṇaireva vivarjayet padaṃ pratiguṇe vṛddhiraṣṭabhirhrāsayettataḥ saptaviṃśatibhirhrāsaṃ labdhamiṣṭamiti smṛtam triṃśadbhirhrāsayettāni śeṣaṃ tithirihocyate śeṣaṃ vāramiti proktaṃ āyaṃ vyayaṃ ca yoni ca āyādhikaṃ vyayaṃ hīnaṃ saṃpatkaramihocyate tasmātsarvaprayatnena āyahīnaṃ na kārayet dhū?mraśvā gardabhaṃ kāko doṣānyetāni varjayet evaṃ parīkṣya bahudhā kartavyaṃ pustakaṃ param viśvāmitro'tha vālmīkiḥ kāśyapaścāṅgirāstathā

caturdaśāṃgulādīni kramādvinyasya dehinaḥ jagatī śatvarī caiva atiśatvari eva ca brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraḥ śiva eva ca caturdaśāṃgulādīni devānāmihacocyate ṣaṭpaṃktirvātha paṃcairvā lekhayetpustakaṃ tataḥ paṃktirevaṃ samākhyātaṃ tattannāmādhidevatā ṛṣīṇāṃ bhūrjapatre tu lekhayettu dvijottama dvau pārśvakampa saṃyuktau pustakāyamatatsamam śivāgre maṇḍapaṃ kuryādīśāne dakṣiṇe'pi vā vedībāhye tu paritaḥ paṃca kuṇḍāni kārayet sthaṇḍilaṃ vā prakartavyaṃ lakṣaṇena samanvitam yathāṃkurārpaṇaṃ kuryātpaṃcāhe vā tryahepi vā sa hiraṇyaṃ sakūrcaṃ ca somarājādhidaivatam vinyasettu viśeṣeṇa pālikāścāṣṭadikṣu ca hṛdayena tu mantreṇa bījāni vinyasettataḥ suptadeśe samutthāpya pālikāḥ sthāpayettataḥ svarṇena tantunā vipra kautukaṃ bandhayeddhṛdā lepayetpustakaṃ tatra śayane śāyayettataḥ śālyardhāṃstaṇḍulānnyasya taṇḍulārdhaṃ tilānnyaset tattadāgamabījena śāyayecchayanopari ādyakṣarasamāyukta manusvārasamanvitam vastreṇāveṣṭayettatra pustakaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ sarasvatīṃ nyasettatra pustakasya tu madhyame śuddhodakena saṃpūrya sa kūrcaṃ sāpidhānakam mūlamantreṇa vinyasya arcayettu viśeṣataḥ

sa vastraṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca sakūrcādīni vinyaset balavikariṇīṃ balapramathinīṃ sarvabhūta damanīm hṛdayādīṣasaṃghaiśca pūjayettu vidhānataḥ pālāśaḥ pūrvatobhāge aśvatthaṃ dakṣiṇe tathā udumbaraṃ tathaiśānyāṃ pālāśairvāpi hūyate samidhaṃ sadyamantreṇa īśānenājyameva ca sarṣapānsadyamantreṇa netreṇa tu yavāṃstathā sahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vāpi hūyate dravyānte vyāhṛtiṃ hutvā pustakaṃ sparśayeddhṛdā sviṣṭamagneti mantreṇa juhuyāttadanantare tattadāgamabījena prokṣayedbardhanīṃ tataḥ havirnivedayetpaścāttāmbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥ brāhmaṇānpūjayettatra saptakanyāśca pūjayet kāpālaṃ paṃcarātraṃ ca ṣaḍete samayāḥ smṛtāḥ tantrasaṃkaradoṣeṇa rājarāṣṭraṃ vinaśyati aṣṭāviṃśatibhedena śaivabhedaṃ vidhīyate dīkṣitasya subīrasya śivabhaktiratasya ca adīkṣitaṃ na śrotavyaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasya cit tantrāvatāramevoktaṃ paṃcākṣaraṃ tataḥ śṛṇu iti vīratantre ṣaṭsahastrikāyāṃ tantrāvatāro dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ śrīpaṃcākṣarakalpaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ vada me prabho ! namaskāreṇa saṃyuktaṃ śiva ityakṣaradvayam tadvargāntaṃ saptamaṃ syātpaṃcākṣaramiti smṛtam caturthyā tu samāyuktaṃ paṃcākṣaramiti smṛtam yakāreṇa samāyuktaṃ paṃcākṣaramihocyate

ṛgvedo jāyate vipra nakārākṣaramucyate atharvavede vākāraṃ yakāramitihāsake śikāraṃ taijasamāyuktaṃ vākāraṃ vāyumeva ca nakāraṃ śvetavarṇaṃ tu īśvareṇa samāyutam sthānaṃ sadyomukhaṃ caiva nakārākṣaramucyate anuṣṭhubhchandasāyuktaṃ mantriṇā ca samāyutam vākāraṃ raktavarṇaṃ tu skandastatrādhidaivatam puruṣasya mukhaṃ sthānaṃ vākārākṣaramucyate sāvitrī chandasā yuktaṃ bhāradvājena saṃyutam paṃcākṣaramiti proktaṃ praṇavaṃ śṛṇu tatvataḥ akāraṃ brahmadaivatyamukāraṃ viṣṇudaivatam ṛgvedastu akāraḥ syādyajurvedamukārakam akāraṃ sātvikaṃ vidyādukāraṃ rājasaṃ bhavet ukāraṃ pauṣṭikaṃ vidyānmakāramābhicārakam makāraṃ pītavarṇaṃ syādevameva krameṇa tu oṃkāreṇa samāyuktaṃ ṣaḍakṣaramihocyate aṃgulyā prajapedekaṃ paṃcadhā mṛṇmayaṃ bhavet śatasaṃkhyaistu vijñeyaṃ pravālaistu sahasrakam padmākṣaiḥ koṭiguṇitaṃ sauvarṇairdaśakoṭikam nyāsaṃ kuryāttato mantrī paṃcākṣaramihocyate kaniṣṭhādyaṃguṣṭhāntaṃ saṃhāranyāsamucyate karanyāsaṃ purākṛtvā aṃganyāsaṃ tataḥ śṛṇu śikāraṃ karṇadeśe tu makāraṃ hṛdaye nyaset sarvāṃgeṣu ca viprendra oṃkāraṃ vinyasettataḥ paṃcāśatpaṃcaviṃśairvā japaṃ kuryādviśeṣataḥ

japaṃ kuryāttu viprendra praṇavena samāyutam nadītīre śataṃ vidyātsahasraṃ devatālaye paṃcaviṃśantato lakṣairvaiṣṇavaṃ padamāpnuyāt praviśecchivamīśānaṃ * * saṃsāra sāgarāt iti vīratantre ṣaṭsahasrasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīpaṃcākṣarakalpastṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ sarvapāpa(praṇāśā)rthaṃ mantroddhāraḥ kathaṃ bhavet mananaṃ sarvamantrāṇāṃ trāṇaṃ saṃsārasāgarāt gaṃgākūle samudre vā prabhāse vā viśeṣataḥ anyeṣu śuddhadeśeṣu mantramuddhārayetkramāt snānaṃ kṛtvā tu viprendra tatsthāne mantramuddharet ācāryastu śucirbhūtvā kṛtopavāsasaṃyutam ratnena * * * vipra akṣaraṃ lekhayeddhṛdā bindornādassamutpannastasmācchaktirajāyata kalāyā vyaṃjanaṃ jātaṃ vyaṃjanā * * mantrakaḥ avargaṃ ca kavargaṃ ca cavargaṃ ca ṭavargakam ādivargeṣu ṛ-ṛca caturakṣaraṃ varjayet pūrvaṃ hṛsvaṃ samākhyātaṃ paraṃ dīrghamihocyate sadyojātaṃ tu gokṣīra sadṛśaṃ varṇamucyate puruṣaṃ kuṃkumaprakhyaṃ īśānaṃ sphaṭikaṃ bhavet dvinetrāṃ cāruvadanāṃ sustanāṃ ca suyauvanām ṣadaṃgaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi hṛdayaṃ ca śirastathā indudhūmraṃ suvarṇaṃ ca kiṃciddhūmraṃ tathaiva ca ṣaḍaṃgānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ mantraṃ varṇaṃ vicintayet jaṭāmakuṭasaṃyuktāṃ yajñopavītasaṃyutām strīrūpaṃ bhāvayedbrahmā ṣaḍaṃgaṃ puruṣo bhavet

atasīpuṣpasaṃkāśaṃ padmapuṣpasamaṃ bhavet raktapaṃkajasaṃyuktaṃ bhinnāñjanasamaprabham akṣarasyādisaṃyuktaṃ binduṃ caiva samāyutam śivaviṣṇusamārūḍhaṃ prathamaṃ cāṣṭavargake prathamasyākādasaṃgṛhya śivaviṣṇusamāyutam paṃcamasya prathamaṃ syādvitīyaṃ saptamasya ca aṣṭamasyādi samāyuktaṃ māyānalasamanvitam prathamasya dvitīyaṃ tu bindunādasamanvitam gaṇāmbikā ca caṇḍeśo nandīśaśca tathaiva ca bhṛṃgīśaśca mahāsenaḥ svanāmādyakṣarairyutam vāyussomastatheśāno brahmā viṣṇuśca saṃyutam vajraṃ śaktiṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ tathāṃkuśam svanāmādyena bījena bindunādasamanvitam śrīvatsaṃ svastikaṃ śaṃkhaṃ dīpo devāṣṭamaṃgalam ṣaṣṭhavargāddvitīyaṃ tu caturthādyena saṃyutam visargeṇa samāyuktaṃ pāśupatāstramucyate bindunādasamāyuktamācāryaṃ bījamucyate mātrāṇāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca * * * gaṇameva ca mūrtipānāṃ ca śiṣyāṇāmevameva krameṇa tu yakārādidvayaṃ vargaṃ caturakṣaramucyate anantāsanaṃ tadviprendra yogāsanaṃ tathaiva ca vimalāsanaṃ tu viprendra svanāmādyakṣarairyutam āgneyamaṇḍalaṃ caiva vinyasettu viśeṣataḥ tatvāmaṇḍalamevoktaṃ svanāmādyakṣarairyutam vyomavyāpi mahāmantraṃ ṣaṇṇavatyakṣarairyutam

dvādaśasya padasya bahiśyadvivitathā punam mantramuccāryate vipra sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt śivaviṣṇusamārūḍhaṃ śivamantramihocyate vyomaśca rūpāśca vaścaivaṃ rūpāyaśvata eva ca taśca yaścaiva dhvāyaśca pukamaśvadṛdṛmaśca ca daśca pāśca vineraśca neśca miśca na eva ca evaṃ krameṇa viprendra vinyasedastramantravit niścayaśca gīpaścaiva tumaguśca jātaśca bhāśca ta vyoścaścaiva ye yośca omaśca dhaśca eva ca viśca sarva oṃ bhraśca jaścedīriśca vāyaniśca evaṃ krameṇa vinyāsaṃ sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt agastyena samāyuktaṃ bṛhatīcchandasā yutam vasiṣṭhena samāyuktaṃ prakṛticchandasā yutam ācāryasya tu bījasya ṛṣicchando devatā atriṇā ca samāyuktaṃ paṃcavaktreṣu dīkṣitāḥ jagatī śakvarī caiva anuṣṭubtriṣṭhubheva ca āgameva tu bījāni pravakṣyāmyanupūrvaśaḥ * * * * dvitīyaṃ tu bindunādavibhūṣitam saptamasyādisaṃyuktaṃ trayodaśa samanvitam tṛtīyasyādimaṃ gṛhya saptamasya tṛtīyakam cintyākṣaramidaṃ proktaṃ dvitīyasyādisaṃyutam kāraṇākhyamidaṃ proktaṃ prathamasyādi saṃyutam bindunādasamāyuktamajitākṣaramucyate dvādaśākṣarasaṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam dvādaśa svara saṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam

saptamasya dvitīyaṃ tu māyābījena saṃyutam antyākṣarasamāyuktamādyakṣarasamanvitam aṣṭavargāttṛtīyaṃ tu analena samāyutaḥ suprabhedākṣaraṃ proktaṃ saptavargasya cādikam vijayaṃ caiva viprendra paṃcamasyāntasaṃyutam niśvāsatantra mevoktamaṣṭavargatṛtīyakam bindunādasamāyuktaṃ vīratantramihocyate akṣarāṇāṃ paraśreṣṭhaṃ rauravaṃ procyate mayā māyānalasamāyuktaṃ makuṭākṣaramucyate bindunādasamāyuktaṃ vimalaṃ caiva kathyate bindunādasamāyuktaṃ candrajñānamihocyate bindunādasamāyuktaṃ bimbasyākṣaramucyate bindunādasamāyuktaṃ prodgītaṃ ca mayocyate bindunādasamāyuktaṃ lalitasya tu mantrakam analena samāyuktaṃ siddhatantramihocyate saptamasya dvitīyena bindunādasamanvitam dvādaśasvarasaṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam māyānalasamāyuktaṃ bindunāda samanvitam dvādaśasvarasaṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam māyānalasamāyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam ṛṣicchandodaivatānvakṣye āgamānāṃ viśeṣataḥ tavarūpeṇa saṃyuktaṃ kāmikādīni sapta ca jagatīcchandasāyuktaṃ viṣṇustatrādhidaivatam adīkṣitaṃ na śrotavyaṃ na deyaṃ na prakāśataḥ aṣṭavargatṛtīyāntā ādyakṣarasamāyutam

śaktibījamidaṃ proktaṃ sarvakarmārthasādhanam śuddhasphaṭika saṃkāśaṃ tryakṣaṃ daśabhujairyutam divyāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam pāśaṃ cāṃkuśaghaṇṭāṃ ca nāgavahniṃ ca vāmake etatsakalamākhyātaṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadam iti vīratantre ṣaṭsahasra saṃhitāyāṃ mantroddhāraścaturthaḥ paṭalaḥ viśeṣaṃ śrotumicchāmi taṃ me brūhi maheśvara ayogyāni ca puṣpāṇāṃ patrāṇāṃ ca tapodhana karavīra sahasrebhyo bilvapatraṃ viśiṣyate padmapatra sahasrebhyaḥ puṇḍarīkaṃ viśiṣyate śatapatrasahasrebhyaḥ sahasraparṇaṃ viśiṣyate bakapuṣpasahasrebhyo dhurdhūrakaṃ viśiṣyate droṇapuṣpasahasrebhyo apāmārgaṃ viśiṣyate kuśapuṣpasahasrebhyaḥ śamīpuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate vyāghātakasahasrebhyaḥ śaṃkhapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate vyāghrapuṣpasahasrebhyaḥ sadābhadraṃ viśiṣyate * * * * * * dvipra bṛhatpuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate śvetārkasya sahasrebhyo bṛhaddroṇaṃ viśiṣyate svarṇadhurdhūrapuṣpaṃ tu nīlotpalasamodbhavaiḥ punaḥ pūjāḥ prakartavyāḥ sarvalokahitāya ca droṇapuṣpa sahasrebhyo jñeyaṃ viṣṇukrāntiṃ ca pastathā bilvapatrasamaṃ jñeyaṃ * * * * * * * * padmapuṣpasamaṃ jñeyaṃ vakulaṃ pa * * * * śvetaṃkusuma * raktotpalamapāmārgaṃ bhavet gandhapuṣpī gandhapuṣpā padmapuṣpasamaṃ bhavet

vedasī se kā cotpalaṃ caiva kalhāraṃ kṛntakaṃ tathā musalī palāśapuṣpaṃ ca droṇapuṣpasamaṃ bhavet sūryāvartaṃ ca nāgaṃ ca * * * * * meva ca vajraṃ ca padmarāgaṃ ca marakatamauktikāni ca nīlotpalasamā jñeyā sarvaratnāni caiva hi aṃkolasaṃkaraścaiva priyaṃguścampakeva ca pālāśapuṣpaṃ viprendra raviraśmisamāyutam yavagodhūmanīvāra brīhivaiṇavakāni ca aṃkurāṇi prakartavyaṃ pūjayecchivamādarāt kadambārjuna sindūraṃ kuḍumaṃ kusumāni ca kadalīpuṣpapunnāga nāganandī tathaiva ca madhūka dhūrtapuṣpaṃ ca karapāddhirdhavāni vā girirāgakakau girikakaca dhurdhūraka samaṃ bhavet puṣpāṇāmapyalābhe tu phalānāṃ pūjayettataḥ mūlānāmapyabhāve tu bhaktyā caiva tu pūjayet ketakīmādhavīpadmaṃ madhudhī pūjayetsadā nīlakaṇṭhī ca mevaśca talapoṭakameva ca evamevaṃ krameṇaiva yo naraḥ pūjayetsadā puṣpādhyāyamidaṃ proktaṃ karṣaṇasya vidhiṃ śṛṇu iti vīratantre ṣaṭsahasrasaṃhitāyāṃ puṣpalakṣaṇaṃ paṃcamaḥ paṭalaḥ etatsarvaṃ samāsena brūhi me parameśvara puṣyamāsādiṣaṇmāsaṃ devatānāṃ divā bhavet divāmāsaṃ ca gṛhṇīyādrātrimāsaṃ ca varjayet maitrādityamakhāsvātī tvaṣṭārvāśravaṇāśśubhā dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā ca paṃcamī ṣaṣṭhisaptamī

pratipatpaurṇamāsyāṃ vā kārayettu śivadvijaḥ somabhārgavasaumyānāṃ vārā śreṣṭhatamāḥ smṛtāḥ aṣṭamasthā grahāḥ sarve kartuḥ kurvantu susthitam grahaṇe viṣuve caiva ayane vyatipātake evaṃ parīkṣā kartavyā sarvasaṃpatkarāya ca ūṣaraṃ kukumimiṣṭarja? valmīkāḍhyaṃ ca varjayet pītā vaiśyā iti proktā kṛṣṇā śūdrā iti smṛtāḥ adhikaṃ cottamaṃ jñeyamadhamaṃ nyūnameva ca evaṃ parīkṣya bahudhā kuryātkarṣaṇamuttamam sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyukto valavānmadhyamovaraḥ kṣīravṛkṣayugaṃ badhvā gocarmeṇaiva bandhayet ācāryaḥ sakalīkṛtya navavastreṇa veṣṭayet tīkṣṇa śṛṃgāya vidmahe vedapādāya dhīmahi (tanno vṛṣaḥ) pracodayāt prāgudakkarṣayettatra ācāryaṃ pūjayettataḥ ācāryāya pradātavyaṃ sahagau vṛṣabhau tathā śalyaṃ vimocayettatra lakṣaṇena samanvitam pūjānte sparśayankartāyidaṃgastannirīkṣayet asthiśalyaṃ śirasparśāntadadhastaṃ ca dvayamānataḥ trihaste śṛṃgalāśalyamaṃgha sparśāttu deśikaḥ aṃgārakatrihaste tu bāhusparśanamucyate kaniṣṭhāṃ guṣṭayoḥ sparśātkarārdhaikāṃgamucyate nābhikorparaṃ haste jānusparśameva ca kughnaṃsatvā tu viprendra gomayenānulepayet aśvatthodumbaro vātha śaṃkuṃ grāhayettataḥ tatra madhye sthitaṃ śaṃkuṃ tanmānena tu bhrāmayet

pūrvāhne ca parāhne ca śaṃkucchāyāṃ viloñcayet vāstu devānsamarbhyarcya puruṣaṃ pūjayettataḥ mahātapasi saṃbhūtaṃ bhūtākāraṃ mahābalam prāgeva tattanmānena madhyasthenaiva kārayet paṃcagavyena saṃprokṣya ṣaṇṇavatyena mantrataḥ daśasūtrāṃśca prāgagrānudagagrāṃstathaiva ca madhye navapadaṃ kṛtvā caturdikṣu ca vinyaset dakṣiṇe tu vivasvāṃśca ṣaṭpadaṃ caiva bhujyate uttare ṣaṭpadaṃ bhuṃkte pṛthivīdhara eva ca sāvitra savitāścaiva āgneyyāṃ tu padadvayam rudraradrojayaścaiva vāyavyāṃ tu padadvaye ādityassatyakabhraṃśa antarikṣaśca pūrvaśaḥ gandharvo bhṛṃgarāgaśca bhṛṃgaścaiva tu dakṣiṇe puṣpadantaśca varuṇa apsaraśca tathaiva ca uttareṣu tathā rogānnāgo mukhyastathaiva ca pūtanā nair-ṛte caiva pāparākṣasi vāyave evaṃ vinyasya devāṃśca puruṣaḥ procyate mayā āpāpavatsake vipra vāmabāhuriti smṛtaḥ rudro rudrodayaścaiva vāmapādaṃ prakīrtitam mitraścaiva tu liṃgasya vṛṣaṇaṃ pṛṣṭhameva ca māse bhādrapadeṣvādi pūrvaśīrṣakamucyate phalgunyāditrayo māsāḥ paścimaṃ śira ucyate pūrvaśīrṣaṃ tu madhyāhne sāye dakṣiṇaśīrṣakam uṣaḥkāle tu sarveṣu uttare śira ucyate vakṣye balividhiṃ yaśca tāvacchṛṇu tapodhana

pradadya phalabhakṣyaṃ tu samaryāke viśeṣataḥ pūṣṇe ca dadhimitre ca mahiṣakṣīrameva ca mahendre piṣṭamevaṃ tu * * * madhurucyate kakvānaścata * * the bimbāna ca grahakṣate samudramatsyaṃ viprendra bhṛṃgarājabaliṃ tataḥ iṣṭeva śatapiṣṭe dauvāriśca gravake asure madhukaṃ vidyācchoṣe ca tilataṇḍulaiḥ mukhye'pi dhānyacūrṇaṃ tu dadhi saṃyutameva ca ṛgvedave gulaṃ caivaditidaivastu modakaiḥ āpe tathā pavatse ca ajamāṃsaṃ ca matsyakam indre balistathā dadyādindrajaye tu mudgakam carakīghṛtamenaṃ tu pitāri lavaṇaṃ tathā sphaṭitaḥ kṛtopavāsaṃ ca evameva baliṃ dadet ācāryaśca śucirbhūtvā upavāsasamanvitam praṇavādyena saṃyuktaṃ baliṃ dadyācchivadvijaḥ evameva mahāśāntissarvasaṃpatkarāya ca śivalokamavāpnoti śivavanmodate sadā karṣaṇasya vidhiḥ prokta ācāryalakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu iti vīratantre ṣaṭsahasrasaṃhitāyāṃ karṣaṇa vidhiḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ kasminkule tu saṃjātāstatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho ! samāsātkathayiṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu sarveṣāṃ ca guruścaiva gururityabhidhīyate apramatto bhavennityaṃ nityaṃ vā gurupūjakaḥ śaivāssaptavidhā jñeyāsteṣāṃ bhedaṃ śṛṇuṣvatha tṛtīyastu mahāśaivāścaturthaścānuśaivakaḥ

saptamo vā nyaśaivastu śaivānāṃ bheda ucyate mahāśaivaḥ kevalo vipraḥ kṣatriyo vaiśya eva ca savarṇāmbaṣṭha madhyasthau kulālapāraśavāstathā anyeṣāmihajātī nāmanya śaiva mihocyate kauśikaḥ kāśyapaścaiva bhāradvājo trireva ca śivena dīkṣitāścaiva śivabrāhmaṇa ucyate kauśikaścottaramukhaḥ kāśyapaścaiva dakṣiṇe atrirūrdhvamukhaṃ jñeyaṃ evameteṣu dīkṣitāḥ kauśikaḥ śivabhaktastu kāśyapastvīśvareṇa tu atressadāśivaścaiva umādhūrtastu dīkṣitaḥ śivadīkṣātparaṃ jātaḥ śivabrāhmaṇa ucyate gokarṇe tu bharadvājo nāgarikastu gautamaḥ śaivaṃ pāśupataṃ somaṃ lākulaṃ ca caturvidham eteṣāmapi tantrāṇāṃ navatvaikasya tu saṃkaraḥ tantrasaṃkaradoṣeṇa rājarāṣṭraṃ vinaśyati kāmikaṃ yogajaṃ cintyaṃ kāraṇaṃ cājitaṃ tathā vijayaṃ caiva niśvāsaṃ svāyaṃbhuvamathānalam candrajñānaṃ ca bimbaṃ ca prodgītaṃ lalitaṃ tathā kiraṇaṃ vā tulaṃ tvetāstvaṣṭāviṃśati saṃhitāḥ ācāryaṃ śivamevāhuḥ śiva ācārya ucyate saubhadro viṣayākhyātā kauśalā māgadhāstathā keralaścāryadeśaśca mālavaṃ ca marūṇi ca jonakāstuluvāścaiva karṇāṭakaśca deśataḥ kumārī himavanmadhye * * * * * * * * haihalaṃ bagharaṃ jonyaṃ varjayelliṃgakarmaṇi

ādiśaivakule jātassa tu vaidika ucyate dīkṣitasya kule jātassarvāgamaviśāradaḥ sarvāyavasaṃpūrṇaḥ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutaḥ kriyādi jñānaparyantatantrajñāna viśāradaḥ sanābhiḥ kunakho * * bālo vṛddhastathaiva ca atidīrgho'tihṛsvaśca atisthūlaḥ kṛśastathā nagnaprabhā tathā kṣībaśmaśruromādivarjitaḥ anabadyāśca viprendra gaṇakāśca tathaiva ca vyasanāḥ krūrakarmāṇaḥ pāradārika corakāḥ kuṣṭhinaścakṣuhīnāśca badhirāḥ śrutidūṣakāḥ rājarāṣṭrāpi naśyanti tasmindeśe na varṣati ādiśaivena kartavyaṃ pratiṣṭhādyarcanāntakam sa gotreṇa tu sambandhaṃ na kartavyaṃ kadācana eṣāmṛṣīṇāṃ viprendra jātānāṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ upanayana kālānte maṇḍale pūjayecchivam sthiraliṃgaṃ tu śūdrāṇāṃ spṛśyate tvabhicārataḥ ātmārthaṃ pūjayennityaṃ sarveṣāṃ jātireva ca ācāryahastayordadyācchiva lokamavāpnuyāt śivadvijānāṃ sarveṣāṃ na doṣāya prakalpayet ācāryahastayordadyācchiva lokamavāpnuyāt patitaṃ cānucāṇḍāla dhūpadeśevikaṃ śivim grāmakukkuṭamevaṃ tu saṃspṛṣṭvāgniṃ tathaiva ca snānaṃ kṛtvā tu viprenda sa prāsādena saṃyutam prayaṃ prātastrayaṃ sāyaṃ * * madyādayācitam ṣoḍaśānāṃ kriyāṇāṃ ca pūrvamevācarettathā

ācāryalakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ dīkṣā(yā) maṇḍalaṃ śṛṇu iti vīra tantre ṣaṭsahasrasaṃhitāyāṃ ācārya lakṣaṇaṃ saptamaḥ paṭalaḥ maṇḍalaṃ kīdṛśaṃ deva tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho tatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana udyāne caiva goṣṭhe vā mahātaṭākatīrake vā atha śuddhagṛhe vāpi kārayenmaṇḍapaṃ tataḥ śrutihastaṃ paṃcahastaṃ vā ṣaḍhastamadhamatrayam daśaikādaśahastaṃ tu dvādaśaṃ cottamaṃ bhavet ṣoḍaśastambha saṃyuktaṃ paṃktimānamathocchraye kramukaṃ veṇudaṇḍaṃ vā vakulī ketakī tathā nālikerasya patreṇa vidheyamācchādanaṃ tataḥ digdhvajaiśca samāyuktaṃ vitānopariśobhitam evameva krameṇaiva pūrvaṃ bhūmiṃ parīkṣayet vaiśyasya vasudhā pītā kṛṣṇā śūdrā iti smṛtā vaiśyasya ṣaḍrasā jñeyā śūdrastu kaṭukā smṛtā mūtragandhā tu vaiśyasya śūdrā viṣṭhānugandhinī hastamātraṃ khanedbhūmiṃ pūrayettena pāṃsunā hīnācāpyadhamaṃ jñeyamadhamaṃ ca vivarjayet paṃcagavyena saṃprokṣya śivamantreṇa deśikaḥ pāṃsubhiśchāyayitvā tu dhiṣṇyaṃ samyak prakalpayet pūrvāgraṃ saptahastaṃ syādudagagraṃ tathaiva ca īśo jayanta ādityā satyakaśca bhṛśastathā bhṛṃgaśca pitṛ sugrīvo varuṇaścāsurastathā ardhārdhadvipadaṃ bhuṃkte pūrve tu samarīcakaḥ ardhārdhadvipadaṃ bhuṃkte uttare pṛthivīdharaḥ

rudrajayaśca viprendra īśānaika padasthitāḥ carakī vidārī caiva pūtanā pāparākṣasī pururṣaṃ pūrvaṃ saṃkalpya * * rīke śiro bhavet sāvitrīṃ candra ca viprendra dakṣīmabahurucyate indrajayastathaiva syāddakṣiṇaṃ pādamucyate gandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca varuṇaścaiva pūjitam pūrve catuṣpade caiva aṣṭādaśa tu bhājayet evameva krameṇaiva caturdikṣu ca bhrāmayet bāhyakārṇaṃ pade cārdho vartayedvṛttameva ca prativāraṇarekhā ca ekāṃgulena kārayet aṃgulenaiva bhūmitvā * * * * * * * * aṃgule naiva viprendra upaśobhāṃ ca vartayet kesaraṃ tu tribhāgaikaṃ karṇikāṃ caiva vartayet mokṣadaṃ maṇḍalaṃ proktaṃ śāntikaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvatha nair-ṛte śānakoṇe vā vāyavyāgneyameva vā khādirāḥ śaṃkavaḥ kāryā bilvacūtakadambakaiḥ aṣṭāṃgulasamutsedhaṃ tadardhaṃ nāhamucyate dalāyāmaṃ ca viprendra caturdaśāṃgulaṃ bhavet śobhā vapyupaśobhāṃ ca vartayedaṃgulāntarā maṇḍalaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi muktācūrṇena saṃyutam gairikaiṣṭaka cūrṇaiśca indranīlasya cūrṇakaiḥ haridrā cūrṇasaṃyuktaṃ maṇḍale vinyasettataḥ madhyame pītavarṇaṃ tu agre śvetamihocyate āgneyyāṃ raktavarṇaṃ ca yāmye kṛṣṇamihocyate tadante rajanīṃ nyasya śālipiṣṭaṃ tadantake

ekahastaṃ dvihastaṃ vā caturhastamathāpi vā hastaṃ ca triṃśatirvāpi ita urdhvaṃ na kārayet aṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi dalasaṃkhyā vidhīyate puruṣaṃ pūrvadale nyasya aghoraṃ dakṣiṇe dale āgneyyāṃ hṛdaye nyasya śiramīśānake dale kavacaṃ vāyudeśe tu netramīśāna deśake daityake tu pade caiva śiṣyādhivāsanaṃ bhavet brāhmīke maṇḍale kuryādevameva krameṇa tu prokṣayedambhasā caiva puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ āvāhayettato devaṃ sadyo jātena mantrataḥ sāṃnidhyaṃ puruṣeṇaiva īśānena tu pūjayet nivedaccaraṇaṃ tasmātsarvopadaṃśa saṃyutam pātraśeṣaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ taṃ tacchiṣyāya pradāpayet ācamya vidhinānena dantenāspṛśya prāśayet dantakāṣṭhaṃ tataḥ kuryāddvādaśāṃguladairghyakam kṣīravṛkṣamapāmārgaṃ dantadhāvanamucyate śodhayitvā malaṃ vipra ācamya ca vidhānataḥ aghoreṇa tu mantreṇa bhasma śirasi vinyaset śivāṃgairbrahmabhiryuktaṃ japitvā paṃcaprāśayet śiṣyaṃ cādhivasenmantrī maṇḍalasya tu dakṣiṇe agnikuṇḍaṃ prakartavyaṃ dvātriṃśatṣoḍaśaṃ tu vā vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā sarvakuṇḍāni kārayet pālāśakhadirāśvattha plakṣanyagrodhameva ca samidājya caruṃ lājānbaliṃ ca sarṣapaṃ tathā samidhaṃ sadyamantreṇa ājyaṃ hṛdayameva ca

śilānyanneyamaṃ caiva śālīṃ ca puruṣeṇa tu śivāya daśahotavyaṃ vidyeśādviguṇaṃ bhavet triguṇaṃ lokapālāstraṃ homayeddeśikottamaḥ sa vastrānsāpidhānāṃśca samagre hemasaṃyutān dhānyopari vidhātavyaṃ candanodakapūritam puruṣaṃ pūrvataḥ sthāpya aghoraṃ dakṣiṇena tu aiśānyāmīśamantreṇa āgneyyāṃ hṛdayena tu tattanmantreṇa saṃyuktaṃ tattatkumbheṣu deśikaḥ hṛdayena tu mantreṇa naivedyaṃ dāpayecchive śubhāśubhāni svapnāni yatnena tu parīkṣayet viṣṭhānulepaṃ rudhirasrutiṃ ca svapneṣu gamyaṃ gamanaṃ ca dhānyam paśyate piśajaṃ svapne mahā(na)rthamavāpnuyāt arpitaṃ pilitaṃ vāpi pakvaṃ vā śubhavṛkṣake śālikṣetre mahaṃ pakvaṃ dṛśyate śālilābhakam dṛśyate puṣpamālāyā arthalābhaṃ vinirdiśet svapnepi dṛśyate vipra dhanalābhaṃ vinirdiśet śārikāṃ vā bhayaṃ vāpi dṛśyet kuṭumbavardhanam patraṃ vā cārthalābhaṃ vā labhate'tra saṃśayaḥ dātavyamapi svapnepi (tu) duḥkhanāśaṃ bhavanti vai janaṃ vā vānaraṃ vāpi sarpaṃ vāpi ca dṛśyate prāsādārohaṇaṃ vāpi samudraṃ dṛśyate naraḥ ādityamaṇḍalaṃ svapne darśanādrājyamāpnuyāt arthalābhamavāpnoti darśanādarthamāpnuyāt vidyālābhaṃ dvijānāṃ tu itarastu dhanaṃ labhet amedhyaṃ darśanaṃ bhakṣye arthalābhaṃ vinirdiśet

raktapāne mahāvyādhirājyaṃ ca dadhibhojanam mahatsukhamavāpnoti māsā maraṇamāpnuyāt mūḍho vā līyate pakṣe māsānmaraṇamāpnuyāt nigalaṃ cātra dṛśye tu mahadvyādhimavāpnuyāt pādadeśe sthitā nārī vyādhitairmaraṇaṃ bhavet māsānmaraṇamāpnoti svapnānte dṛśyate yadi saṃnyāsinaṃ kṣapaṇaṃ boddhaṃ dṛśyate maraṇaṃ bhavet mahāstriyamavāpnoti svapnānte dṛśyate yadi kiṃśukaṃ raktapuṣpāṇi karavīraṃ tu varjayet narāṇāṃ brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭho rājānāṃ madhyamaṃ bhavet dhenuṃ (ca) vṛṣabhaṃ caiva siṃhaṃ caiva mṛgaṃ tathā kulasthaṃ sarṣapaṃ mudgaṃ dṛśyate vyādhimāpnuyāt eteṣāṃ tu phalaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhanadhānyaṃ mavāpnuyāt yastu paśyati svapnānte dhanamāyuryaśo bhavet māṃsaṃ vāpi ca matsyaṃ vā labdho śubhadaṃ bhavet rājā pīḍāmavāpnoti pratārairvyādhimādiśet raṇḍāṃ ca muṇḍāṃ vāpi nagnastrīṃ vāpi paśyati purīṣaṃ vāpi mūtraṃ vā na svapne darśayettataḥ śālyannaṃ bhuṃjate yastu āyuḥ śrīkīrtivardhanam śubhe tu praviśeddīkṣāmaśubhe homamācaret sarvaṃ haratu me pāpaṃ dūrvā duḥsvapnanāśinī svapnaṃ tu prathame yāme vatsaratraya pākanam caturthe viśvayāme ca ṣaṇmāsātsidhyate tataḥ aruṇodayavelāyāṃ saptāhātsiddhimāpnuyāt svapnaṃ parīkṣya bahudhā prabhāte snapanaṃ bhavet

dīkṣāmaṇḍalataḥ proktadīkṣāmārgamataḥ śṛṇu iti vīratantre ṣaṭsahasrasaṃhitāyāṃ dīkṣāmaṇḍalavidhiraṣṭamaḥ paṭalaḥ śaivāssaptavidhājñeyā tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho ! tatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana tathostu saṃghaṭīkṛtya sā dīkṣā iti kathyate anādi śaivaṃ prathamamādiśaivaṃ dvitīyakam avāntarastu śaivaṃ tu paṃcamaṃ tu vidurbudhāḥ śaivāssaptavidhāḥ proktāsteṣāṃ bhedaṃ śṛṇuṣva ca śivadvijāśca viprendra ādiśaivāḥ prakīrtitāḥ gautamaścaiva paṃcaiva paṃcavaktreṣu dīkṣitāḥ śivadīkṣā na kartavyā kartavyā cetsuniṣphalā snapanaṃ cāṃgaśudhyarthaṃ kārayettu śivadvijān adīkṣitaścaturvedī śivapūjāṃ na kārayet saṇmāsātpatanaṃ yānti yajeddevalakāḥ smṛtāḥ pūjayedyadi viprastu sa vai devalako bhavet sthiraliṃgeṣu yatpūjānnakurvanti kadācana śūdro vāpyantaro vāpi antare śaiva cocyate pravaraśaivamiti khyātaṃ idamanyacchṛṇuṣva ca * * * ādiśaivena pratiṣṭhābhyarcanāntakam śaivabhedā mayākhyātā dīkṣāvidhimataḥ śṛṇu puṣyaṃ śatabhiṣak caiva dīkṣānakṣatramucyate mithunaṃ vāpi kanyā vā dhanurvā mīnameva vā dvitīyā paṃcamī vāpi ṣaṣṭhī vāpi viśeṣataḥ ete hi tithayaḥ proktā vārāṃścaiva śṛṇuṣva ca bṛhaspatyudayaṃ vāpi śukrodayamathāpi vā

aṣṭamasthā grahāścaiva paścācchiṣyānupoṣitān pādaprakṣālanaṃ kuryādācamya vidhinā tataḥ dukūlapaṭṭasaṃyuktaṃ kārpāsikamathāpi vā adhamaṃ navahastaṃ tu catustālaṃ tu vistṛtam sadaśāhatavastreṇa netrabandhaṃ tu kārayet vyomavyāpi japettatra tatpuruṣeṇa samāyutam uttamaṃ daśaniṣkaṃ tu aṣṭaniṣkaṃ tu madhyamam daridrāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ yathālābhena kārayet īśānena tu mantreṇa puṣpaṃ haste nidhāpayet dhyātvā tu parameśānaṃ śivamantreṇa buddhimān dhyātvā tu parameśānaṃ śivamantreṇa buddhimān tanmantraṃ sidhyate tasya kuruto vāpyanugraham nair-ṛtyāṃ śrīkaraṃ proktaṃ anāyuṣyaṃ tu vāyu ca karṇike patite puṣpe sukhaṃ caiva bhavettadā udakena samāyuktaṃ bhasma śirasi nikṣipet śivāgre caiva tu kuṃbhaṃ tu śālyopari ca vinyaset śivamantramanuddhṛtya sthāpayetkuṃbhameva ca īśānaṃ mūrdhni vinyasya mukhe tatpuruṣaṃ nyaset sadyojātaṃ nyasetpādau vinyasecchiṣyadehake śikhāyāṃ tu śikhāṃ nyasya kavacaṃ hastamadhyataḥ devasya dakṣiṇe pārśve palāśapatraṃ ca saṃyutam āsanasthā tu śiṣyāṇāṃ pūrvābhimukhameva ca pādāṃguṣṭhātsamārabhya dahedyāvacchirontakam candramaṇḍalasaṃkāśamakāraṃ cātmasaṃbhavam omityekena malaṃ yogapīṭhamadhomukham

tena plāvitamātmānamārya * ntaṃ vicintayet na tasya jāyate manyuratra śāstrasya niścayaḥ mantrādhvā ca padādhvā ca tatvādhvā bhuvanātmakam satvo rajastamaścaiva ātma trayameva ca paṃcabrahmaśivāṃgāṃ ca prāsādaṃ tu sadāśivam tattanmantramanusmṛtya yojayecchiṣyadehake tatvādhvā hṛdaye nyasya nābhau tu bhuvanātmakam pādādhvā tu punaryojya pādārabhya śirontakam aghoramapi cāṣṭau tu tatpuruṣaṃ tathaiva ca vidyeśvarāṇāmaṣṭau tu gaṇeśānāṃ catuṣṭayam evaṃ padādhvā vinyasya tatvādhvā ca punarnyaset śrotraṃ cakṣuśca jihvāśca ghrāṇaṃ tvakcaiva paṃcamaḥ śabdasparśorūparaso gandhaścāpi ca paṃcamam rāgo māyā ca vidyā ca kalā niyatimeva ca śuddhavidyā śuddhakalā sadāśivaḥ śivaḥ param bhuvanādhvā tato nyasya kalānāṃ tu śivāntakam adhastāddhṛdayādīni kalpayetkalpavittamaḥ rauravaṃ kumbhīpākaṃ ca mahārauravameva ca uṣṇasaṃtāpanaṃ caiva lohataptatapastathā dhanurnirayamādhānaṃ kṣurikānīyameva ca talaṃ ca vitalaṃ caiva nitalaṃ ca talātalam parahalokaśca bhuvarlokaḥ svarlokaśca tathaiva ca tapolokaṃ satyalokaṃ gandharvākṣayalokakam īśānaṃ devalokaṃ ca brahmalokaṃ tathaiva ca anante satyalokaṃ tu sūkṣmalokamataḥ param

ekarudrastrimūrtiśca śrīkaṇṭhaśca śikhaṇḍi ca golokaṃ śivalokaṃ ca kramameṣāṃ prakīrtitam nābhimūlātsamārabhya yāvaddhṛdayadeśakam akāraṃ mūrdhnideśe tu ākāraṃ tu lalāṭake ḷkāraṃ dakṣiṇe gaṇḍe ḹkāraṃ vāmagaṇḍake dantapaṃktidvaye nyasya aṃ aḥ ityakṣaradvayam ṭavargaṃ dakṣiṇe pāde tavargaṃ vāmapādake makāraṃ hṛdaye nyasya yakāraṃ caiva vinyaset lakāraṃ mede vinyasya śakāraṃ cādhideśake hakāraṃ prāṇamityāhu lakāraṃ meḍhrameva ca navatriṃśatkalā vipra kādipādāntavinyaset nivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyā śāntistathaiva ca tato mohau kṣudhānidrā mṛtyumāyajarā mayā dhṛtiḥ kāryā ca rātrī ca bhrāmaṇī mohinī tathā navatriṃśatkalāvyātā devadevena dhīmahi ākāśaṃ mūrdhni vinyasya paṃcatatvānkramānnyaset tatvā vaiśyaghoreṇa bhuvanādhvā puruṣeṇa tu evameva krameṇaiva śiṣyadehe nyasettataḥ hṛdaye brahmaṇaḥ proktaṃ aśvinyāṃ hastayornyaset deśikaścātmanā vipra śivastatraiva tiṣṭhati yaddravyaṃ pātraśeṣādi śivasya parameṣṭhinaḥ śivamuddiśya sarvaṃ tu vastradhānyādikāñcanam dīkṣāvidhiriti proktaṃ abhiṣekamataḥ śṛṇu iti vīratantre dīkṣāvidhiḥ navamaḥ paṭalaḥ abhiṣekaṃ kathaṃ deva tatsarvaṃ vada me prabho

sumuhūrte sulagne ca yoge ca karaṇānvite athāṃkurārpaṇaṃ kuryāllakṣaṇena samanvitam nīvāraṃ yavaśālī ca tilaṃ vaiṇavameva ca kalamāśāliyavoktaṃ vā sarṣapaṃ śimbameva vā payasā kṣālayedvipra ! prācyādīnāṃ tu bāpayet savastraṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca sakūrcaṃ sāpidhānakam bījāni vāthayettatra tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥ aṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi paṃcāśatpaṃcaviṃśatiḥ sūtrapātraṃ tu kartavyaṃ śālinā vikirettataḥ taṇḍulārdhatilairlājādarbhaiścaiva paristaret sa sūtrānsāpidhānāṃśca sa vastrānhemasaṃyutān savyādīśānaparyantaṃ sthāpayedaṣṭakumbhakān ananteśaśca sūkṣmaśca śivottamaścaikanetrakaḥ adhidevāssamākhyātā dravyāṇāṃ ca śṛṇuṣva ca vardhanīṃ gauribījena suvarṇaṃ tatra nikṣipet ārakūṭaṃ ca vipulaṃ kāṃsyaṃ pūrvaṃ nyasettataḥ haritālaṃ ca * * * * * * * canātilām rasena navakaṃ caiva vinyasettu viśeṣataḥ pālāśaṃ cādi khadiraṃ tārkṣya nyagrodhameva ca nair-ṛte sthāpite kumbhe puṣpāṇāṃ navakaṃ nyaset * * * devaśirau ca nivedyāṃ ca tu sāgare paṃkajaṃ caṃpakaṃ caiva kumudaṃ nīlotpalaṃ tu vā nandyāvartaṃ ca ghātaṃ ca navapuṣpamihocyate candanaṃ kuṃkumaṃ nīlotpalaṃ khagajānaśca vānaram saumyāyāṃ sthāpite kumbhe navabījāni vinyaset

godhūmayavamudgāṃśca sarṣapaṃ ca yathākramam lakṣmī ca sahādevī ca viṣṇukrāntiṃ trayaṃbalā vinyasettu viśeṣeṇa svasvanāmānumantrataḥ aṣṭadikṣu ca homaḥ syāllakṣaṇena samanvitam palāśakhadirāśvattha plakṣanyagrodha bilvakaiḥ samidājyacarunlājānyavaśālitilānapi yāvadvai kumbhasaṃkhyā tu tāvatsaṃkhyā tu homayet yāgasthānasya vāruṇyāṃ mahādevasya * * * * adhyayanaṃ ca kartavyaṃ caturvedaiścaturdiśi yāgasthānasya vāruṇyāṃ mahādevasya pūrvataḥ brahmairaṃgaiśca saṃyukta vyomavyā(pi)samāyutam gandhapuṣpādinā pūjya prāsādena tu mantrataḥ sā varṇaka * atrādya * nta siṃhahani bhojanam * * * * * * * * * * parvatavāhanam ācāryāya pradātavyaṃ mānaṃ ca nivedayet sagulaṃ goghṛtairyuktaṃ kadalīphalasaṃyutam ācāryaḥśiṣyasaṃyuktaṃ bhojayedvidhipūrvakam lājānta saṃyuktamapūvaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutam catuṣpathe pathe caiva dvipathekai ca vidhirave evamevakrameṇaiva abhiṣekaṃ tu kārayet vidhinā kārayedyastu tasya mṛtyurna vidyate abhiṣekaṃ mayā proktaṃ śaivācāraṃ tataḥ śṛṇu iti vīratantre ṣaṭsahasrasaṃhitāyāṃ abhiṣeko nāmadaśamaḥ paṭalaḥ kīdṛśānīha sarvaṃ tadvaktuṃ sarvamihārhasi niṣekādi sapiṇḍāntaṃ śrūyatāṃ kamalāsana

śucau deśe samaṃ kṛtvā sitānvinyasettataḥ hastamātreṇa viprendra kuryādvai sthaṇḍilaṃ tataḥ vyapoṣya kalaśaṃ tatra hastau prākṣālayettataḥ vyāhṛtyāvānayedagniṃ ṣolkālayettataḥ paristīrya tato darbhairhastamātraiścaturdiśi dakṣiṇānuttarānagrānadhastādvinyasettataḥ parīdhīnhastamātreṇa * * * * * caiva hi hṛdayena tu darbhāṃśca paridhī śikhayā saha darbhoparinyasedvipra śarāvaṃ samidhā saha prokṣayedambhasā caiva gandhapuṣpādinārcayet sthaṇḍilādakṣiṇe bhāge brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ dvedarbhāgrasamāyuktaṃ tiraḥ pavitraṃ vinyaset darbhānekera viprendra ājyādhiśravaṇaṃ bhavet sruvaṃ caiva tu darbhāṃśca mārjayeddeśikottamaḥ pariṣecanaṃ tataḥ kuryāddhṛdayena samanvitam prajāpataye svāheti sruveṇaiva tu homayet athājyabhāgaṃ hotavyaṃ agnesvāheti mantrataḥ yuktau vahādi ṣaḍbhiśca bhūyate kramaśodhanam ṛtusnātānāṃ strīṇāṃ ca ṛṭusaṃgamanaṃ śṛṇu tatra cāgnimukhaṃ kāryaṃ ūrdhvavaktraṃ caturbhujam hṛdayena tu mantreṇa hūyate kramaśodhanam evameva prakāreṇa rākṣasānāṃ tu tṛptaye ayantayonirityāśca agnayerājñayā tanu praṇītasyoṣṭha prakṣālya prokṣiṇyāmudakena tu vardhanīṃ vyāpayettatra prokṣayedambhasā tataḥ

śayane śāyayettatra daṃpatibhyāṃ samanvite viṣṇuryoniti mantreṇa mūlaliṃgaṃ bhavanti vai yonisaṃgamanaṃ kuryāduktareta sa saṃyutam somābhivardha ityuktaṃ tadasyāṃgaṃ ca tiṣyati niṣekametaduddiṣṭaṃ tava snehādviśeṣataḥ iti vīratantre ṛtu saṃgamanavidhiḥ ekādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ rohiṇī revatīhastā śravaṇaṃ cānanāyakam saumya jīvasitendūnāṃ drekkāṇāvasāṃśakam puruṣaṃ jīvanāmeti pradakṣiṇamathācaret sadyena homayettatra paṃcaviṃśatirāhutiḥ tataḥ paṃkti viprendra sakalīkṛtavigrahaḥ puruṣeṇodasparśa garbhādhānaṃ bhavanti vai iti vīratantre garbhādhānavidhiḥ dvādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ māsadvayānte kartavyaṃ sarvālaṃkāra saṃyutam guruśukrabudhajñānāṃ udayaṃ śastameva ca aṃkurāṇīha kartavyaṃ puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ agnimukhaṃ samāstīrya yukto vāhādi bhūyate garbhau agnau vidhānaṃ tu ājyāhutimathācaret nyagrodhaudumbarāśvattha palāśaṃ khādirā saha dakṣiṇe caiva nāsā ca asmai devāna mantrataḥ prācīnaṃ vāpyudīcīnaṃ cchedadarśapaṃ tataḥ dhruvāyetatyarundhatyāmiti bruvandarśayettataḥ stridharmasyā tu strīṇāṃ tu kurute nātra saṃśayaḥ tīrthānāṃ tu nakhākośa vānādireva ca antarvartnyāḥ patiḥ kuryānna prajā bhavati śruvam

iti vīratantre puṃsavanavidhiḥ trayodaśaḥ paṭalaḥ māsāccatuṣṭaye prāpte ṣaṇmāse vāpi kārayet rohiṇyāṃ caiva puṇye ca uttarā ca punarvasu sīmantonnayanaṃ kuryācchubhāsye śubhalagnake puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra agnimukhaṃ ca kārayet ājyā hutiṃ kariṣyāmi * * * * * * * * kāmayediti mantreṇa rāvikhareṇakhayet sinībalī khamantreṇa audumbareṇa homayet vanavāsī cāsīva pāśvetikeśārvanilaṃ badhyate tataḥ śeṣaṃ puṃsavanādeva kartavyaṃ syātsurottama iti vīratantre sīmantavidhiḥ caturdaśaḥ paṭalaḥ puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu viṣṇumabhyarcayettataḥ agnimukhaṃ ca saṃkalpya pūrvavallakṣaṇānvitam keśavaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ caiva govindaṃ mādhavaṃ tathā śrīdharaṃ ca hṛṣīkeśaṃ padmanābhaṃ tathaiva ca carubhojanaṃ ca kartavyaṃ yāddhṛdavasānake ājyāhutistathaivaṃ syātpuṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ aṣṭānāṃ brahmacārīṇāṃ bhojayettu viśeṣataḥ iti vīratantre viṣṇubalividhiḥ paṃcadaśaḥ paṭalaḥ abhijātaṃ kumāraṃ ca darśayed hṛdayena tu adbhyassaṃbhūtamantreṇa snāpayedvidhi pūrvakam īśānādimantrāṇāṃ mūrdhni jighratimucyate aśvābhava paraśubhaṃ japtvā caiva viśeṣataḥ brūhitāntena saṃprārcyāṃ hiraṇyena samāyutam āyurārogyamedhāvīti prāśayet

yastestenemimantreṇa mātussavyastanetreṇa mātustanaṃ dadet sa caivaṃ sthāpayitvā tu agnimukhaṃ ca kalpayet hariharaṃ ca mucca * * pa * * tathaiva ca sadyaṃ ca kamanāya aśvatthāparṇasaṃyutam * * * * * taṃ ca gau tilasarṣapahomayet āveśanāvyatra khīphalīkaraṇa homayet iti vīratantre jātakarmavidhiḥ ṣoḍaśaḥ paṭalaḥ uttarārevatīhastā śatabhiṣaṅmūlapuṣyakāḥ śraviṣṭhā conati nakṣatrātpraśastā nāmakarmaṇi īśānaṃ prājāpatye nāmakaraṇaṃ ca bhūyate mārgasīrṣe tu puṣyeśaṃ śaṃbhuriti smṛtaḥ caitre tu sthāṇu nāmaṃ ca vaiśākhe tu śivastathā śravaṇe sarvanāmaṃ tu bhādramāse triyambakam eteṣāṃ nāmamuccārya gurornāmastu vācayet nāmakaraṇaṃ ca mevaṃ tu kartavyaṃ syātsurottama iti vīratantre nāmakaraṇavidhiḥ saptadaśaḥ paṭalaḥ aśvinī somadaivatyaṃ revatī ca punarvasu citrādiruttarāścaiva śatabhiṣagrohiṇī tathā daśamasthā grahāścaiva neṣṭāssarvaprayatnataḥ īśānena tu mantreṇa svasyātreṇa juhoti ca sikataiḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā aśvatthaṃ sthāpayettataḥ svānnigrahānnāmayantīti evameva vidhīyate iti vīratantre upaniṣkramaṇavidhiraṣṭādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ ṣaṣṭhame māsi saṃprāpte annaprāśanameva ca śravaṇaṃ ca śraviṣṭhā ca hastasvātyanurādhakaḥ

puṣyaṃ caiva tu nakṣatrā praśastāścānna bhojane pūrvedyurbhojayedviprānyugmaṃ nādimukhaṃ tataḥ śubhaṃ saṃpūjayettatra citreṇacchādayettathā putra ca mūrdhni madhye tu atijighratpratipadmajaḥ paṃcabrahmasamāyuktaṃ gomaye sapta cāhutiḥ yāmāta oṣadhīsteti madhuno madhunopya ca brāhmaṇānbhojayettatra ācāryaṃ pūjayettataḥ iti vīratantre annaprāśanavidhirekonaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ * * * trīṇi saṃprokte śubhanakṣatra saṃyutam puṣyā punarvasū caiva mṛgaśīrṣakameva ca puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra kuru brāhmaṇa bhojanam eke sino'tinaktaṃ ca iti hutvā hutiṃ tataḥ īśānena tu mantreṇa paṃcāśajjuhuyāttataḥ piṇḍaṃ sākṣata saṃyuktaṃ śarāve sādhayettataḥ keśāśca secayettatra kuṃśena prokṣayettataḥ karmamadhye śikhāṃsthāpya gavāmabhimukhaṃ tataḥ kumāraṃ snāpayettatra prokṣayeddhṛdayena tu svasti vācakasaṃyuktaṃ dadyādācāryadakṣiṇām iti vīratantre caulavidhirviṃśatiḥ paṭalaḥ garbhāṣṭameṣu viprāṇāṃ rājanyaikādaśaṃ tataḥ ṣoḍaśābdāvidhiṃścaiva brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ svātī mṛgaśirāścaiva punarvasuḥ prakīrtitaḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā tu viprenda sarvaṃ cābhi pradakṣiṇam agnimukhaṃ ca saṃkalpya gandhapuṣpādinārcayet yāvatkuntantatāvatyā vastrayugmaṃ tu veṣṭayet

āpañca ācamitrasya kṛṣṇājinaṃ dadettataḥ devasyatveti savyena pakvāhutimathācaret brahmasūktena hutvā tu hutvā vyāhṛti nāmataḥ catasṝḥ palāśasamidho hotavyaṃ nīcajīvinā āditya vratapate caiva vratānāṃ vratapatepi ca agnerdakṣiṇataḥ sthāpya astreṇābhyukṣayettataḥ brahmacāryasyābhimukhaṃ sāvitrīṃ ca japettataḥ tatkāle maṇḍalaṃ likhya yathā vidhipurassaram maṇḍalasyottare bhāge kalaśāṃsthāpayettataḥ īśānādivyāhṛtibhirnavasamidhā samāyutam ācāryaṃ pūjanaṃ kuryādgobhūmīkāṃcanādibhiḥ arghyeṇaiva tu māyāṃśca dadyānmāṇavake tataḥ prātaḥ snātvā'pa ācamya sūryaśceti jalaṃ pibet agniśceti ca sānneti kāle kāle pibettataḥ añjalyodakamādāya vyāhṛtyā sūryābhimukhaṃ sṛjet * * * sahāraṃ * * * * * * * praviśet prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā sāvitryāṣṭaśataṃ japet mitrassametya nayaści siddhasandhyopasthānamācaret agniṃ caiva paristīrya pariṣecanamācaret evamevakrameṇaiva sāyaṃ prātaśca homayet kṣāraṃ ca madhumāṃsādi lavaṇa caiva varjayet evameva krameṇaiva balaṃ prāyeṇa naktakam dve striyau samalaṃkṛtya śraddhā medhā prayāmiti evameva kramaṃ kuryādāyuṣyaṃ balamāpnuyāt agnimukhaṃ ca saṃkalpya sruksruve ceti mantrataḥ

catasrasamidhā caiva pūrvavaddhūpayettataḥ palāśamūle daṇḍaṃ ca ajinaṃ mauñjīmaṇi vā sakhā apa ācamya viprendra jayādiṃ hūyate tataḥ brāhmaṇānbhojayettatra śivadīkṣāsamanvitān iti vīratantre upanayanavidhiḥ ekaviṃśatiḥ paṭalaḥ nadītaṭāke gatvā tu navarṣīṃstarpayettataḥ agnimukhaṃ ca saṃkalpya ṛṣīṇāṃ ca hūyate punaḥ pariṣecanaṃ kṛtvā yathā vidhi ca hūyate sahasrasamidhāṃ ca hūyate kramaśastataḥ iti vīratantre upākarmavidhiḥ dvāviṃśati paṭalaḥ snātvā tu śucivāsāśca hutvā vai śukriyāvṛtaḥ gātraṃ ca veṣṭhakaṃ kuryānnavavastreṇa deśikaḥ brāhmaṇānbhojayettatra śivabhaktisamanvitān iti vīratantre śukriyavratavidhistrayoviṃśatiḥ paṭalaḥ svātīmūlānurādhā * * * * * * * stathā te nakṣa(trā)ṇi suraśreṣṭha saptame grahavarjitam mauñjyā * * * * * * brahmacārikare dadet kṛṣṇakeśā * * * * * * roma tathaiva ca snātakasya vrataṃ caiva hutvā caiva viśeṣataḥ ājyāhutiṃ mayāmaṃ tu sarvāneva hunettataḥ evaṃ mantramanusmṛtya bilvaṃ caiva tu nikṣipet prativeśānimantreṇa udaraṃ co'bhimantrayet pūrvasyāṃ diśi śāstreṇa diva * taṃ ca vandayet samāvartana vṛddhyādi vyāhṛtyājyena hūyate pāṇigrahaṇa pra * * tīryā cairvā vrīhistulāḥ

sūryāya prajāpataye prātaścaiva hūyate ayāścāgneti mantreṇa hotavyaṃ dīrghajīvinām iti vīratantre samāvartanavidhiścaturviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ svātīmūlānurādhā ca maghā mṛgaśirastathā kanyāyāṃ mithune caiva tulāyāṃ mṛgakumbhayoḥ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannāṃ kanyāṃ caiva parigrahet udaṅmukhaṃ samabhyarcya puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ viśvetveti hi mantreṇa brahmansāmeti mastakam snāto vastradharo bhūtvā vapurjāta hirarpitam piturutsaṃgamāviśya tasya puruṣaṃ tu mantrakam puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra dakṣiṇe pati tiṣṭhati tābhyāṃ hūsasaṃbhūya hantalāśca viśeṣataḥ sāvitraṃ ca tato datvāpahāṃsi śirasi nikṣipet darbhāntanmūlasaṃyuktānsaptapaṃcāni nikṣipet sakhā saptapadaṃ caiva viśeṣa * * lpe tasya paścimatodiśi hṛdayeneti mantreṇa hṛdayaṃ sparśayettataḥ agneruttarataḥ sthānaṃ sthāpayettu viśeṣataḥ hastaṃ prakṣālayettatra lājānhastau tu pūrayet punaḥ patnīti mantreṇa hṛdayena samāyutam jayādimabhyadhānaṃ ca rāṣṭrabhṛccaiva hūyate hutvānte tu yadasyeti sviṣṭa kṛya caiva hūyate arundhatīṃ ca dṛśyeta dhruvosīti mantrataḥ catubhirmaṃgalībhiśca śayanaṃ kalpayettataḥ caturthadivase caiva agnimukhaṃ ca hūyate jayādirabhyadhānaṃ ca rātriśca kramāddhute

śivaṃ pradadyāddaṃpatyobījaścaiva tu rāhayet guhye vāmena saṃspṛśya ṛtugamanaṃ ca sehate grāmātprāgi prayātu udumbaraṃ ca dṛśyate jānudaghnajale sthitvā vastre * * myāṃśca grāhayet daśamehani viprendra agnimukhaṃ ca kalpayet daśabaliṃ tataḥ kuryādgṛhaṃ prāpya ca deśikaḥ iti vīratantre vivāhavidhiḥ paṃcaviṃśatiḥ paṭalaḥ udumbareṇa śākhā ca apte vidhinā mārjayet yamāya dahanapatayetyasadeti vinikṣipet citāya pretaṃ vinyasya prokṣayeddhṛdayena tu vātāste pasatīsvīti navāṃ caiva tu kārayet asmāttvamabhijāto sītyagniṃvikṣipya deśikaḥ śarāvaṃ pāṣāṇasaṃyuktaṃ dvāravāme vinikṣipet ekādaśyāmekāddiṣṭasthānamenaiva kārayet śūdrādinā darśayitvā tu savarṇa saṃskārameva ca astreṇa gavā sarpādīn kriyāhīnā tathaiva ca pālāśapatraistriśikhai raṃgapratyaṃgakalpanam vāsasā upavātena karṇasūktaṃ japettataḥ daśarātraṃ baliṃ kṛtvā saptāhaṃ pūrvavatkṛtam ekādaśāhe tatraiva ekoddiṣṭaṃ ca kārayet iti vīratantre tṛṇasaṃskāravidhiḥ saptaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā tu viprendra aghoreṇa tu mantrataḥ nikṣipecchavamevaṃ tu prokṣayetpuruṣeṇa tu sajitapītātramamayānti maraṇe ghanaṃ bhavet mama putraṃ ca bālaṃ vai jīvitaṃ snāpayettataḥ

paṃcagavyena saṃprokṣya tatpuruṣeṇa tu mantrataḥ prāṇāpānāya vyānāya udānāya samānāya svāhanteti kāṣṭhe pretaṃ samāropya vidhinā ca dahettataḥ sarvāsāṃ ca kriyāṇāṃ tu pūrvavatkārayettataḥ iti vīratantre gabhiṇīsaṃskāra vidhiraṣṭāviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ aṣṭamī cāpare pakṣe caturdarśyāmathāpi vā pūrvedyuścaiva śaivāśca kṣaṇaṃ kurvanti deśikāḥ pitṝṇāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ caiva pādaprakṣālanaṃ kuru agnimukhaṃ ca kṛtvā tu pitṝṃścaiva pitāmaha odanaṃ caivāpūpāṃśca pakvāhutimathācaret vastraiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca mālyaiḥ prapūjayet agnerdakṣiṇatobhāge darbhenaikena vinyaset odanaṃ jalasaṃyuktaṃ ūrjaṃ vahanti dāpayet prāyaścittāni hūyante hūyatāṃ kramaśodhunā iti vīratantre aṣṭakāvidhirekonatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ caturthe dvādaśe māse sa piṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kuru āyāntu pitara iti āvāhya pitṛpitāmahān pitṝṇāṃ rudradevānāṃ svāheti juhuyāttataḥ śanno yavosīti ātma * * mahantureva ca vāmasya tvitāvaśceti rasanamucettataḥ gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpairdīpaiścaiva samāyutam apahanteti mantreṇa vikirettatra deśikaḥ ye divyā āpa ityarghyaṃ * * * tatra vai yanme māteti mantreṇa saptājyāhutimeva ca odanaṃ tilasaṃyuktaṃ dadhi ca madhusaṃyutam

pṛthivyādyena mantreṇa dadyātpitṛpitāmahān udakaṃ vinyasettatra madhumānī ca yantribhiḥ pradakṣiṇa namaskāraṃ kṛtvā caiva tu deśikaḥ ādiśaivānuśaivāṃśca * * * * * sarvaśaḥ devoktena ca mantreṇa caivācāraṃ samācaret iti vīratantre sapiṇḍīkaraṇavidhiḥ triṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ hṛdayena tu mantreṇaṃ mahecaivaktavantataḥ śokācordhva * * * * dīpotsavaṃ prakalpayet dvinetraṃ caturbhujaṃ caiva upavītasamanvitam kuṇḍalaiḥ karṇikairhāraiḥ kaṭisūtrārabandhanaiḥ * * * * * * namaskāraśaivānprakāśayet śaivānsaṃbhojanaṃ yogyāndadyācchaktyā tu dakṣiṇām iti vīratantre avāntaraśaivācāravidhiḥ ekatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ śucau deśe samaṃ kṛtvā gomayenopalepayet sa sūtrānsāpidhānāṃśca sa hiraṇyānsavastrakān ādityaṃ madhyame sthāpya śukraṃ pūrve tu vinyaset madhyādīśānaparyantaṃ sthāpayetkalaśānnava ketuṃ caiva tu vāyavyāṃ uttare ca bṛhaspatim sanasve ca svaināmena saṃyuktaṃ hṛdayena samanvitam bilvapatraṃ śirīṣaṃ ca pūrvā caiva palāśakam bakulākasya patraṃ ca aśvatthodumbaraṃ tathā gandhapuṣpādinā'bhyarcya pūrvedyuradhivāsayet āpohiṣṭhāmayo caiva tānsamandīya eva ca evamabhyarcya vidhivad grahapīḍāṃ vyapohya ca sarve doṣā vinaśyanti evameva samācaret

ācāryaṃ pūjayettatra vastradhānyādikāñcanaiḥ iti vīratantre grahābhiṣekavidhiḥ dvātriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ etatsarvaṃ samāsena bhagavanvaktumarhasi tatsarvamakhilaṃ (vipra pra) vakṣye caturānana āvāhanī ca mudrā ca nirvīramudrā ca paṃcabrahmasya mudrikā mudrā ca śodhanī kalyāśaṃ tathā dhanurbāṇaṃ ca paṇḍā ca vajramudrā tathaiva ca kaniṣṭhikānāmikā tu madhyamāṃguli saṃsthitaḥ vayetsadā | surabhimudrābhavedeṣā sarvāriṣṭavināśinī anāmikāsaśuddhi sarveṣya tarjanīnaṃ ca veṣṭayet liṃgamudrā bhavedeṣā sarvakāmārthasādhanī surāje mukulākāramudreyaṃ mukulī bhavet ubhau hastau kaniṣṭhau ca tayoraṃguṣṭha śirasi tarjanyaṃkuñcitau tathā | aṃguṣṭhamadhyamādīni śeṣā ṛjvā sthitāniti ubhau hastau kaniṣṭhau ca aṃguṣṭhāṃgaṃ tu mūlake dvau hastau muṣṭisaṃbadhvā ekaikena tu tā yet prasārya dakṣiṇe haste aṃguṣṭhamūrdhvasaṃyutam prasāryadakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ aṃguṣṭhaṃ cordhvasaṃyutam dvau hastau tu prasāryātha aṃguṣṭhaṃ mūrdhni saṃsthitam uttānau tu karau kṛtvā anāmikādyau prasārayet dvau hastau maṇibandhaṃ tu madhyamau dvau prasārayet dvau hastau maṇibandhaṃ tu tarjanīṃ dvau prasārayet pūrvavaddhasta saṃyuktau prasāryātha kaniṣṭhikau dvau hastau ca prasāryātha protaṃ kṛtvā parasparam ubhau hastau saṃprasārya nāmikā caiva madhyamau kaniṣṭhikāyā mūle tu aṃguṣṭhāgraṃ nidhāpayet

śiro mudrā bhavedeṣā sarvakāmārthasādhinī śeṣātparasparau kṛtya śikhā mudrā iti smṛtāḥ śeṣānparasparaṃ kṛtvā kavaceyaṃ prakīrtitam tarjanī madhyamā caiva adhomukhaṃ tu kārayet dvau hastau ca prasāryātha kaniṣṭhāṃguṣṭhatānvite hastau tu maṇibandhaṃ syāddhṛdaye saṃsthitāni tu uttānau tu karau kṛtvā maṇibandhaṃ tu kārayet vāmāṃguṣṭhasya madhyordhve dakṣiṇāṃguṣṭhaṃ vinyaset kalaśamudrā bhavedeṣā snānakāle prayojayet mukulīkṛta hastau dvau padmamudrā iti smṛtāḥ śūlamudrā bhavedeṣā sarvaśatruvimardinī karapṛṣṭadvayaṃ bhūyātsamāśliṣṭhau parasparam uttānau ca karau kṛtvā tarjanī dvau ca tiṣṭhati uttānau tu karau kṛtvā ūrdhvahastaṃ tu kārayet pāśamudrābhavedeṣā sarvaśatruvimardanā śeṣāṃ muṣṭiṃ ca saṃbadhvā mukulīyaṃ kṛśasya tu dakṣiṇaṃ karṇamūle tu dhanurmudrā bhavanti vai śeṣā muṣṭiṃ ca saṃbadhvā śaramudrā bhavanti vai caṃcalaṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvā ghaṇṭamudrā tathaiva ca ubhau parasparaṃ hastau vajramudrā bhavanti vai mudrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ naivedyaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṇu iti vīratantre mudrālakṣaṇavidhistrayastriṃśatpaṭalaḥ naivedyasya vidhānaṃ kiṃ brūhi me parameśvara ! tatsarvama * * * vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana tāvadyugasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate

kṛsarānna sahasrebhyo gauḍa?nnaṃ ca viśiṣyate evameva krameṇaiva sahasra guṇitaṃ phalam kṛṣṇaśālī ca nīvāraṃ veṇugodhūmameva ca taṇḍulārdhaṃ gṛhītavyaṃ uttamaṃ ca vinirdiśet adhamaṃ pakṣināmaṃ ca tasmāttānparivarjayet hṛdaye prokṣayetsarvaśāliṃ netreṇa vinyaset uttamaṃ dvijanārībhiḥ kṣatraviṭkanyayā tataḥ ulūkhalvo'thamṛtkuṇḍe hṛdayenaiva nikṣipet śūrpaṃ vai viṣṇudaivatyaṃ ityete adhidevatāḥ śatadvayaṃ paṃcaviṃśati vrīhibhiśśuktirucyate aṃjaliṃ caiva viprendra prasthaṃ caiva tathaiva ca śivaṃ ca droṇakaṃ caiva khārī caiva tathaiva ca pātrasaṃkhyā bhavettatra āḍhakaṃ ca ekaikaṃ dviguṇaṃ prasthaṃ kuḍavasaṃyuktaṃ piśācānāṃ baliṃ bhavet naivedyaṃ navadhā caiva kalpayetkalpavittamaḥ śivaṃ ceva tu vijñeyaṃ madhyamatrayamucyate madhyamatrayamevoktaṃ uttamaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvatha bhāratrayaṃ ca viprendra uttamatrayamucyate na doṣāntaṇḍulāngrāhya nirvāpanaṃ tu kārayet tribhirvākṣālayitvā tu jalamardhādhikaṃ bhavet agniṃ prajālayettatra agnibījena deśikaḥ kṛmikoṭarasaṃyuktaṃ pipīlikādivarjitam atipakvamapakvaṃ ca dhūmragandhaṃ ca śītalam bāhyaśuddhikramaṃ kuryāttripuṇṭraṃ kārayeddiśi upadaṃśaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana

bṛhatīdvayaṃ ca kuṣmāṇḍaṃ bṛhanmudgaṃ cālābunī śiśukaṃ bṛhatkandaṃ sāraṇasya tu kandakam rājamāṣāḍhakī caiva mudgaśimbaṃ kulasthakam ete vakṣopadaṃśā sā kāravallī tathaiva ca evameva kramaṃ kuryādyathā lābhe ca kārayet taṇḍulāścaiva dvitriṃśadupadaṃśamihocyate sūpaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣeṇa * * * piṣṭa saṃyutam panasena samāyuktaṃ sūpamājyaṃ nivedayet pūgīphaladvayaṃ caiva aṣṭapatrasamāyutam mātuluṃga phalādyāsu pakvādīni nivedayet ekasthāne tu viprendra nidhāya sakalaṃ tataḥ gandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca dīpaiścaiva supūjayet sthalikā caiva sauvarṇaṃ rajataṃ kāṃsyameva ca athavā kadalīpatraṃ vastropari nyasettataḥ vāmadevena mantreṇa pātre cānnaṃ kṣipettataḥ caruṇāṃ tu caturbhāgaṃ dvibhāgaṃ ca nivedayet hṛdayena tu mantreṇa dadyātpānīyameva ca prokṣayedambhasā caiva tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥ agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kuryācchāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā pāyasānnakramaṃ vakṣye mudgaṃ vai taṇḍulārdhakam gulānnaṃ vakṣyate vipra kṣīraṃ vai taṇḍulārdhakam gulānnamiti vijñeyaṃ kṛsarānnaṃ tataḥ śṛṇu tilārdhaṃ prakṣipedājyaṃ kṛsarānnamihocyate nālikeraphalairyuktaṃ mudgānnaṃ saṃprakīrtitam āloḍhya pācitaṃ hyetatkadalī bṛhatīdvayam

tritripādaṃ ca ghaṭikāmudhamatra ya śeṣataḥ kālaṃ yāmasamāyuktaṃ śrībalyaṃ tu ta kārayet visarjayettu nirmālyaṃ caṇḍeśāya nivedayet nirmālya laṃghanāddānāttatkṣaṇānnarakaṃ vrajet bhūmau vā khānayettatra agninā dasameva ca sakalānāṃ nivedyaṃ tu śūdrādīnāṃ tu bhojanam umādevyāśca naivedyaṃ sarveṣāṃ caiva bhojanam abhojyaṃ sūryabhaktānāṃ jyeṣṭhā caiva sarasvatī itareṣāṃ tu naivedyaṃ na bhojyaṃ sarvadehinām pūrvadvāre'tha dakṣiṇye paścimadvārameva vā dvārabhedeṣu bhedānāṃ pūjābhedaṃ na vidyate anyathā kārayedyastu abhicārāyamūca vahi evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ sarvapāpādvimucyate kulaikaviṃśamuttārya śivalokamavāpnuyāt iti vīratantre naivedyavidhiścatustriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ etatsarvaṃ samāsena bhagavanvaktumarhasi tatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana grāmātprācīmudīcīṃ vā gatvācāryo viśeṣataḥ navatābhimukhasthaṃ tu malaṃ caiva visarjayet ūṣaraṃ caiva viprenda śivakṣetra samīpataḥ śirovaguṇṭhanaṃ kṛtvā maunena tu visarjayet vāme śiśnaṃ gṛhītvā tu karṇayajñopavītakam śuddhasnānajalaṃ prāpya ācamettu yathāvidhi paṃcabhiḥ kṣālayedvāmaṃ karayoḥ saptamṛttikā āmalīphalamātreṇa pādau prakṣālayettataḥ

mṛtpiṇḍaṃ ca tridhā kṛtvā hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ dakṣiṇe ghoramantreṇa uttare vāmamantrataḥ dakṣiṇe ghoramantreṇa uttare vāmamantrataḥ dakṣiṇena hṛdā caiva śivadīkṣāṃ tu kalpayet tailaṃ cāmalakāyuktaṃ aṃgamālipya sarvaśaḥ mārjayecchiramīśānaṃ puruṣeṇa mukhaṃ tataḥ pādayossadyamantreṇa mārjayeddeśikottamaḥ kālamudrāṃ tu badhvā tu prāsādenābhiṣiṃcayet nābhimātrodake sthitvā āca(myaca) vidhānataḥ aṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ ca cakṣuṣīsamupa spṛśet aṃguṣṭhatarjanībhyāṃ tu bāhuṃ caiva spṛśettataḥ dakṣiṇena tu hastena udakaṃ grāhayettataḥ īśānenāgniśceti sāyāhneti jalaṃ pibet sāvitrīṃ ca bhavettatra sūryodakaṃ dadet ṛṣīṇāṃ dāpayettatra aghoreṇa tu mantrataḥ prāsādena samāyuktaṃ sāvitrīṃ ca śatāṣṭakam japedvai deśikastatra dhautavastraṃ ca veṣṭayet tīre samatalaṃ kṛtvā hastamātreṇa lepayet pādyamācamanaṃ caiva arghyaṃ tasya nivedayet ārṣeṇa tu tīthaina ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva tarpayet vimānaṃ prāviśettatra puṣpahastau vicakṣaṇaḥ praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau arcayettu kavāṭakam pūjayedvidhinā vipra kavāṭasthāṃstu devatān evaṃ yaḥ kurute nityaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate bhojane devakārye ca maunaṃ ṣaṭsu vidhīyate

āgneyaṃ divyamevaṃ tu vāyavyaṃ mānasaṃ smṛtam āgneyaṃ bhasmanā snānaṃ sā pathāvarjayettataḥ mantrairmānasamityuktaṃ paṃcasnānaṃ vidhīyate snānamevaṃ mayā proktaṃ sarvakāmārthasādhanam iti vīratantre śaucācamana snānavidhiḥ paṃcatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ etatsarvaṃ samāsena brūhi me parameśvara bhāsatvānmanuṣyāṇāṃ bhāsatvabhasya ci anyaiduṣṭamṛgairduṣṭairbhasmasnānena naśyati tṛtīyaṃ śaivamityuktaṃ caturthaṃ bhogadaṃ bhavet nandā bhadrā ca surabhiḥ suśīlā sumanaṃ tathā uttamaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ tu madhyamaṃ raktameva ca vikaṭāṃgaśca viprendra aṃgahīnaṃ ca varjayet kapilā gomayaṃ caiva uttamottamamucyate ākāśo grāhayedaṃgairdarbhe tatpauṣṭikaṃ bhavet paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ (ca) śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ piṇḍaṃ kṛtvā tu hṛdayaṃ śikhāmantreṇa deśikaḥ sadyo jātena mantreṇa grāhayet (ca) viśeṣataḥ adhamaṃ tāmrapātraṃ syādalābhe mṛṇmayaṃ bhavet etadāgneyamityuktaṃ mārutaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvatha mārutākhyamiti proktaṃ śaivalakṣaṇamucyate bhogadaṃ ca pravakṣyāmi kulālānāṃ dahepyataḥ catvāri bheda saṃyuktaṃ bhasmanā ca viśeṣataḥ vyoma vyāpi samāyuktaṃ brahmamaṃgena saṃyutam mukhaṃ tatpuruṣeṇaiva svītau caiva kaṭī tathā sadyo jātena mantreṇa uddhūlayedviśeṣataḥ

tripuṇṭraṃ kārayettatra nṛpāṇāṃ vaiśyameva ca madhyahātprakṛjalairyuktaṃ toyaṃ tamana varjayet karṇau ca cakṣuṣī caiva nāsikau cāsya eva ca hṛdi nābhau ca meḍhre ca puyūruku ca jānunī dvātriṃśatsthānamevoktaṃ bhasmanā lepayettataḥ hṛdaye jaṭhare caiva nābhau pārśve tu pṛṣṭhake mūrdhni caiva lalāṭe ca kaṇṭhe bāhu tathaiva ca aṣṭasthāneṣu viprendra vinyasedbhasmameva ca vasundharā ca pitarau adhidevāḥ prakīrtitāḥ brāhmaṇādīnāṃ varṇānāṃ vistārasi vivistaraṃ bhavet jñānāsūcandanaṃ lipya vaiśyārthaṃ pūrṇameva ca deśikānāṃ tu sarveṣāmanāmikā madhyamatarjanī dusvapne durjanasparśe āturāṇāṃ tu sarvataḥ bhojane tuṣakeśaṃ ca citāri nakhānyapi dadhikṣīra ghṛtetaila miśrite tu viśeṣataḥ pūrvāhne bhojanekāle gamane'pi tathaiva ca evameva krameṇaiva bhasma dadhyāttu bhaktitaḥ bhasmasnānaṃ mayā proktaṃ mantranyāsaṃ śṛṇuṣvatha iti vīratantre bhasmasnānavidhiḥ ṣaṭtriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ mantranyāsaṃ kathaṃ deva tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho tavasnehādahaṃ vakṣye śrūyatāṃ kamalāsana maṇḍapaṃ caiva viprendra gomayenānulepayet kūrcaṃ caiva tu nikṣipya pūrvanā(tha) vidhipūrvakam sadyena prokṣayettatra kuśakūrcena vāmataḥ ghṛtāśikhāgre dvādaśāṃgulye śivatatvaṃ vicintayet

trikoṇamaṇḍale vidyādadvitīyaṃ vicintayet bhasmabhūtaḥ śivaṃ dhyātvā amṛtaṃ plāvanaṃ kuru śvetapadmo pariṣṭāttu candrabimbamadhomukham cintayedamṛtaṃ toyaṃ suṣumnābhinnamastakam mṛtyunāśanamevaṃ tu iti śāstrasya niścayaḥ recakaṃ pūrakaṃ caiva kumbhakaṃ trividhaṃ matam āpūrṇakumbhavattiṣṭhedacalasya tu kumbhakam hastābhyāṃ saṃspṛśetpūrvaṃ kādipādāntameva ca divi dikṣu ca dātavyaṃ ūrdhvādhaścaiva vinyaset galāddve tejasaṃśuddhi lalāṭādvāyu śudhyati prathamaṃ sṛṣṭinyāsaṃ tu sthitinyāsaṃ dvitīyakam gṛhasthaḥ sṛṣṭimārgeṇa brahmacārī sthitirbhavet aṃguṣṭhādi kaniṣṭhāntaṃ sṛṣṭinyāsamudāhṛtam īśānaṃ mūrdhni vinyasya mukhe tatpuruṣaṃ nyaset sadyojāte nyasetpādau punaraṃgāni vinyaset brahmāṇaṃ mūrdhni vinyasya lalāṭe viṣṇurucyate sarasvatīṃ tu vaśvāre hṛdaye īśvaraṃ tathā subrahmaṇyasya liṃge ca pārśvayorambikā tathā akāraṃ mūrdhni vinyasya ākāraṃ tu lalāṭake ukāraṃ dakṣiṇe nāse ūkāraṃ vāmanāsike ḷkāraṃ dakṣiṇe gaṇḍe ḹkāraṃ vāmagaṇḍake dantapaṃktidvaye nyasya aṃaḥ parikīrtitau ṭavargaṃ dakṣiṇe pāde tavargaṃ vāmapādake makāraṃ hṛdaye nyasya yakāraṃ tvaci vinyaset vakāraṃ medodeśe tu śakāraṃ cāsthideśake

hakāraṃ prāṇa ityāhuḥ kṣakāraṃ meḍhrameva ca sṛṣṭinyāsamiti proktaṃ nyāsaṃ sthitimataḥ śṛṇu īśānaṃ madhyame caiva anāmikena puruṣaṃ nyaset sadyojātaṃ tu tarjanyāṃ vinyasetpṛṣṭhameva ca śikhāṃ kaniṣṭhike nyasya kavacāṃguṣṭhake nyaset evaṃ ṣaḍaṃgaṃ vinyasya vidyeśānvinyasettataḥ śivottamaṃ mukhe nyasya ekanetraṃ tu karṇayoḥ liṃge śrīkaṇṭhamevoktaṃ śikhaṇḍiṃ pādayornyaset śikhāyāṃ tu śikhāṃ nyasya kavacaṃ stanamadhyataḥ hastau tu maṇibandhaṃ tu īśabrahmāṇimeva ca sadyojātaṃ kaniṣṭhe tu vāmadevena nāmikā īśamaṃguṣṭhake nyasya ṣaḍaṃgānvinyasettataḥ śikhāmantraṃ tu madhyaṃ syāt kavacaṃ pādayoḥ sadyamantreṇa kukṣau vāmaṃ nyasettataḥ īśānaṃ mūrdhni vinyasya pādayorhṛdayaṃ nyaset kavacaṃ hṛdaye nyasya netraṃ bāhudvayornyaset indraṃ tu pādayornyasya meḍhre tu pāvake nyaset bāhvau varuṇadaivatyaṃ kaṇṭhe vāyuriti smṛtaḥ evameva krame jñātvā vinyaseddeśikastathā sṛṣṭau sthitiṃ ca saṃhāra nyāsaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ gandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca pādyaiśca svadehaṃ pūjayeddhṛdā pūrve tu dvārapālaṃ tu nandikālau tathaiva ca paścimadvārapālau tu bhṛṃgiṭirvijayastathā nandinaṃ dakṣiṇe sthāpya śyāmavarṇasamanvitam kālaṃ kuṃkumavarṇāmaṃ uttare tu pratiṣṭhitam

daṇḍiṃ pūrve tu vinyasya indragopasya saṃnibham muṇḍī tu paścime nyasya śuddhasphaṭikasaṃnibham bhṛṃgiṭiṃ dakṣiṇe sthāpya mayūragrīvasaṃnibham vijayaṃ cottare sthāpya raktavarṇa samāyutam anantaṃ paścime sthāpya kanakābhaṃ tathaiva ca paśupatiṃ pūrvataḥ sthāpya nīlarūpasamanvitam evameva kramaiḥ sthāpya etairmantraiśca pūjayet sarve ṛjvāgatāḥ sthityā krūradṛṣṭibhayāvahāḥ nānābharaṇasaṃyuktā ghorabhayāvahāḥ evameva krameṇaiva pūjayeddeśikassadā iti vīratantre mantranyāsaḥ saptatriṃśatpaṭalaḥ śivārcanaṃ kathaṃ deva tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho nārudraḥ saṃsmaredrudraṃ nārudro rudramarcayet sarvapāpaharaṃ caiva sarvatīrthaphalaṃ bhavet dīkṣitaścāpi yo vipro bhṛtyarthaṃ na prapūjayet sandhisvadharmānuṣṭhānaṃ na doṣāya prakalpayet tatkāle vāpyakāle vā evameva krameṇa tu tṛtīyaṃ dravyaśuddhistu caturthaṃ liṃgaśodhanam pūrvoktena vidhānena ātmaśuddhiṃ ca kārayet huṃkāreṇa samāyuktaṃ phaṭkāreṇa samāyutam gomayenopa lipyātha prokṣayed hṛdayena tu arghyapātraṃ puṣpapātraṃ dhūpadīpasya pātrakam hṛdena kṣālayitvā tu astreṇa śodhayettataḥ paṃcabrahmeṇa mantreṇa udakaṃ secayettataḥ dravyāṇi prokṣayettatra hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ

hṛdayenaiva mantreṇa ghaṇṭāṃ caiva tu tāḍayet pūjāparyaṣitānāṃ tu hṛdayena visarjayet apanīya ca nirmālyaṃ caṇḍeśāya pradāpayet liṃgaṃ prakṣālayettatra hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ evamevakrameṇaiva liṃgaśuddhimathācaret paṃcabrahmaśivāṃgaiśca prāsādena samanvitam gaṇeśānlokapālāṃśca lokapālāstrameva ca mantraśuddhirbhavedevaṃ kārayeddeśikottamaḥ āsanaṃ kalpayedvidvān anantāntānyathākramam siṃhāsanaṃ tṛtīyaṃ syād yogāsanaṃ caturthakam śaktyakṣarasamāyuktaṃ navamāṃkurasaṃyutam madhye nālasamāyuktaṃ paṃcāśatkarṇikāyutam anantaṃ pūrvato bhāge vāsukiṃ cāgnigocare śaṃkhapālaṃ ca vāruṇyāṃ gulike vāyugocare anantāsanaṃ tu pradadyāt kūrmasyopari saṃśritāḥ ādhāraṃ cāpyate vipra devānāṃ ca śṛṇuṣvatha ekarudrastrimūrtiśca śrīkaṇṭhaśca śikhaṇḍikaḥ śeṣaścaiva tu nāgendrā gulikāśca caturdiśi caturaśraṃ tu yogaṃ syāt śeṣasyopari vinyaset devadattadhanaṃjayau madhyame ca vikīryate praṇavaṃ madhyadeśe tu ākāraṃ pūrvadeśake adhaścāthordhvacchadanaṃ yogāsanamiti smṛtam āgneyyāṃ dharma vinyasya nair-ṛtyāṃ jñānameva ca catuṣkoṇe mahāsiṃhaṃ āsanaṃ pādanirmitam adharmaṃ pūrvato bhāge ajñānaṃ dakṣiṇe tathā

kṛṣṇavarṇa samāyuktaṃ ilikāṃ tatra vinyaset mahādikṣu nyasedenaṃ madhyapādastu keśavaḥ evaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ proktaṃ padmāsanamathocyate tejorūpaṃ tu dakṣiṇyāṃ vāyurūpaṃ tu nair-ṛte satvaṃ vāyavyake nyasya rajovinyasya somake tatvavarṇasamāyuktaṃ ādhāraṃ cocyate mayā aghoraṃ dalamevāhu statpuruṣaṃ guhyadeśake devatāḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi kālīṃ pūrve tu vinyaset balavikaraṇīṃ nair-ṛtyāṃ vāmāṃ paścimato nyaset sarvabhūtadamanīmīśānye manonmanīṃ tu madhyame caturvedasvarūpaṃ tu vinyased vyāghracarmavat ambikāṃ pūrvataḥ sthāpya gaṇāmbikāṃ ca dakṣiṇe vimalāsanamidaṃ proktaṃ idamanyacchṛṇuṣvatha vimalamarcaneṣūktaṃ bhojyāsanaṃ tu yogataḥ gandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca dīpaiścaiva tu pūjayet satvaṃ rajastamaścaiva uparyupari vinyaset candrabimbaṃ nyasetpaścā ātmānaṃ cāntarātmakam dakṣiṇe hyātmatatvaṃ tu vidyātatvaṃ tu cottare evaṃ nyastvā tu vidhivacchivaṃ saṃpūjayettataḥ tryakṣaṃ daśabhujaṃ caiva candrārdhakṛtaśekharam paṃcavaktraṃ ca deveśaṃ paṃcamūrdhasamanvitam makuṭaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ caiva keyūrakaṭakaṃ tataḥ divyāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ divyagandhānulepitam vāmāṃkuśaṃ caivāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ nāgaṃ ca vahni ca evaṃ sadāśivaṃ dhyātvā sarvalokasukhāvaham

sthāpayedvāmadevena aghoreṇa nirodhayet pūrve dvāragehe tu dakṣiṇe vā viśeṣataḥ niṣkale sakalaṃ dhyātvā āsanaṃ caiva kalpayet dvārabhedeṣubhedānāṃ pūjābhedaṃ na vidyate aghoraṃ hṛdaye nyasya guhye vāmaṃ prakalpayet hṛdaye hṛdayaṃ nyasya śiraśśirasi vinyaset astraṃ hastapradeśe tu netraṃ netreṣu vinyaset pādyaṃ pādau pradātavyamarghyaṃ śirasi vinyaset uśīraṃ candanopetaṃ pādyadravyamudāhṛtam ācamanīyamiti proktaṃ mukhe dadyādviśeṣataḥ tilaissiddhārthakaiścaiva arghyamaṣṭāṃgamucyate kṣurikāṃ kalpayettatra dakṣiṇekadireva ca śivasya dakṣiṇe pārśve nyasetpāśupatāstrakam evaṃ nyasya vidhānena paścādarcanamārabhet ādityodayapūrve tu paṃcasnānaṃ tu kārayet paṃcabrahmaṣaḍaṃgaiśca vyomavyāpi japettataḥ jalabhāṇḍe vinikṣipya abhiṣekaṃ tu kārayet dvātriṃśadvā catustriṃśatpaṃcāśatpaṃcaviṃśatiḥ āḍhakena tu saṃpūrṇaṃ kumbhalakṣaṇamucyate tāmraṃ vā mṛṇmayaṃ vāpi abhiṣekaṃ tu kalpayet nālikerasya salilaṃ ikṣukāṇḍasamanvitam nṛttageyasamāyuktaṃ stotraśabdasamāyutam tasyānte pūjako vipra ācamanīyaṃ tu kārayet niryāsaṃ triphalaṃ caiva uśīraṃ ca viśeṣataḥ hṛdayena tu gandhaṃ syād vastraṃ vāmena dāpayet

nānāvidhaiśca puṣpaiśca pūjayetparameśvaram pīṭhapūjā prakartavyā lakṣaṇena samanvitā vistāraṃ tāvadevasyānmṛdenaiva tu lepayet puṣpairnānāvidhairyuktaṃ nālikerasya pātrakam sarvadvayaṃ ca pīṭhaṃ ca gopuraṃ maṇḍapaṃ tathā darpaṇaṃ pūrṇakumbhaṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ yugmacāmaram vajraṃ śaktiṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃpāśaṃ tathāṃkuśam dinaṃ prati nyasedekaṃ triṃśaddināntameva ca pīṭhapūjāṃ ca viprenda hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ māse māse prakartavyaṃ evameva punaḥ punaḥ dhūpaṃ caiva tu viprendra dhūpapātraṃ viśeṣataḥ ekabhāgaṃ tu karpūraṃ lohaṃ caiva catuṣṭayam madhunā secayeddhūpaṃ pātre tu pari nikṣipet śrīphalaṃ cājyasaṃmiśraṃ dhūpaṃ dadyādviśeṣataḥ dakṣiṇe dhūpapātraṃ tu hṛdayena tu dāpayet prokṣayedambhasā caiva dīpaṃ dadyāttu sadyataḥ rakṣādīpaṃ tu kartavyaṃ tatkāle tu viśeṣataḥ taddīpaṃ balipīṭhe tu strībhiścaiva tu dhārayet āḍhakaṃ vā śivaṃ vāpi droṇaṃ vā taṇḍulaṃ pacet ājyena dadhisaṃyuktaṃ pūrvoktena vidhānataḥ pātraśeṣaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ deśikāya pradāpayet nirmālyaṃ caiva viprendra caṇḍeśāya pradāpayet padmaṃ śūlaṃ ca paraśuṃ khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ tathāṃkuśam surabhimudrāṃ liṃgamudrāṃ darśayettu vidhānataḥ puruṣaṃ pūrvataḥ pūjya aghoraṃ dakṣiṇe yajet

īśānaṃ karṇikāyāṃ tu pūjayeddeśikassadā nair-ṛtyāṃ tu śikhāṃ pūjya vāyavyāṃ kavacaṃ yajet madhyame śivatatvaṃ tu ātmatatvaṃ tu dakṣiṇe madhyame tu yajeddevaṃ śivaṃ paramakāraṇam maheśvaraṃ yajenmadhye kiṃcidāgneyamācaret paraṃ śivamayaṃ jñeyaṃ śivātparataraṃ na ca anantaṃ pūrvataḥ pūjya sūkṣmaṃ vai dakṣiṇena tu ekarudraṃ tu īśānyāṃ trimūrtistvagnigocare vidyeśāvaraṇaṃ hyetad gaṇeśāvaraṇaṃ śṛṇu caṇḍeśamīśadigbhāge nandīśaṃ pūrvato yajet vighneśaṃ nir-ṛte caiva bhṛṃgīśaṃ vāruṇe yajet gaṇeśāvaraṇaṃ hyetat lokapālānśṛṇuṣvatha yāmyāyāṃ tu yamaṃ pūjya nair-ṛtyāṃ nir-ṛtiṃ yajet saumyāyāṃ somaṃ saṃpūjya aiśānyāmīśameva ca lokeśāvaraṇaṃ hyetat lokapālāstramucyate yāmye daṇḍaṃ yajettatra khaḍgaṃ nir-ṛtigocare gadāyudhaṃ cottare pūjya śūlaṃ cīśānagocare gandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca dīpaiścaiva tu pūjayet āsanasthāṃśca devāṃśca śivasyābhimukhaḥ sthitaḥ vidyeśānāṃ gaṇeśānāṃ liṃgamudrāṃ ca darśayet tatkāle tāḍayed ghaṇṭāṃ paṭaṃ caiva visarjayet prokṣayedambhasā caiva dīpaṃ dadyācchikhāsaha paṃcavarṇahavirdadyāt paṃcavaktreṣu deśikaḥ uśīraṃ caiva kuṣṭhaṃ ca elaṃ candana saṃyutam mukhavāsaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ karpūraṃ triphalairyutam

apūpaṃ pṛthukaṃ caiva phaṭkulī ca samanvitam nivedayettu śarvāya kṣetrapālāṃśca pūjayet samudraghoṣo vāyughoṣo analākṣaḥ pramardanaḥ nīlajīmūta saṃkāśa ūrdhvakeśasamanvitam evameva krameṇaiva pūjayeddeśikottamaḥ śiro hastau dvijānvośca cibukaṃ bāhuyuk tathā śiro hastau dvijānū ca paṃcāṃgamihocyate paṃcāvaraṇaṃ proktaṃ ekāvaraṇamucyate vimalāsanaṃ tṛtīyaṃ syād āsanaṃ trīṇi kalpayet ekāvaraṇamevoktaṃ pūjayeddeśikassadā agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kuryāllakṣaṇena samanvitam gandhapuṣpādinā caiva agnidevaṃ samarcayet prāsādena tu mantreṇa śive daśāhutiṃ hunet paṃcabrahmaśivāṃgānāṃ ekaikaṃ homayettadā ekāhutiṃ ca hotavyaṃ tattatsvanāmamantrataḥ pustakārādhanaṃ tatra gandhapuṣpādinā saha uktānuktaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ hṛdayena tu dāpayet praviśya vigṛhaṃ paścād gṛhadevānsamarcayet tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjayecchivamādarāt ātmārthaṃ pūjayed nityaṃ calaliṃgaṃ viśeṣataḥ ābhicāraṃ kariṣyāmi ekadhā daśadhā tataḥ evameva krameṇaiva arcayeddeśikassadā arcanāyā vidhiḥ proktaḥ agnikāryaṃ tataḥ śṛṇu iti vīratantre arcanāvidhiḥ aṣṭatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ kīdṛśaṃ cāgnikāryaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho

samāsena pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana ! pratiṣṭhā cotsave caiva śatrūṇāṃ ca pradarśane dīkṣākāle tu vā kuryācchāntike pauṣṭike'pi vā cauke vā copanayane samāvartanake'pi vā sīmantopariniṣkrāme agniṣṭomādiyāgake kuṇḍaṃ vā sthaṇḍilaṃ vāpi kārayeddeśikastathā vṛttaṃ * * * * kuryān nityakarma ihocyate trimekhalā samāyuktaṃ nābhiyonisamanvitam khananaṃ hastamātraṃ tu darpaṇodaravattataḥ śoṣitaṃ pācitaṃ caiva śoṣaṇaṃ pācanaṃ tathā praṇītā spṛśyapātraṃ tu sudhāparidhayaḥ sruvāḥ vastraṃ coṣṇīṣamevaṃ tu arghyaṃ gandhaṃ ca puṣpakam ājyaṃ caiva caruṃ caiva homadravyaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ sādhayeddhṛdayenaiva prokṣayedambhasā tataḥ tisṝḥ pūrvamukhā rekhā udagrekhāstathaiva ca arcayedgandhapuṣpāṃśca hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ śrotriyasyāgnihotrācca janayejjātavetasam vistāraṃ tu ṣaḍaṃgulyaṃ viṣkambhaṃ tu triyaṃgulam mathitvā paṃcabrahmeṇa pātre vinyasya deśikaḥ hṛdā cāgniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya agnyādhānaṃ tu kārayet pātrāṇāṃ sādanaṃ caiva prokṣaṇaṃ prokṣaṇī tathā ūrdhva praveśanaṃ cāpi tattanmantreṇa deśikaḥ agnau kāṣṭhaṃ vinikṣipya śivamantreṇa deśikaḥ kuśenaiva paristīryaḥ pūrve tu cottarāgrajāt uttare pūrvamūrdhvaṃ tu vinyaseddeśikastathā

ūrdhvaṃ saṃsthādvayaṃ caiva āgneyyāmīśadeśataḥ ṛtusnānaṃ ca saṃkalpya yonimārgeṇa jāyate tatpuruṣeṇa mantreṇa puṃsavanaṃ bhavanti vai vāmadevena mantreṇa jātakarma ca hūyate catuḥśṛṃgasamāyuktaṃ ṣaṇṇetreṇa samanvitam jaṭāmauṃji samāyuktaṃ kṛṣṇājinasamāyutam atiraktā bahurūpā saptajihvāḥ prakīrtitāḥ uttarā raktamākhyātaṃ yāmye kṛṣṇā iti smṛtā bahurūpā caiva jihvā syāt saptajihvāḥ prakīrtitāḥ jātakarma mayā proktaṃ nāmaṃ tu hṛdayena tu caulamantreṇa kartavyaṃ upanayanaṃ hṛdayena tu hṛdayena tu mantreṇa samāvartanavivāhakam dakṣiṇe brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ darbhāsanopari nyaset viṣṇustatrādhidaivatyaṃ gandhapuṣpādinārcayet kuśenaiva tu viprendra udakopavanaṃ kuru utplāvanaṃ tataḥ kuryāt praṇave naiva nikṣipet agneruttarabhāge tu aṃgārakopari nyaset ājyādhiśrayaṇaṃ kāryaṃ darbhānande vinikṣipet sruvaṃ caiva tu viprendra kṣālayeddhṛdayena tu madhyaṃ madhyena saṃspṛśya mūlaṃ mūlena saṃspṛśet atīte tu mavasveti dakṣiṇe pariṣiñcati sarasvate'numanyasveti uttare pariṣiñcati palāśasamidhaścaiva idhmaṃ ṣoḍaśameva ca prajāpataye svāheti dakṣiṇārdhapūrvādhake somāya svāheti mantreṇa dakṣiṇārdhapūrvārdhake

evameva krameṇaiva hotavyaṃ dīrghajīvinā agnimarcayate caiva ājye vāmena saṃyutam gaurībījena tadvacca paṃcabrahmaśivāṃgakaiḥ varṇāgnigandhaśabdāni lakṣayeccaiva deśikaḥ raktapaṃkajasaṃkāśaṃ kiṃśukasya samaprabham uśīraṃ kuṣṭhagandhaṃ ca karpūrāgarumeva ca padmaṃ kusumagandhaṃ ca śubhānyetāni nikṣipet vāruṇe śāntikaṃ proktaṃ saumyāyāṃ mṛtyunāśanam āgneyyāmagnidagdhaṃ ca mṛtyuṃ caiva tu yāmyake īśānyāṃ jñānalābhaṃ ca śikhāniṣkrāntalakṣaṇam ulūkadhvanite vahnau kārāgṛhamavāpnuyāt vṛṣabhadhvanite vahnau agamyāgamanaṃ bhavet kharavad dhvanite vahnau apamṛtyuvaśaṃ gataḥ gokharavadbhavecchabdaṃ svadravyaṃ taskarāvaham govacca dhvanite vahnau sarpeṇa maraṇaṃ bhavet bhāṇḍavad dhvanite vahnau rogo bhavati niścayam kapiladhvanite vahnau surāpānamavāpnuyāt laśunagandhaṃ bhavedagnau kṣayarogamavāpnuyāt atigandhaṃ bhavedagnau mahājvaramavāpnuyāt mūtragandhaṃ bhavedagnau pāṇḍurogamavāpnuyāt romagandhaṃ bhavedvipra kukṣirogamavāpnuyāt śubhāśubhaṃ mayā proktaṃ agnidevasya padmaja pariṣecanaṃ tu kuryāttu taddoṣaśamanāya ca samidājyacaruṃ lājān sarṣapāṃśca yavāṃstilān hṛdayenājyahomaṃ tu caruṃ ca śikhayā hunet

aghoreṇa yavaṃ hutvā kavacena tilānapi sarvadravyasamāyuktaṃ havyavāhaṃ samuccaran kṛtvānte tu yadasyeti sviṣṭakṛt caiva hūyate īśānyāṃ caiva hotavyaṃ kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile'pi vā indradhanuśca dṛṣṭvā ca taddoṣaśamanāya ca ācāryapūjanaṃ kṛtvā vastrāṃgulīyakādibhiḥ agnikāryaṃ mayā proktaṃ nityotsava mataḥ śṛṇu iti vīratantre agnikāryavidhiḥ ekonacatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ nityotsavaṃ kathaṃ deva tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvalokasukhāvaham nityaṃ nityārcanānte tu nityotsavamathācaret ucchiṣṭāścaiva vetālā kūṣmāṇḍārhatathāgatam nityotsavasya śabdāṃśca śrutvāgarjanti tatra vai dvitīyaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ caiva viṣṇuprītikarāya ca pūrvāhne ca tava prīti puṣpaliṃgasamanvitam sāye taṇḍulaliṃgaṃ syād nārāyaṇapriyaṃ tathā calaliṃgeṣu sarveṣu śrībaliṃ ca na kārayet evameva krameṇaiva nityotsavaṃ tu kārayet balipākaṃ tu kartavyaṃ lakṣaṇena samanvitam ekatālena hīnaṃ tu madhyamaṃ pātramucyate tripātraṃ ca tridhāharmyaṃ madhye padmaṃ tu kārayet padmasyotsedhamānaṃ tu ekāṃgulamihocyate evameva krameṇaiva balipātraṃ tu kārayet dviprasthamadhamaṃ proktaṃ āḍhakaṃ madhyamaṃ bhavet atyuṣṇamatiśītaṃ ca āmlaṃ lavaṇavarjitam

karṇakambusamāyuktaṃ māraṇaṃ tu vinirdiśet śivāgre maṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā maṇḍapasyottare diśi prokṣayedastramantreṇa kuśenaiva tu vāriṇā kṣīraṃ vā dadhisaṃyuktamājyenaiva samāyutam aṣṭāṃgulaṃ tu cotsedhaṃ dviguṇaṃ tasya mūlakam adhamaṃ liṃgamityuktaṃ madhyamaṃ tu tataḥ śṛṇu agramaṣṭāṃgulaṃnāhaṃ uttamaṃ śṛṇu tatvataḥ agraṃ daśāṃgulaṃ nāhaṃ annaliṃgamihocyate dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ * * * vāmahastaṃ kaṭispṛśam evaṃ svarūpakaṃ dhyātvā baliliṃge tu vinyaset gandhaṃ hṛdayamantreṇa śikhayā puṣpamucyate hastamātraṃ bhaveddaṇḍaṃ agre cakradvayaṃ bhavet prokṣayedambhasā caiva hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ aghoraṃ hṛdaye nyasya guhye vāmaṃ prakalpayet hṛdayaṃ hṛdaye nyasya śiraśśirasi vinyaset astraṃ hastapradeśe tu netraṃ netre tu vinyaset sthalikāṃ caiva coddhṛtya hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ japetpāśupatāstraṃ ca śanairgacchetpradakṣiṇam purastātpratimaṃ gacchelliṃgaṃ tu tadanu vrajet śivasyābhimukhaṃ caiva gomayenānulepayet gandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya vādyakaṃ pūjayettataḥ suṣiraṃ gānavaṃ caiva śabdabhedaṃ tathaiva ca evaṃ vidhisamāyuktaṃ vādyakānvādayettataḥ dvitīyaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ kuryād aṣṭatāla samanvitam dakṣiṇe kaduvādyaṃ syān nair-ṛtyāṃ saṃkarī tathā

naṭaprahāraṃ saumyāyāṃ aiśānyāṃ mallatālakam bāhyapīṭhe kramāvṛtya prāsādaṃ tripradakṣiṇam paścime vā trisaṃdhyāyāṃ pradakṣiṇamathācaret sāyāhne paścime caiva balimevaṃ visarjayet sarvadvāre tu kartavyaṃ pūrve tu balipīṭhakam yamasya bhṛṃgiṇī tālaṃ nair-ṛtyāṃ mallatālakam saumye ca koṭikāḥ proktā īśānyaṇḍaṃkarī tathā gāyaṃ gāndhārapūrvaṃ syād dakṣiṇe kauśikaṃ tathā āgneyyāṃ caiva kollī ca nair-ṛtyāṃ nāṭṭabhāṣayā dvāradeśamanuprāpya vṛṣabhasyādhidaivatam nirmālyaṃ ca visṛjyātha jale caivābhiṣecayet arcayetpādukau vidvān * * * * * * dvayoḥ pṛthivīṃ paścime nyasya medinīṃ cottare nyaset balavikariṇī balapramathinī sarvabhūtamanonmanī manonmanī nyasenmadhye arcayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥ visarjayettu cāstreṇa namaskāraṃ tu kārayet gaṇikāṃ snāpayettatra gandhapuṣpādinārcayet tasya dakṣiṇapārśve tu brahmāṇaṃ pūjayettataḥ aṣṭottaraśataṃ nṛttaṃ bhāvayedgaṇikā tataḥ agnimukhīkaraṇaṃ yattu tadā vāhanamucyate pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kṛtvā namaskāraṃ tathaiva ca evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokamavāpnuyāt śivalokamavāpnoti śivavanmodate sadā nityotsavamidaṃ proktaṃ parivārāṃcchṛṇuṣvatha iti vīratantre nityotsava vidhiścatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ

parivāraṃ kathaṃ deva tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho parivāraṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvidhi purassaram purato vṛṣabhasthānaṃ sthāpayedvṛṣabhaṃ tataḥ īśānyāṃ śaiva viprendra bhāskaraṃ vinyasettataḥ idamanyaprakāreṇa vakṣyehaṃ caturānana ! dakṣiṇe mātṛdevāṃśca vighneśaṃ nair-ṛte tathā jyeṣṭhāṃ vāyavyadeśe tu viṣṇuṃ cottaradeśake uttarāyāṃ diśi caiva durgāṃ devīṃ ca vinyaset pūrve tu bhārgavasthānaṃ kumāraṃ * * * * * āgneyyāṃ gaṇapatiṃsthāpya vinyasettu daivatān dakṣiṇadvāragehasya dakṣiṇe vṛṣabhālayam jyeṣṭhāṃ ca vāyudeśe tu (uttare) viṣṇurucyate durgāmāgneyadigbhāge kṣetrapālaṃ tu vinyaset maryādā vīradigbhāge yāmye mātṛgaṇāḥ smṛtā vāyavyāṃ vinyasejjyeṣṭhāṃ viśeṣeṇa vicakṣaṇaḥ ṣoḍaśadvāradevāṃśca vakṣyāmi munisattama yamanair-ṛtayormadhye vasavo'ṣṭau ca vinyaset varuṇa vāyavyayormadhye ṛṣīṇāṃ sthānamucyate soma īśānayormadhye aṣṭanāgaṃ prakalpayet evameva prakāreṇa maryādau ca vinyaset rakṣādīpaṃ kathametat tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho ! rakṣādīpaṃ viśeṣeṇa trividhaṃ cocyate mayā sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi tāmrajaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ tu vā pūrvaṃ ca dakṣiṇaṃ caiva paścimaṃ cottaraṃ tathā aṣṭāṃgulasamutsedhaṃ * * * * * * bhavet

pādaṃ caiva daśāṃgulyaṃ utsedhaṃ tu vidhīyate * * * * * saṃyojya rakṣādīpaṃ tu kārayet vistāraṃ tu caturviṃśad aṃgulyā sthalitā bhavet etatpauṣṭikamityuktaṃ kāmadaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṇu saptapātrā * * * * ke teṣāmūrdhve tantathā ninnityāne kuryāt tasyānnaṃdīpamucyate nityāgni kuṇḍe viprendra ! * * * * * dīpayet sthalikāṃ vinyasettatra śikhāmantreṇa saṃyutam vartiṃ tatraiva * * * * * * dīpayettataḥ pūrve tu puruṣaṃ caiva aghoraṃ dakṣiṇena tu īśānena tu mantreṇa vyomavyāpi samanvitam gaṇikā (vātha) dāsī vā dhārayeddīpamuttamam * * * * samāyuktaṃ śaṃkhadhvani samāyutam gaccha pradakṣiṇaṃ tatra ninayecchivasaṃnidhau īśānena tu mantreṇa arcayeddīpameva ca ekaṃ vāpi trayaṃ vāpi pradakṣiṇamathācaret etacchāntikamityuktaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṇu vinyasetsthalikāṃ tatra hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ hṛdayena tu mantreṇa dīpaṃ dadyācchivasya tu * * japettato mantrī bhasmaṃ śirasi nikṣipet evaṃ pauṣṭikamevā tu kāmadaṃ śṛṇu tatvataḥ saptapātre tu viprendra dīpaṃ saṃyojayettataḥ śive dīpaṃ susaṃyojya visarjayettu vā mataḥ uttamaṃ dīpamākhyātaṃ saptāṃgulasamucchrayam uttamaṃ goghṛtaṃ caiva madhyamaṃ ja saṃbhavam

dūrvākṣataiśca saṃyuktaṃ darpaṇaṃ bhasmameva ca dīpasya darśanādūrdhvaṃ śive dadyādviśeṣataḥ yāntenaiva samāyuktaṃ īkārasvarasaṃyutam etanmantraṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ tava snehātprakāśitam karaṇḍamakuṭopetaṃ saumyarūpaṃ sulocanam evaṃ vidhasvarūpaṃ tu dhyātvā vai pūjayettataḥ balavikaraṇī balapramathinī sarvabhūtadamanyatha madhye manonmanīṃ nyasya pūjayeddevi bāhyataḥ rāhuketuṃ ca viprendra tadbāhye pūjayettataḥ someśānasamāyuktaṃ tādbāhye pūjayettataḥ bhasma dadyācchive tatra dadyāccheṣaṃ janāya ca pariṣecanakāle tu rakṣādīpaṃ karoti yaḥ rakṣādīpaṃ mayā proktamaṃkurārpaṇakaṃ śṛṇu iti vīratantre rakṣādīpavidhidvicatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ aṃkurārpaṇakaṃ kiṃ vā tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho ! tatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana ! utsavāṃkuramevoktaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ athavātryaṃkuraṃ vidyād dhvajāṃkuraṃ tu cocyate sthāpane prokṣaṇe yāge utsave snapane'pi ca śrīkaraṃ śrīnivāsaṃ ca śrīpradaṃ ca tridhā bhavet kṛtvā navapadaṃ tatra daivatāṃśca śṛṇuṣvatha dakṣiṇe tu yajurvedaṃ ekāraṃ caiva nir-ṛte vāyavye pavanaścaiva atharvaṃ somake pade madhyame tu pade caiva somakumbhaṃ pratiṣṭhitam etacchrīkaramityuktaṃ śrīnivāsamataḥ śṛṇu

ṣoḍaśānpadamevāhuḥ devapādāṃ śṛṇuṣvatha sugrīvo varuṇaḥ śoṣa mukhya somāditistathā īśānogniśca sugrīvo mukhyasya tu padāni ca jayanto vitathaścaiva varuṇassoma eva ca ādityaśca yamaścaiva śoṣaścaiva diti sthitaḥ etadvai śrīnivāsaṃ tu śrīpradaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvatha paṃcaviṃśatpadaṃ kṛtvā pūjayetkramaśastathā svabhṛṃgaśca sugrīva varuṇāḥ śoṣamārutau āpavatsārya sāvitrī vivasvānindramitrakā brahmaṇaśca pade caiva sthāpayetsomakumbhakam pitṛdauvārikau caivaṃ marutaścaiva mukhyakaḥ ādityaśca prathaścaiva yamaścaiva tu bhṛṃgarāṭ śarāvānvinyasettatra ghaṭikāṃśca śṛṇuṣvatha lakṣaṇaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva caturānana ! tatrāṃgulena kartavyaṃ pālikādīni caiva hi ṣoḍaśāṃgulaṃ madhyaṃ syād adhamaṃ ca daśāṃgulam paritoṣṭau ca viprendra ṣaḍbhāgaikamiti smṛtam ghaṭasyotsedhamānaṃ tu pālikāsamameva ca vaktraṃ caiva ṣaḍaṃgulyaṃ paṃcavaktra samanvitam vaktraṃ caiva ṣaḍaṃgulyaṃ paṃcavaktra samanvitam tadardhaṃ pāda vistāraṃ tripādaṃ vā samucyate ghaṭikā brahmadaivatyaṃ pālikā viṣṇurucyate caturviṃśati saṃkhyā tu uttamaṃ tu vinirdiśet pālikāṣṭakasaṃyuktaṃ adhamaṃ tadihocyate navame saptame vāpi triśūlena samanvitam

tadante pālikādīni dhārayecchivabhaktakān suśuddhabhūtalaṃ prāpya prokṣayecchuddhavāriṇā kundālīṃ caiva saṃpūjya hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ mṛdaṃ saṃgrāhya vāmena vāmena mṛdamarcayet prāsādasyāgrato vāpi īśāne dakṣiṇe'tha vā aṣṭadroṇena śālisyātsthaṇḍilaṃ kārayettataḥ madhyame somakumbhaṃ tu vinyasetsomabījakaiḥ gandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya naivedyaṃ dāpayettataḥ darbheṇa suṣiraṃ nyasya mṛdaṃ tatraiva pūrayet puṇyāhaṃ tatra kurvīta tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥ niṣpāvaṃ śimbasaṃyuktaṃ apāmārgaṃ ca sarṣapam payasā kṣālayettatra hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ vāpayecchivamantreṇa śivabhaktāśca vāpayet somādhidevatānkumbhātpariṣicya tato jalam suguptadeśe saṃsthāpya somakuṃbhena saṃyutam havirnivedayettatra tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥ homayeccaiva viprendra apūpāni tathaiva ca aṃkurārpaṇahīne tu rājarāṣṭrasya doṣakṛt evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokamavāpnuyāt aṃkurārpaṇamevoktaṃ utsavasya vidhiṃ śṛṇu iti vīratantre aṃkurārpaṇavidhistrayaścatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ utsavasya vidhiḥ ko vā tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho ! tatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana ! udgataṃ tu savoṃ yasmāt tasmādutsavamucyate jvaramāryā prakartantu śūtrūṇāṃ pīḍane'pi vā

sarveṣāmiṣṭakāmyārthaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam dvividhamutsavaṃ caiva tayorbhedaṃ śṛṇuṣvatha puṣyamāse tu puṣyāntaṃ māghamāse maghāntakam vaiśākhe tu viśākhāntaṃ jyeṣṭhāntaṃ jyeṣṭhamāsake pūrvāṣāḍhe tu mevoktaṃ pūrvabhadreti māsakam kārtike kṛttikāntā tu kārayettu śivotsavam rājñāṃ janmadinānte vā grāmanakṣatrameva vā śaivaṃ gauṇaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca bhauvanaṃ daivikaṃ tathā eteṣāṃ bhedakaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana ! triyahena samāyuktaṃ gauṇamityabhidhīyate eteṣāṃ tu kramāṇāṃ tu vakṣyate vidhinā'dhunā prātaḥkāle tu tīrthaṃ syādekāhe tu balidvayam sāyaṃkāle samārabhya tadrātrau cādhivāsayet balimekaṃ mayā proktaṃ ekāhe cotsave tathā evameva krameṇaiva vividhaṃ cocyate mayā prātaḥkāle tṛtīye syādbalirvipra ṣaḍeva tu tṛtīye tu dine caiva balireko vidhīyate cūrṇotsavānte tīrthaṃ syāddvividhaṃ cocyate mayā sāyaṃkāle samārabhya tatpūrvaṃ homamācaret ṣaṣṭhāhe tu ca pūrvāhne cūrṇotsavaṃ tu kārayet sāyaṃkāle samārabhya tadrātrau cādhivāsayet dvitīye tu dine caiva balireko vidhīyate cūrṇātsavānte tīrthaṃ syād dvividhaṃ cocyate mayā sāyaṃkāle samārabhya tatpūrvaṃ dinamārabhet ṣaṣṭhāhe tu ca pūrvāhne cūrṇotsavaṃ tu kārayet

sāyaṃkāle samārabhya paṃcāhaṃ syāddine tathā dvitīye ca tṛtīye ca caturthe ca balidvayam kuryādvai tīrthakarmaṃ tu dvividhaṃ cocyate mayā aṣṭāhe caiva sāyāhne adhivāsanamārabhet caturdaśabaliṃ dadyāccūrṇotsavaṃ ca kārayet saptāhe sāyaṃmārabhya adhivāsya tato budhaḥ dvitīye divase caiva (tṛtīye ca caturthake) saptāhe balirevaṃ syād balyante cūrṇamucyate saptāhe dvividhaṃ proktaṃ navāhaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvatha homaṃ kuryāttu tadrātrau baliṃ caiva tu dāpayet cūrṇotsavaṃ tataḥ kuryāt tīrthaṃ kuryāttato budhaḥ navāhe caiva sāyāhne adhivāsanamārabhet dvitīye divase caiva tṛtīye tu caturthake navāhe'pi ca viprendra balinā dvitayaṃ bhavet navāhaṃ dvividhaṃ caiva procyate kamalāsana ! sūryavāraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana ! puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra havirnivedayettataḥ nityotsavasya kāle tu kuryādgrāma pradakṣiṇam praviśedālayaṃ tatra pādukārcanamācaret liṃge vā pratimāyāṃ vā tailābhyaṃgamihocyate havirnivedayetpaścāllokapālabaliṃ kṣipet grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt sarvātodya samanvitam sāyaṃkāle samārabhya prātaḥkāle baliṃ dadet maṇṭapāddakṣiṇe pārśve sthāpayetkalaśānnava samidājyacaruṃ caiva hutvā vai paṃcaviṃśatiḥ

baliṃ dadyāttu viprendra sāyaṃkāle viśeṣataḥ tīrthaṃ kuryāttato bidvānpraviśedālayaṃ prati mārtāṇḍīyamidaṃ proktaṃ * * rambhaṃ śṛṇu dvija ! bherītāḍanapūrvaṃ ca trividhaṃ cocyate mayā bherīṃ tu tāḍayitvā tu aṃkurārpaṇa pūrvakam evameva krameṇaiva trividhaṃ cocyate mayā dviguṇīkṛtya vā kuryād dhvajamāropayettataḥ bhauvane daivike kuryād anyeṣu ca vivarjayet yatpakṣe yaddine vāre astaṃ yāti divākaraḥ anyeṣāṃ tithi na spṛṣṭaṃ tasmātpūrvaṃ vidhīyate itareṣāṃ ca viprendra tannadīṣu na kārayet yatpakṣe vāre astaṃ yāti divākaraḥ śivasya ca vrataṃ kuryāt snapanaṃ tadanantaram utsavārambhamevoktaṃ vṛṣayāgamataḥ śṛṇu prāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryān maṇṭapaṃ caturaśrakam darbhamālābhirāveṣṭya puṣpamālā valambitam lokapālādhidaivatyaṃ svasvarūpaṃ tu lāṃcchayet vitānenordhvamācchādya muktādāmairalaṃkṛtam mudgānnaṃ caiva dātavyaṃ upadaṃśaissamanvitam aṣṭadroṇena śāliṃ tu tadardhaṃ taṇḍulairapi tasyopari nyasettatra kalaśānnavasaṃkhyayā pūrayedgandhatoyena suvarṇaṃ tatra nikṣipet pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ vinyasedaṣṭakumbhakān ācamanaṃ dakṣiṇenyasya śuddhodakaṃ tu nair-ṛte uttare paṃcagavyaṃ tu īśāne ratnodakaṃ nyaset

vṛṣabhaṃ madhyame nyasya ukṣāṇaṃ pūrvato nyaset nair-ṛtyāṃ nandinaṃ caiva paścime tu paśoḥ patim mahodakaṃ tathaiśānyāṃ vinyasetkalaśeṣu ca aṣṭapadmaṃ samālikhya darbhaiścaiva paristaret uttamaṃ daśahastaṃ tu madhyamaṃ navahastakam ardhādhikatritālaṃ tu dhvajadairghyamihocyate ardhādhika tritālaṃ tu kanyasaṃ tviha cocyate brāhmaṇasya bhavecchvetaṃ kṣatriyasya ca raktakam vistāreṇa samaṃ pucchaṃ pucchārdhaṃ śikharaṃ bhavet vṛṣabhaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ tu raktavarṇaṃ tu śṛṃgakau netraṃ śvetamayī caiva madhyaṃ raktamayī tathā pārśvau dīpadvayau nyasya citramūrdhve tu kārayet pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ vṛṣamūrtiṃ nyasettataḥ prokṣayedambhasā caiva hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ vṛṣamūrtiṃ nyasettataḥ tadbāhye pūjayettatra lokapālāstrameva ca padmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhya darbhaiścaiva paristaret vāmādīnāṃ tu śaktīnāṃ śūlaṃ mūle pratiṣṭhitaḥ taṭī caivāgnidaivatyaṃ sarasvatīṃ caiva daṇḍake gandhapuṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca ṣaṇṇavatyena pūjayet tato homaṃ prakurvīta sthaṇḍilaṃ caturaśrakam samidājyacaruṃ lājān sarṣapaṃ caiva hūyate pratyekaṃ śatamardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vāpi hūyate dhvajārohaṇamevaṃ tu vakṣyāmi munisattama varṇaṃ vai raktavarṇaṃ tu stambhanaṃ pītavarṇakam
