dhūmraṃ vyādhipradaṃ caiva evameva krameṇa tu varṣārdhaṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ tu kṣīrābhaṃ sarvaśāntikam pūrvāhne brāhmaṇaprītira madhyāhne rājavṛddhidam dhvajasthānamahaṃ vakṣye śrūyatāṃ kamalāsana ! pīṭhāgrevā'tha kuryāttu dhvajasthānaṃ vidhīyate campako devadāruṃ ca stambako bilvakairapi prāsādasya samaṃ vāpi prāsādagrīvameva vā mūlāntaṃ tu kulāntaṃ vā daṇḍasyotsedhamucyate dvādaśaṃ daśahastaṃ vā dhvajasyotsedhamucyate dvāviṃśatyaṃgulaṃ vātha nāhastasya vidhīyate ekapūrvaṃ vināśārthaṃ dvipūrveṇa bhayaṃkaram paṃcaparvadvayaṃ loke ṣaṭparvaṃ śriyamāvahet navaparvaṃ kulakṣīṇaṃ daśa vai sarvakāmadam ita ūrdhvaṃ na kartavyaṃ hastamānaṃ tataḥ śṛṇu ādhāraphalakādīni yājñikairvṛkṣasaṃbhavaiḥ suṣiradvayasaṃyuktaṃ kramukaṃ veṇunā saha paṃcaṣaṭsaptamāṃgulyaṃ veṇudaṇḍasya nāhakam kaniṣṭhāṃgulīpramāṇena tantunā rajjurucyate māṇavakaḥ śucirbhūtvā prokṣayedambhasā tataḥ * * anyadhvajaṃbandha kuryādgrāmapradakṣiṇam nānādhvajasamāyuktaṃ nānāpiṃchasamāyutam nānācchatra samāyuktaṃ brahmaghoṣa samanvitam agrataḥ pṛṣṭhato gatvā ācāryo yajamānakaḥ avaṭaṃ khānayettatra hastadvayapramāṇataḥ ṣaṭtālamadhyena vinyasya suvarṇaṃ kūrmameva ca

hṛdayena tu mantreṇa kṣālayed dhvajadaṇḍakam vṛṣagāyatrīmantreṇa prokṣayetkalaśodakaiḥ vālukena hṛdā caiva pūrayedavaṭaṃ tataḥ ṣaṭtālaṃ paṃcatālaṃ vā catustālamathāpi vā tadūrdhve padmaṃ saṃkalpya aṣṭapatraṃ suśobhanam utsedhaṃ tu tridhā bhajya ekaikaṃ mekhalocchrayam śrīdevīṃ madhyame pūjya tṛtīye ca sarasvatīm ekamekhalayā kuryād bhūmidevīṃ nyasettataḥ yāgasthāne tathā devaṃ snāpayetkalaśena tu vṛṣagāyatrimantreṇa paścātsūtre tu sūtrayet rajju yantreṇa vā kuryād dhvajamāropayettataḥ śūlahastaḥ pinākī ca aṣṭanāḍī daṇḍamuṇḍiyaḥ pūjayedgandhapuṣpeṇa dhūpadīpaiḥ samanvitam puṇyāhaṃ kārayettatra kalaśānnava vinyaset indrādīśānaparyantaṃ vinyasetkalaśāṃstataḥ sthāpayitvā yathānyāyaṃ vṛṣagāyatrimantrataḥ tatkāle tu prajārthīnāṃ piṇḍān (vai) bhojayettataḥ vṛṣagāyatrimantreṇa piṇḍaṃ dadyāttu deśikaḥ * * * * * kartavyaṃ dhvajamūle samāśritaḥ antyajātistu sarveṣāṃ pratilomaṃ ca kārayet tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettasmai janānsarvānviśeṣataḥ iti vīratantre dhvajārohaṇa vidhiścatuścatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ prātarmadhyāhnasāyāhne dhvajamāropayettataḥ lakṣaṇaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana ! vyāghravṛkṣeṇa vā kuryādbherīṃ vā paṭahaṃ tu vā

paṃcatālaṃ tu madhyaṃ syāt ṣaḍaṃgulyavihīnakam āyāmasya samaṃ nāhaṃ madhye paṭahamucyate evameva krameṇaiva kuryātpaṭahamuttamam mardalairhāhalaiścaiva haṃsadhvanisamāyutam anyaiśca sarvavādyaiśca yathā lābhena tāḍayet maṇḍapasya tu madhye tu gomayenānulepayet aṣṭadroṇena śāli syāt sthaṇḍilau dvau tu kārayet tadardhaṃ taṇḍulairyuktaṃ prokṣayedambhasā tataḥ paṭahasya tadākāraṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ kārayettataḥ tato'gre sthāpayecchalaṃ astramantreṇa deśikaḥ evaṃ vai pūjayecchūktaṃ paścādbherīṃ samarcayet āpohiṣṭheti mantreṇa prokṣayitvā kuśāmbhasā dakṣiṇe rudramabhyarcya vāme viṣṇuriti smṛtam vāsukī carmasūtre tu valayau ravi candramāḥ kauṇadaṇḍena saṃyuktaṃ pūjayedastramantrataḥ śuklavastra paridhānaṃ gandhamālyaṃ tu lepanam arcayitvā yathā nyāyaṃ gandhapuṣpādinā tataḥ ācāryaṃ pūjayettatra vādyakaṃ pūjayettataḥ tāḍayecchivamantreṇa ācāryau mantravigrahaḥ kulodgato'pi dīnāśca tāḍayettālameva ca indrasya samatālaṃ tu agnau badhvā vaṇaṃ bhavet tatogrāmabaliṃ dadyāllakṣaṇena samanvitam dhūpadīpasamāyuktaṃ nānāpiṃcha samanvitam triśūlena samāyuktaṃ annaliṃga samāyutam vimāna pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryācchivabhakta samanvitam

brahmādyaiśānaparyantaṃ grāme caiva baliṃ dadet sarveṣāṃ tu gaṇānāṃ tu bhūtānāṃ tu piśācakaiḥ dhvajamūle tu cāvāhya baliṃ tatraiva nikṣipet bherītāḍanamevoktaṃ yāgasya maṇḍapaṃ śṛṇu iti vīratantre bherītāḍanavidhiḥ paṃcacatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ pratiṣṭhā cotsave caiva dīkṣāyāṃ prokṣaṇe'pi ca pūrvameva mayā proktaṃ bhūmisaṃgrahaṇaṃ dvija indra īśānayormadhye (madhye) cānalaśakrayoḥ kārayenmaṇḍapaṃ tatra lakṣaṇena samanvitam saptaṣaṭpaṃcahastaṃ vā sapta * * * cocyate ekāśīti padaṃ kṛtvā prokṣayedgandhavāriṇāṃ veditāratnicotsedhaṃ darpaṇodaravatkṛtam madhyame tu pade caiva homakuṇḍaṃ vidhīyate uttare caiva viprendra kuṇḍaṃ syāccaturaśrakam sarveṣāṃ caturaśraṃ vā sarveṣāṃ vṛttameva vā īśāna indrayormadhye vṛttakuṇḍamiti smṛtam trimekhalā samāyuktamekamekhalameva vā catustoraṇa saṃyuktaṃ caturdvāreṣu deśikaḥ trihastatālasaṃyuktamadhamaṃ tviti kathyate palatraya samāyuktaṃ śūlaṃ tālasamaṃ bhavet uttamaṃ saptadarbhaiśca hastamātra pralambitam vitānoparisaṃcchannaṃ muktāsragdāma saṃyutam pūrvāyāṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ tu āgneyyāṃ raktavarṇakam paścime pītavarṇaṃ tu vāyavyāṃ nīlameva ca lokapālasya rūpaṃ tu dhvajānāṃ madhyame nyaset

śrīvatsaṃ svastikaṃ śaṃkhaṃ dīpo devāṣṭamaṃgalam gadā triśūlaṃ cakraṃ ca padmaṃ ceti daśāyudham hastamātra pramāṇena kārayedaṣṭamaṃgalam kṣālayettu mṛdā caiva śuddhatoyena saṃyutam vedibāhye nyasecchāli tatsamaṃ samalaṃkṛtam darbhopari nyaseccaiva kūrcenaiva pidhāya ca evameva nyasedvidvān aṣṭame navameva ca vajrādīnarcayettatra svaiḥ svairnāmnā ca mantrataḥ tato homaṃ prakartavyaṃ ekaṃ vā paṃcame'pi vā ācāryapūjanaṃ kṛtvā pādāthīnpūjayettataḥ iti vīratantre maṇḍapalakṣaṇaṃ ṣaṭcatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ utsavasyādirātro tu ārabhedadhivāsanam vinyasetpālikādīni madhyame somakumbhakam suguptadeśe saṃsthāpya pālikādīnyathākramam pratimāṃ vinyasettatra astraṃ caiva tu vinyaset kārpāsasūtraṃ vā kuryāt prokṣayeddhṛdayena tu tāmbūlaṃ dāpayetpaścājjanānsarvānviśeṣataḥ taṇḍulaistala saṃyuktaṃ darbhaiścaiva paristaret sasūtrānsāpidhānāṃśca savastrānvāripūritān ratnāni vinyaseddhemaṃ gaurībījena vinyaset nānā vādyasamāyuktaṃ nānāpiṃcha samāyutam vimānaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt praviśedyāgamaṇṭapam ācāryaśca śucirbhūtvā mantradehasamanvitaḥ gandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ yajñamūrtiṃ pravakṣyāmi ekavaktra samanvitam

padmamadhye sukhāsīnaṃ jaṭāmakuṭa saṃyutam varadābhayahastaṃ ca divyāmbaradharaṃ haram dvinetrāṃ cāruvadanāṃ dvibhujāṃ ca suyauvanām sarvābharaṇa saṃyuktāṃ vardhanīmadhyame nyaset dvārasyābhimukhaṃ caiva vinyasedyāgamūrtinam pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ aṣṭakuṃbhānkramānnyaset vedikāścaiva digbhāge śūlaṃ vai sthāpayettataḥ arcayedgandhapuṣpādyaiḥ svasvanāmnā viśeṣataḥ gadā triśūlaṃ padmaṃ ca cakraṃ ceti daśāyudham padmāstraṃ nair-ṛte bhāge cakraṃ caiśānagocare śrīvatsaṃ svastikaṃ śaṃkhaṃ dīpo devāṣṭa maṃgalam gandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya tattatsvanāmamantrataḥ tato homaṃ prakurvīta lakṣaṇena tu deśikaḥ samidājya caruṃ lājān sarṣapāṃśca yavāṃstilān samidhaḥ sadyamantreṇa ājyaṃ vāmena hūyate sarṣapānīśamantreṇa yavānvā yamamantrataḥ netreṇa mudgaṃ hutvātha śālīnastreṇa homayet hutvā caiva viśeṣeṇa dravyaṃ prati viśeṣataḥ sarvadravya samāyuktaṃ havyavāhaṃ samuccaran jayādirabhyadhānaṃ ca rāṣṭrabhṛcca kramāddhunet kuryādadhyayanaṃ tatra caturovedapāragān sāyaṃ prātarbaliṃ dadyād homānte tu viśeṣataḥ annaliṃgaṃ prakartavyaṃ pūrvavallakṣaṇānvitam pāśaṃ vāmakare caiva abhayaṃ dakṣiṇe kare evaṃ pāśupataṃ dhyātvā baliliṃgaṃ suyojayet

prathamaṃ vighnarātraṃ tu dvitīyaṃ bhūtarātrakam paṃcamaṃ tvindrarātraṃ syāt ṣaṣṭhaṃ vai ṛṣirātrakam navamaṃ śaivamityāhu rityete rātridevatāḥ paṃcāhe tu prakartavyaṃ indrarātrādhivardhayet ekāhamutsave caiva śivarātramiti smṛtam śuddhānnaṃ dadhisaṃyuktaṃ apūpaṃ laḍḍukānvitam padmapuṣpaṃ ca rajanī lājapāyasasaṃyutam padmamūlaṃ kuśāgraṃ ca śālyannaṃ ghṛtamiśrakam haridrānnaṃ sa sarpiśca nālikeraphalairyutam indravallī haridrānnaṃ priyaṃgughṛtasaṃyutam gulodanaṃ sasarpiśca kadalīpanasāyutam gulodanaṃ ghṛtaṃ yuktaṃ bṛhatīphalasaṃyutam māṣānnaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ māṃsaṃ caṃpa samanvitam śuddhānnaṃ dadhisaṃyuktaṃ lājāpūpasamanvitam navame'hani dātavyaṃ śivamantramanusmaran brahmādīśānaparyantaṃ balipīṭhe baliṃ kṣipet mātrāṃgulena kartavyaṃ vistārāyāma tatsamam mekhaloccaṃ dvayāṃgulyaṃ veśanaṃ tāvadeva tu hastamātraṃ tu vistāraṃ utsedhaṃ tālamātrakam vistāraṃ tu tridhā kṛtvā ekaikaṃ dvidvihastakam raṃgeṣvārūḍhato vāpi rathedyāmau vrajettataḥ prathame tu patākāśca dvitīye vādyakāstathā paṃcame vānnaliṃgaṃ tu vitānavastra saṃyutam dhūpadīpasamāyuktaṃ ghaṇṭārava samanvitam caṇḍarudrāya gosthāne vyāpya * * darāya ca

kṣetreṣu kṣetrapālaṃ syāt sabhāsthāne sarasvatī evameva baliṃ kuryād balipīṭhe vinikṣipet kautukaṃ balidānānte kuryādgrāmapradakṣiṇam nānājanapadairyuktaṃ nānādhvaja samanvitam prathame ca patākāśca dvitīye vādyakastathā paṃcame nṛtayantrāśca tadā yaṣṭitaṭātakān navame tu * * * * vṛṣabhaṃ daśame tataḥ bhikṣāṭanaṃ tadante tu ardhanārīṃ caturdaśa ṣoḍaśe harirardhaṃ tu tadante kālahā vrajet bimbakordhve tu viprendra umāskandahitaṃ vrajet grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā balidānasya deśikaḥ ālayaṃ praviśedvidvān pariveṣamathocyate dakṣiṇābhimukho vāpi pūrvābhimukha eva vā mahāmaryādau maryādau kuryānnoda maṇḍapam snānaṃ kuryāttu viprendraṃ gandhapuṣpādinā'rcayet uttare nṛpatiṃ vidyād dvau pārśvau yoṣito nyaset dakṣiṇena tu śaivānāṃ uttare samayānsmitān tatkāle caiva viprendra pūrvoktavidhinā saha arcayedgandhapuṣpādyaiḥ dadyādvai dhūpadīpakam pṛthak pātre vinikṣipya gaṇikā dhārayetkramāt evameva prakāreṇa dinaṃ prati samācaret iti vīratantre adhivāsanavidhiḥ saptacatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ rākṣasānāṃ tu divase vanayātrāṃ samārabhet tripurāntakarūpaṃ gacchedāyudhakaṃ dharet keciddhanurdharāścaiva kecitkhaḍgadharāstathā

evameva divā kuryād rātrau kautukabandhanam kautukaṃ caiva śūlaṃ ca vardhayetkautukaṃ hṛdā sthalikāṃ vinyasettatra taṇḍulānupari nyaset gandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya prāsādena tu mantrataḥ nānādīpa samāyuktaṃ nānāvādya samanvitam pūrvoktena tu mantreṇa śūlaṃ vai bandhayettataḥ tīrthasaṃgrahaṇaṃ kuryācchivāgre maṇṭapaṃ tataḥ madhyame vinyasetkumbhaṃ savastraṃ sāpidhānakam hemaṃ tatraiva nikṣipya gandhapuṣpādinārcayet tīre samatalaṃ kṛtvā sthāpayet * * * tataḥ digbandhanaṃ tu kartavyaṃ astramantreṇa deśikaḥ sādhitaiḥ kalaśaistatra śūlaṃ vai snāpayettataḥ iti vīratantre yātrā kautukavidhiraṣṭacatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ kautukaṃ balidānānte kuryādgrāmapradakṣiṇam kautukasyāgrato vāpi cūrṇamabhyukṣya lūkhale gomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā sthaṇḍilaṃ śālinā kuru padmamaṣṭadalaṃ nyasya darbhaiścaiva paristaret plakṣodumbaramaśvatthaṃ padaṃvai na tu lūkhalam kṣālayedastramantreṇa sthāpayeddhṛdayena tu lūkhale * * vinyasya madhyena hṛdayena tu * * * vyajanairyuktaṃ gaṇikā cūrṇayettataḥ takkolaṃ caiva jātī ca gaṇikā cūrṇayettataḥ savastra hemasaṃyuktaṃ gandhapuṣpādinārcayet mūlabimbe nyasettatra cūrṇaṃ caiva tu tailakam bhaktānāṃ parivārāṇāṃ cūrṇaṃ dadyādviśeṣataḥ

indrādi lokapālānāṃ cūrṇaṃ dadyāttu deśikaḥ gehaṃ praveśayettatra tatastīrthaṃ samācaret iti vīratantre cūṇotsavavidhirekonapaṃcāśaḥ paṭalaḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ śālinākuryāt taṇḍulaistilasaṃyutam gaurībījena mantreṇa vardhanīṃ tasya vāmataḥ svasvanāmnā ca mantreṇa pūjayettu viśeṣataḥ kautukaṃ śivasaṃyuktaṃ kuryādgrāmapradakṣiṇam tīre samatalaṃ kṛtvā śālinā sthaṇḍilaṃ kuru arcayitvā tu gandhādyaiḥ śūlaṃ kalaśasaṃyutam kautukaṃ ca visṛjyaiva pratimāṃ śūlameva ca sahasnānaṃ tu yomartyaḥ sarvapāpādvimucyate pūrṇāhutiṃ ca kṛtvā tu agniṃ caiva visarjayet snapanaṃ kārayettatra lakṣaṇena samanvitam tadrātrau caiva viprendra baliṃ dadyādviśeṣataḥ vāpayetsṛtayenāpi piṇyākena samāyutam sandhau catuṣpathe caiva devālaye śmaśānake baliṃ dadyādviśeṣeṇa rājarāṣṭrasukhāvaham iti vīratantre tīrthavidhiḥ paṃcāśaḥ paṭalaḥ tīrthāhe vā tṛtīye vā paṃcāhe saptame'pi vā tīrthāhe vā tṛtīye vā paṃcāhe saptame'pi vā saptāhātparamaṃ caiva snapanaṃ tatra kārayet caṇḍeśvarāgrataścaiva gomayenānulepayet tilānvinyasya viprendra darbhaiścaiva paristaret navakumbhānsamādāya sūtreṇa pariveṣṭayet snāpayeccaiva caṇḍeśaṃ caṇḍamantreṇa buddhimān

caṇḍeśasyākṛtiṃ kṛtvā brahmacārī śucirbhavet puṣpamālyairalaṃkṛtya gandhacandanakādibhiḥ ṭaṃkahastasamāyuktaṃ bhasmoddhūlitavigraham śibikordhve nyasettatra dhvajasthāne praveśayet dhvajāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā sthāpayetkalaśānnava vṛṣamantramanusmṛtya dhvajaṃ vai sthāpayettataḥ diśāṃ baliṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dhvajaṃ caiva visarjayet ṭaṃkena cchedayettatra dhvajavedīṃ viśeṣataḥ lājasakthu samāyuktaṃ haridrānnaṃ dadhisaṃyutam sandhisthaṃ pīṭhamudvāsya ṭaṃkenaiva tu chedayet ācāryaścaivaṃ viprendra ! pādaprakṣālanaṃ kuru ācāryaṃ pūjayettatra vastradhānyādikāṃcanaiḥ gaṇikānāṃ ca dāsīnāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dāpayettataḥ kulaikaviṃśamuddhṛtya śivalokaṃ sa gacchati gacchecchivapuraṃ divyaṃ yāvanto dhṛti saṃplavam utsavasya vidhiḥ proktaḥ prāyaścittavidhiṃ śṛṇu iti vīratantre utsavavidhirekapaṃcāśaḥ paṭalaḥ prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ deva tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho ! tatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana ! vināśasya tu saṃdhānaṃ prāyaścittamiti smṛtam akṛtānāṃ vinaṣṭānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate (prāsādaṃ pūrvavatkṛtvā jalasaṃprokṣaṇaṃ kuru) āgneyyāṃ vahninā dagdhaṃ dakṣiṇe maraṇaṃ bhavet vāyavyāṃ bandhuvṛddhiḥ syād uttare putravardhanam ravātvaṃ vyapohya sarvaṃ tu sakalikenna bandhayet

prāsādaṃ naṣṭamevaṃ syāt prāsādaṃ caiva kārayet pūrvasthānagataṃ liṃgaṃ anyasthānagataṃ bhavet pūrvadeśe calaṃ liṃgaṃ kiṃcideva tu saṃsthitam liṃgaṃ vā pīṭhamevaṃ vā sphuṭite dagdhameva vā vyapohyaiva tu talliṃgaṃ sthāpayennavaliṃgakam talliṃgaṃ sthāpayedanyaddeśilakṣaṇa saṃyutam jalasaṃprokṣaṇaṃ kuryāllakṣaṇanena samanvitam gulaṃ sākṣānmadhūcchiṣṭaṃ sajjarasamanvitam jalasaṃprokṣaṇaṃ kuryāt samīpe snapanaṃ bhavet * * * * * * * * śāntihomaṃ tu kārayet pratimasyāṃgahīnaṃ tu śilpinā kārayettataḥ pratimāṃ caiva deveśaṃ parito viśvarairyutam hutvā pratiṣṭhāmārgeṇa sthāpayettadvadeva ca yojayetpratimāṃ viprasnapanaṃ tatra kārayet bhinne ca sphuṭite caiva pramādācchedane'pi ca jalasaṃprokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā śāntihomaṃ tu kārayet sadyogandhādināpūjya śivamaṣṭaśataṃ japet pūrvavatparimanyā vā saṃprokṣaṇādi kārayet jvarādipīḍanaṃ kuryād upaśāntiṃ karoti ca catudikṣu caturvedaiḥ kuryādadhyayanaṃ tataḥ samidājyacaruṃ lājā saktuṃ caiva tu hūyate aṣṭottaraśataṃ caivaṃ homayeddeśikottamaḥ evameva krameṇaiva saptāhaṃ kārayeddvijaḥ śaivāṃśca bhojayettatra savyaṣṭiparicārakān dinānte caiva viprendra ! rātrau grāmabaliṃ dadet

brahmādīśānaparyantaṃ svasvanāmnā vinikṣipet nityārcanā vihīne tu śāntihomaṃ tu kārayet sandhyāṃ ca dvitrayo hīne paṃcagavyābhiṣecanam ekāhe tritaye vāpi paṃcāhe vāpi hīnake diśāhomaṃ cārdhamāse tu snapanaṃ caiva kārayet sthitaliṃgamidaṃ proktaṃ calaliṃgamataḥ śṛṇu triṃśāttu divasādūrdhvaṃ snapanaṃ kārayettataḥ nityāgnau ca vihīne tu dviguṇaṃ homamucyate parivāre tu vicchinne sthāpayetparivārakān garbhagehe dīpahīnaṃ puṇyāhaṃ tatra kārayet nityotsave dīpahīne tu puṇyāhaṃ tatra kārayet śuddhanṛttavihīne tu snapanaṃ tatra kārayet śāntihomaṃ tataḥ kuryānnavaliṃgaṃ prakalpayet pratime patite vāpi snapanaṃ tatra kārayet jalasaṃprokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā paścānnityotsavaṃ kuru śvānakākādibhiḥ spṛṣṭe liṃge vā pratime'pi vā kāle cotsavahīne tu snapanaṃ tatra kārayet paṃcāhe balihīne tu diśāhomaṃ tu kārayet balidravyavihīne tu dviguṇaṃ ca prayojayet bhinne vāṃgavihīne tu pratiśūlaṃ tathaiva ca āvāhya śūlaṃ tatraiva baliśeṣaṃ samācaret aṣṭamaṃgalarūpe vā āyudhe vā vihīnake tatsvarūpaṃ punaḥ kṛtvā prokṣayetpūrvavatkramāt snapanaṃ tatra kurvīta caṇḍayāgaṃ tu kārayet caṇḍayāgavihīne tu snapanaṃ tatra kārayet

yāgaśālāvihīne tu śāntihomaṃ hunettataḥ dīpaṃ tatraiva saṃyojya taddoṣaśamanāya ca gandhapuṣpavihīne tu dhūpahīne tathaiva ca ācāryastu viprendra ! pramādāvyādhisaṃbhave putrapautrādinā caitacchiṣyeṇaiva tu kārayet vṛṣabhaṃ tatra saṃsthāpya sthāpayedvidhinā saha śilpinā kārayetpīṭhaṃ sthāpayellakṣaṇairyutam punaḥ pūjāṃ samārabhya taddoṣaśamanāya ca puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra punaḥ karmasamārabhet snapanaṃ tatra kurvīta punarvārotsavaṃ kuru śāntihomaṃ tataḥ kuryādamāvāsyāṃ punaḥ kuru snapanaṃ tatra kurvīta punarmāsotsavaṃ kuru puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra punaḥ snapana mācaret khanitvā cāstramantreṇa valmīkaiḥ pūrayettataḥ prākāre maṇṭape vāpi prāsādasya samīpake tatkāle paṃcahavyaṃ tu tadevaṃ prokṣayettataḥ bhūtavalyaṃ ca viprendra ! dīpahīnaṃ bhavettataḥ agnikuṇḍavihīne tu śāntihomaṃ tu kārayet homagarbhe pratiṣṭhāyāṃ prokṣaṇe cotsave'pi vā śāntihomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā snapanaṃ tatra kārayet traivarṇikakule jātā strīṇāmārtava saṃyutam prākāre gopure caiva paṃcagavyena śudhyati snapanaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ taddoṣaśamanāya ca mantrahīne kriyāhīne dravyahīnasya kālake upadaṃśādi vicchinne puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ

pīṭhapūjā vihīne tu puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ śuddhanṛttavihīne tu kuryātsnapanamuttamam śāntihomaṃ tataḥ kuryācchuddhanṛttaṃ tu kārayet gaṇikābhṛtyavarge vā rajodṛṣṭena saṃbhave diśāhomaṃ tataḥ kuryān mahāhavirnivedayet puṇyāhaṃ kārayettatra śāntihomaṃ ca kārayet iti vīratantre prāyaścittavidhiḥ dvipaṃcāśaḥ paṭalaḥ etatsarvaṃ samāsena vaktumarhasi me prabho ! anāvṛṣṭyādikāleṣu jvaramārī pravartane śatrūṇāṃ pīḍane kāle kṣīrasnānaṃ vidhīyate adhamaṃ raktajaṃ proktaṃ snāpayeddeśikottamaḥ paṃcagāvasamutpannā lokānugrahakāmyayā kṣīrasnānaṃ tridhā proktaḥ muttamaṃ madhyamādhamam adhamaṃ caitaduddiṣṭaṃ madhyamaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṇu śivasya purato vipra ! gomayenānulepayet sūtrapātaṃ prakartavyaṃ śāstradṛṣṭena tantunā uttarāgraṃ tathā sūtraṃ vinyaseddeśikottamaḥ tadbāhyāvaraṇādbāhye padamekantu hrāsayet madhyamena pade caivaṃ śālinā vikirettataḥ paristarettu darbhaiśca prokṣayed hṛdayena tu kalaśāngrāhayettena sūtreṇa veṣṭayettataḥ madhyame śivakumbhaṃ tu kṣīreṇaivābhipūrayet śivabījena mantreṇa sthāpayecchivakumbhakam savastraṃ sa hiraṇyaṃ ca sakūrcaṃ sāpidhānakam prathamāvaraṇe caiva kalaśānaṣṭa vinyaset

tṛtīyāvaraṇe caiva ṣaṭtriṃśatkalaśānnyaset kṣīreṇa pūrayeddhīnaṃ savastraṃ sāpidhānakam prathamāvaraṇe caiva vidyeśvarāṃśca vinyaset tṛtīyāvaraṇe caiva brahmā tatrādhidevatā tato homaṃ prakartavyaṃ navapaṃcaikameva vā agnimukhaṃ ca saṃkalpya pūrvoktena krameṇa tu mudgamāṣasamāyuktaṃ navadravyamihocyate aghoreṇa caruṃ hutvā lājānvāmena caiva hi tilānvai śiromantreṇa mudgaṃ tu śikhayā yutam aṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi paṃcāśatpaṃcaviṃśatiḥ ghṛtamikṣeti mantreṇa juhuyāttadanantaram ācāryaṃ pūjayettatra padārthīnpūjayettataḥ gaurībījena mantreṇa vardhanīṃ snāpayettataḥ paṃcāśadbhiḥ paṃcaviṃśadbhiḥ snāpayetsnapanoktavat dadhisnānaṃ prakartavyaṃ ghṛtasnānaṃ tathaiva ca iti vīratantre kṣīrābhiṣekavidhistripaṃcāśaḥ paṭalaḥ kuṇḍānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kiṃ ca tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho ! sruksruvāṇāṃ vidhiṃ caiva śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana ! dahatyaśeṣabhāvena tatkuṇḍamiha saṃjñitam snapane dīkṣākāle tu pavitrārohaṇādiṣu hastamātra pramāṇena mātrāṃgula samanvitam yonyādi sarvakuṇḍāni caturaśre prajāyate yāmyāyāmardhacandraṃ ca nair-ṛtyāṃ tu trikoṇakam saumyāyāṃ saptakoṇaṃ tu aiśānyāmaṣṭakoṇakam karṇasūtrasya mokṣāṃśaṃ paścime vinyasettataḥ

dakṣiṇe cottare vṛttaṃ kārayeddeśikottamaḥ koṇādi tatra sūtraṃ ca vinyaseddeśikottamaḥ caturaśrasya karṇaṃ tu grāhayettu dvijottamaḥ bhāgamekaṃ nyasetpūrve madhyātpūrvādi bhrāmayet aṣṭabhāgakṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ ekabhāgaṃ tu dakṣiṇe vinyaseccaiva viprendra ! tena mānena sūtrakam saptabhāgakṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ vinyasetpūrvamekaśaḥ karṇārdhamaṣṭadhā bhitvā karṇārdhena samanvitam likeśāṃśaṃ tu kṣetraṃ syātpūrvamekena vinyaset kṣetraṃ dvātriṃśadaṃśaṃ tu kṣetrārdhena tu yojayet vasubhāgakṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ dakṣiṇe cārdhabhāgataḥ tasmānmadhyaṃ gṛhītvā tu kṛtvā ṣaṭkoṇameva ca dakṣiṇe cottare caikaṃ koṇamityabhidhīyate aṣṭapatrasamaṃ kṛtvā padmakuṇḍamihocyate abhyantare tu vinyasya caturdikṣu viśeṣataḥ lāṃchanaṃ koṇakaṃ gṛhya etadabhyantarasya tu athavānyaprakāreṇa kuṇḍaṃ kuryāttu deśikaḥ mekhalāṃ ca prakartavyaṃ vistārotsedhatatsamam adhastānmekhalā vipra ! dvyaṃgulaṃ tadihocyate vistāraṃ caturaṃgulyaṃ saptāṃgulaṃ tu dairghyakam hastamātraṃ khanedbhūmiṃ vistāraṃ talameva tu madhye nābhiṃ prakalpyātha ekāṃgulaṃ tu viṣṭharam vajraṃ śaktiṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ tathāṃkuśam sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ yājñikaṃ vṛkṣameva vā vaikaṃkatamayaṃ vāpi kuryādastramanuttamam

vistāraṃ ca ṣaḍaṃgulyaṃ ghanaṃ tasyārdhamucyate madhye padmamṛjuṃ kṛtvā bahirvakraṃ tu pārśvayoḥ tadadho gaṇḍikāṃ kuryādardhāṃgulena kārayet madhyame gaṇḍikāṃ kuryādaṃguladvyamānataḥ evameva krameṇaiva dvayoragraṃ tu śūlavat caturaṃgulavistāraṃ dīrghaṃ pūrvavadeva tu tasyocchrayaṃ ṣaḍaṃgulyaṃ ekāṃgulena gaṇḍikā tadūrdhve tadadhaścāpi dvābhyāmaṃgulinā bhavet vajravatphalakā caiva tadūrdhve gaṇḍikāṃguliḥ ghaṭasyoccaṃ ṣaḍaṃgulyaṃ tadadho gaṇḍikāṃguliḥ pūrvavaddīrghamevaṃ syān madhye vakraṃ tathaiva ca mūle tu phalakāṃ kṛtvā vistāraṃ tu ṣaḍaṃgulam taddīrghaṃ phalakāṃ kṛtvā madhye pāśaṃ tu lekhayet dīrghaṃ tu pūrvavatkṛtvā agre sūcīmukhaṃ tataḥ caturaṃguladairghyaṃ tu nāhamekāṃgulaṃ bhavet gadāṃ tu daṇḍavatkṛtvā agre sūciṃ tu kārayet pālikā tu catuṣkoṇe vṛṣabhaṃ sthāpayetpunaḥ cakrasya śūlavanmānaṃ vṛttarūpamihocyate evaṃ cakraṃ samākhyātaṃ padmaṃ caiva śṛṇuṣvatha paṃcāṃgulaṃ tu viprendra ! daṇḍanāhamihocyate ṣoḍaśāṃguladairghyaṃ syādaṣṭāṃgulaṃ tu vistaram darpaṇaṃ pūrṇakumbhaṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ yugmacāmaram vinyasetphalakāmadhye aṣṭamaṃgalamucyate varṇena lekhayitvā tu lāṃchayecchilpinā tataḥ sruvasya lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye caturviṃśatiraṃgulī

karṇaṃ triyaṃgulaṃ proktaṃ mānaṃ pūjyākṣayaṃ bhavet nāsikāvadbaliṃ kṛtvā sruvalakṣaṇamucyate ṣaṭtriṃśadaṃgulāyāmaṃ aṣṭāṃgulasuvistaram agraṃ caiva tribhāgaikaṃ saptāṃgulaṃ tu dairghyakam rasāṃgula pravistāraṃ karṇaṃ caiva samāhitaḥ aṣṭāṃgulena vediḥ syād vistāra tāvadeva tu madhyame caturaṃgalyaṃ baliṃ caiva tu kārayet dvayoḥ paṭṭikayormadhye yavadvayaṃ tu nimnakam bilāccaiva mukhāntaṃ syātkhātaṃ kaniṣṭhamānataḥ gajoṣṭra sadṛśākāraṃ matsyapṛṣṭhākṛtirbhavet tadadho gaṇḍikā bāhyāṃ tadadho gaṇḍikāṃ śṛṇu dvayāṃgulapramāṇena ghaṭaṃ kṛtvā tu deśikaḥ paṃcahastapramāṇena uttamaṃ toraṇocchrayam utsedhārdhaṃ tu vistāraṃ phalakāṃ caiva vinyaset evaṃ toraṇamākhyātaṃ darbhamālāṃ śṛṇuṣvatha adhamaṃ trīṇi darbhāṇi tadagre rajju rucyate paridhīlakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye avakraṃ nirvraṇaṃ śubham ṣaṭtriṃśadaṃgulāyāmaṃ tridhā darbhaiḥ paristaret catvāri viṣṭharaṃ kuryādājyasthālyādikaṃ śṛṇu vistāraṃ ca ṣaḍaṃgulyaṃ utsedhaṃ tu dvayāṃgulam ājyaṃ sruvaprapūrṇaṃ ca hastamātrapramāṇataḥ annamakṣa pramāṇena gulaṃ vai tatpramāṇataḥ sthalikā caiva kartavyā hastamātra pramāṇataḥ pīṭhoccaṃ tu tripādīṃśca kārayeddeśikottamaḥ madhyamaṃ paṃcadarbhaistu saptadarbhaistu cottamam

kūrcānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ vastrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu uttamaṃ dvādaśa proktaṃ vistāraṃ paṃcatālakam ṣaṭsapta caiva dīrghaṃ syādaṣṭatālaṃ tu vistaram kuṇḍānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ śāntihomaṃ śṛṇuṣvatha iti vīratantre kuṇḍādilakṣaṇavidhiścatuḥ paṃcāśaḥ paṭalaḥ mūrtihomaṃ kathaṃ śaṃbho ! brūhi me parameśvara ! pūrvoktamaṇḍapaṃ vāpi agniśālāmathāpi vā caturaśraṃ vātha vṛttaṃ agnikuṇḍaṃ tu kārayet evaṃ tatraiva saṃkalpya darpaṇodaravatkṛtam mathitvā tu gṛhītvā tu hṛdayena pratiṣṭhitam upasthānaṃ śirasā kṛtvā paristaraṇameva ca dakṣiṇe paścime caiva uttare ca paristaret pātrāṇāṃ sādhanaṃ caiva hūyate kramaśastataḥ aghoreṇa caruṃ hutvā juhuyāttu śatāhutiḥ śāntihomamitikhyātaṃ diśāhomaṃ tataḥ śṛṇu iti vīratantre śāntihomavidhiḥ paṃcaḥ paṃcāśaḥ paṭalaḥ diśāhomaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva caturānana ! agnimukhaṃ ca saṃkalpya pūrvoktena vidhānataḥ prāsādasya caturdikṣu pūrve tu caturaśrakam padmaṃ caiva tu saumyāyāṃ kuṇḍaṃ vā sthaṇḍilaṃ tu vā aśvatthaṃ vāruṇe caiva vaṭaṃ caivottare diśi sahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā aṣṭottaraśataṃ tu vā ājyena caruṇā caiva juhuyāttu śatāhutiḥ dravyānte caiva dravyānte vyāhṛtiṃ juhuyāttataḥ śivāgre maṇṭapaṃ kṛtvā sthaṇḍilaṃ śālibhiḥ kuru

sa vastraṃ sa hiraṇyaṃ ca sakūrcaṃ vāripūritam ādityaśca tathācāgniḥ somo dharaṇireva ca pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ pūjayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥ kalaśānbāhyato vipra ! aṣṭadikṣvaṣṭa homayet ekaikāṣṭaśataṃ caiva īśānādīni hūyate havirnivedayetpaścāt śivasya parameṣṭhinaḥ prāsāde maṇṭape caiva liṃgasthāpanakarmaṇi udyāne vāpi viprendra ! vāstuhomaṃ tu kārayet samarīya pade kṛtvā sthaṇḍilaṃ sikatena vā śuddhatoyena saṃpūrya homaṃ tatraiva nikṣipet gandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya ullekhanaṃ tu kārayet aghorāstreṇa cā likhya prokṣayetpuruṣeṇa tu paristareta darbhaiśca pūrvoktena paristaret praṇītāmuttare sthāpya brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe yajet ājyādhiśravaṇaṃ kuryāt pūrvoktena vidhānataḥ dakṣiṇe cottare caiva uttare paridhīnnyaset tūṣṇīmadhyaṃ tu dadyāttu aghoraṃ caiva hūyate caruṃ hutvārthabhasmannājyaṃ vāstoṣpateti ca sadyādīśānaparyantaṃ ghṛtenaiva tu homayet pāyasānnaṃgulaṃ yuktaṃ ghṛte naiva pariplutam jayādirabhyadhānaṃ ca rāṣṭrabhṛccaiva hūyate sviṣṭamagneti mantreṇa juhuyāttadanantare pariṣecanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā paridhānyāni dhāpayet praṇītodakena saṃprokṣya pavamānamudīrayan savatsāṃgāṃ pradadyāttu ācāryāya viśeṣataḥ

kriyāśarīramityuktaṃ dakṣiṇā jīva ucyate tasmātsarvaprayatnena ācāryaṃ pūjayetsadā vāstuhomamitikhyātaṃ sakalārādhanaṃ śṛṇu iti vīratantre mūrti vāstuhomaḥ ṣaṭpaṃcāśaḥ paṭalaḥ sakalārādhanaṃ kiṃ vā tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho jalasnānaṃ purā kṛtvā bhasmasnānaṃ samācaret uttarābhimukho bhūtvā pūrvābhimukha eva vā tasyaiva vāmabhāge tu darbhaiścaiva paristaret pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ hṛdayena tu vinyaset tripādamadhyame caiva śaṃkhaṃ caiva tu vinyaset recakaṃ pūrakaṃ caiva kumbhakaṃ ca samācaret phaṭkāreṇa samāyuktaṃ daśadikṣu ca śodhayet īśānamaṃguṣṭhe nyasya tarjanyāṃ caiva deśikaḥ puruṣaṃ tarjanīṃ nyasya aghoraṃ madhyame nyaset ṣaḍaṃgaṃ vinyasettatra pūrvoktena vidhānataḥ śikhāyāṃ tu śikhāṃ nyasya kavacaṃ stanamadhyataḥ īśānamūrtiṃ vinyasya mukhe tatpuruṣaṃ nyaset sadyojātaṃ nyasetpāde vinyasettu viśeṣataḥ mukhe viṣṇuṃ nyasedvidvānkarṇayoraśvinau nyaset ādityaṃ dakṣiṇe bāhau somaṃ vinyasya vāmake varuṇaṃ dakṣiṇe jānau apare vāyurucyate vinyasetsṛṣṭimūrtīnāṃ sṛṣṭi nyāsamudāhṛtam saṃhāramūrtināṃ caiva saṃhāra nyāsamucyate evaṃ nyāsavidhānena paścātpūjanamārabhet tālamātrapravistāraṃ tadardhaṃ cocchrayaṃ bhavet

mātrāṃgulena kartavyaṃ mekhaloccaṃ dvayāṃgulam pratimānāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ pīṭhe karmārcanaṃ yajet calaṃ caivācalaṃ caiva dvividhaṃ pratimaṃ bhavet śilābhirmṛṇmayairvāpi bhitticitre paṭe'pi vā śailajaṃ pratimaṃ caiva abhiṣekaṃ tu kārayet lohajaṃ pratimaṃ caiva snāpayetprokṣayettu vā pīṭhe saṃpūjayettatra parivāra samanvitam kevalaṃ sthāpita idamanyacchṛṇuṣvatha parivāraṃ na kartavyaṃ śrībilvaṃ ca na kārayet vīrāsanaṃ tadūrdhve tu kalpayeddeśikottamaḥ niṣkalāśritaṃ yattu āsanāvaraṇāyutam pratimānāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ tiṣṭhantadyenameva vā āsīnastatra sakalaṃ pūjayettu viśeṣataḥ anyarūpaṃ na kartavyaṃ kartavyaṃ cedvināśanam vastramābharaṇaṃ caiva kṣālayecchuddhirucyate vastraṃ datvā tvaghoreṇa gandhaṃ vai śirasā dadet dīpaṃ sadyena dadyāttu hṛdayena havirdadet pūrvoktena krameṇaiva garbhāvaraṇakaṃ yajet evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ sarvapāpādvimucyate sakalārādhanaṃ proktaṃ vighneśasthāpanaṃ śṛṇu iti vīratantre sakalārādhanavidhiḥ saptapaṃcāśaḥ paṭalaḥ guruvaktrāttu vijñeyaṃ anyathā naiva kathyate īśādisadyaparyantaṃ uddharettu yathā kramam cakraṃ trayodaśaṃ grāhya paṃcadaśa samanvitam vāsavasya caturthaṃ ca śūlādyaṃ ca tataḥ param

vajraṃ tena samāyuktaṃ īśānasya tṛtīyakam tadeva punaruddhṛtya agnibījena vā yutam varuṇasya tṛtīyaṃ tu vāsavena samanvitam vajradvitīyasaṃyuktaṃ varuṇasya tu paṃcamam tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi bhagavanvaktumarhasi tatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana ! lokadravyādbubhukṣante eteṣāṃ vighnāya pūjayet prāsādaṃ kārayettatra śāstradaṣṭena karmaṇā vyomavyāpi japitvā tu karṣayeddeśikottamaḥ pakṣe santi ca sarvāṇi gogaṇānāṃ nivedayet darpaṇodaravatkṛtvā gomayenānulepayet pūrvokte caiva nakṣatre yoge ca karaṇānvite dvārasya dakṣiṇe pārśve prathameṣṭāṃ tu vinyaset śilābhiriṣṭakābhirvā dārumṛdbhirathāpi vā navahastaṃ paṃcahastaṃ vā trihastaṃ vāpi kārayet prāsādasyavaśādvidvā prākāraṃ kārayettataḥ paṃcatālottamaṃ viddhi catustālaṃ tu madhyamam ṣoḍaśāṃśe vibhajyaṃ tu upānamekabhāgikam ekena paṭṭikāṃ kuryād grīvā caiva triyaṃśakam pīṭhotsedhaṃ caturbhāgaṃ padmamūrdhve prakalpayet uttamaṃ lohajaṃ proktaṃ madhyamaṃ tu śilāmayam sauvarṇaṃ caiva saubhāgyaṃ mokṣārthī rajataṃ bhavet calitaṃ lohajaṃ caiva ratnajaṃ dārujaṃ tu vā sthāpitaṃ tu parārthaṃ syādanyadātyārthamucyate gajānanaṃ gajakarṇaṃ lambodaraṃ tathaiva ca

teṣāṃ caiva tu mūrtīnāṃ svanāmādyakṣarairyutam tasya yantraṃ vadāmīha sarvāśubhanivāraṇam likhitvāṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ kesarāsya sakarṇakam vinyasedaṣṭapatreṣu aṣṭamūrtyakṣarānbudhaḥ pūjayettu viśeṣeṇa mūlamantreṇa homayet sarvaroga (haraṃ hyetat) siṃhadṛṣṭagajaṃ yathā rohiṇyādityapuṣyeṣu hastapauṣṇatriruttarā sthirarāśau tu kartavyaṃ ubharāśāvathāpi vā āsīnaṃ vā sthitaṃ vāpi vāhanārūḍhameva vā nānābharaṇa saṃyuktaṃ nāgayajñopavītinam paṃcatālena kuryāttu pratimāṃ kārayecchubhām pādoccaṃ tu dvibhāgaṃ tu kuryātpratimamuttamam vāme pāśasamāyuktaṃ dakṣiṇe cākṣasūtrakam evaṃ lakṣaṇa saṃyuktaṃ pratimāṃ kārayedbudhaḥ ṣaḍbhujenaiva kartavyaṃ paracakra jayecchatā madhyamaṃ caturaṃśena trayaṃśamadhamaṃ bhavet tāla saṃkhyākramaṃ vakṣye adhamaṃ tālamucyate yajamānecchayā yuktaṃ śilpinā kārayettataḥ kāmadaṃ mokṣaphaladaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam śuddhasnānamanuprāpya śuddhiṃ kṛtvā tato budhaḥ akārādi kṣakārāntā nyakṣarāṇi vilekhayet dvivargasya tṛtīyaṃ tu prathamasya caturthakam mūlamaṃtramidaṃ proktaṃ vighneśvarasya padmaja ! eteṣāṃ sthāpaneṣūktaṃ vibhavasyānurūpataḥ prāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryānmaṇṭapaṃ caturaśrakam

stambhaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryuktaṃ paṃktimānamathocchrayaḥ kramukaṃ veṇudaṇḍaṃ vā avakraṃ nirvraṇaṃ tathā madhyame vedikāṃ kuryāt paritaḥ kuṇḍamucyate vajraṃ pūrve tu vinyasya āgneyyāṃ tu pravālakam vāruṇyāṃ padmarāgaṃ tu vaiḍūryaṃ vāyugocare madhyame caiva māṇikyaṃ vinyasettu viśeṣataḥ tato devaṃ samāyojya hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ evameva prakartavyaṃ lohajānāṃ viśeṣataḥ nayanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana ! nayanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ kuryāt pūrvokte maṇṭape śubhe aṣṭadroṇaiśca śālībhiḥ tadardhaistaṇḍulairapi tatraiva pratimāṃ sthāpya pūrvābhimukhameva vā abhitaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau vinyasettoyapūritān gandhapuṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca hṛdinā pūjayettataḥ akṣihomaṃ tataḥ kuryādājyenaiva tu deśikaḥ aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā pūrṇāhutimathācaret padmarekhāṃ samālikhya tanmadhye kṛṣṇamaṇḍalam hemapūrvaṃ tathā caiva madhvājyaṃ vinyasettataḥ madhuvāteti mantreṇamadhunā tarpayettataḥ gaṇānāṃ ceti mantreṇa savatsāṃgāṃ pradarśayet prokṣayedbrāhmaṇāstatra sākṣataṃ sakuśodakam prokṣayetkalaśānvipra ! paṃcabrahmeṇa saṃyutam geyanṛttasamāyuktaṃ jayaśabdaissamanvitam paṃcamṛtpaṃcagavyaiśca paṃcāṃgaiśca samanvitam rathevā śibikāyāṃ vā pratimāṃ ropya bhaktitaḥ

pratimāṃ paṃcagavyena snāpayeddhṛdayena tu mūlamantreṇa viprendra ! jale caivādhivāsanam abhitaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau vidyeśvara samanvitān ekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā paṃcarātramathāpi vā jalāduttīrya pūrvedyuḥ śuddhiṃ kṛtvā tu deśikaḥ navavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya mūlamantreṇa deśikaḥ śālyardhaṃ taṇḍulaṃ nyasya taṇḍulārdhaṃ tilaṃ nyaset anḍajaṃ muṇḍajaṃ caiva romajaṃ carmajaṃ tathā tasyopari nyasedbījaṃ kūrcenaiva samanvitam abhitaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau vinyasenmūrtisaṃyutān savastrānsāpidhānāṃśca sahiraṇyānsakūrcakān vighneśaṃ tatra saṃsthāpya mūlamantreṇa deśikaḥ lokapālāṃśca kumbhāni vinyasetpūrvameva ca vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā sarvakuṇḍāni kārayet plakṣāśvatthaṃ ca nyagrodhaṃ bilvaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ pālāśaṃ caiva viprendra ! navakuṇḍeṣu homayet sarveṣāmapyalābhe tu palāśasamidhā yutam kadalīphalasaṃyuktaṃ homayeddeśikottamaḥ hṛdayaṃ ca śiraścaiva śikhāmantreṇa hūyate hutvā hutvā spṛśedbimbaṃ dravyaṃ prati viśeṣataḥ laḍḍukaṃ nālikeraṃ ca mātuluṃgaphalāni ca caturdikṣu caturvedaiḥ kuryādadhyayanaṃ tataḥ snānavedyāṃ samānīya snāpayenmūlamantrataḥ śilādīnsthāpayedvidvāndeśe'pi tu pade'pi ca yajanaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva caturānana !

prāṇāyāmaṃ carettatra paścādbrahmāṇi vinyaset hṛdayātpaṃca vinyasya vighneśaṃ hṛdaye nyaset pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ gandhapuṣpaṃ ca dhūpakam tato lohajaberaṃ cet snātvā parvaṇi parvaṇi mṛṇmaye bhitticitre vā pīṭhe karmārcanaṃ bhavet siṃhaṃ padmaṃ ca vimalaṃ yathā krameṇa vinyaset caturbhujaṃ triṇetraṃ ca prasannavadanānvitam nirmālyaṃ ca visṛjyātha śikhāmantreṇa deśikaḥ puṣpaṃ vai śikhayā caiva vāmo dhūpaṃ ca dīpakam bhakṣyaṃ caiva gaṇānāṃtvā evameva krameṇa tu puruṣaṃ pūrvadeśe tu aghoraṃ dakṣiṇena tu īśānyāmīśamantraṃ tu āgneyyāṃ hṛdayaṃ nyaset īśānyāṃ ca śiraścaiva netramastraṃ diśāsu ca śukraṃ bṛhaspatiṃ caiva aśvinyau ca tathaiva ca śāstā caiva tu durgā ca pradakṣiṇe krameṇa tu vibudhamīśadigbhāge nirmālyaṃ dhārakaṃ nyaset pūrvoktena vidhānena agnimukhaṃ ca kalpayet saptāhutiṃ ca vighneśaṃ mūlamantreṇa deśikaḥ nityotsavaṃ tataḥ kuryādvighneśa pratimānvitam brahmacārī śucirbhūtvā soṣṇīssottarīyakaḥ pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā ālayaṃ tu praveśayet utsavaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana prāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryānmaṇṭapaṃ kārayettataḥ mudgamāṣa samāyuktaṃ sarṣapena samanvitam sugupte sthāpayettatra dhvajārohaṇamārabhet

vistāreṇa samaṃ pucchaṃ tadardhaṃ śikharaṃ bhavet yaṣṭinā saṃghaṭitvā tu dhvajamāropayettataḥ yāgasya maṇṭapaṃ kṛtvā īśe vā cāgnigocare paṃcaṣaṭsaptahastairvā ṣoḍaśastambha saṃyutam vedibāhye tu paritaḥ paṃcakuṇḍāni kārayet vedīmadhye nyasecchālīṃ darbhaiścaiva paristaret abhitaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau vinyasecchālimadhyame sa vastrānsāpidhānāṃśca sa hiraṇyānsakūrcakān samidājyacaruṃ lājān apūpena samanvitam gaṇānāṃceti hutvā tu pūrṇāhutiṃ yadasya ca śūlaṃ para"'sukhaḍgaṃ ca daṇḍaṃ padmaṃ ca saṃyutam prathamaṃ bhūtarātraṃ tu dvitīyaṃ gandhamucyate siddhānāṃ paṃcamaṃ proktaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ rākṣasamucyate paṃcāhaṃ ṛṣirātrādi siddhāditryahaṃ bhavet kautukaṃ balidānānte kuryādgrāma pradakṣiṇam snapayetkalaśaṃ tatra hṛdayena tu deśikaḥ sādhitaiḥ kalaśaistatra snāpayenmūlaberakam prāgagraṃ tu catussūtraṃ udagagraṃ tathaiva ca pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ kalaśānnyasya vittamaḥ dvitīyāvaraṇe caiva vidyeśvarāṃśca daivatān pradhāna kumbhe svarṇasya pādyaṃ pūrve tu vinyaset nair-ṛtyāṃ gandhatoyaṃ ca vāruṇyāṃ tu kuśodakam īśānyāṃ dadhi saṃyuktaṃ prathamāvaraṇānvite rajanī cūrṇaṃ tu kadalītilasarṣapa saṃyutam nāraṃgasya dvayaṃ caiva dvitīyāvaraṇe tathā

evaṃ vai snapanaṃ kuryāt sarvaśāntikaraṃ param sthāpane paṃcaniṣkaṃ tu utsave tu dviniṣkakam mūrtipānparivārāṇāṃ yathā śaktyā tu dakṣiṇā iti vīratantre vighneśasthāpanārcanasnapanotsavavidhiraṣṭapaṃcāśaḥ paṭalaḥ guruvaktrāttu vijñeyamanyathā naiva kathyate īśādi sadyaparyantaṃ uddharettu yathākramam cakraṃ trayodaśaṃ grāhya paṃcādaśa samanvitam vāsavasya caturthaṃ tu śūlādyaṃ tu yathā tathā vajrāntena samāyuktaṃ īśānasya tṛtīyakam tadeva punaruddhṛtya agnibījordhvavāsavam varuṇasya tṛtīyaṃ tu vāsavena samanvitam vajrāddvitīyasaṃyuktaṃ varuṇasya tu paṃcamam vāsavasya caturthaṃ tu śaṃkarānyamataḥ param somasyaiva dvitīyaṃ tu ṣoḍaśena samanvitam * * * * * * * * punastadbīja saṃyutam varuṇāpati saṃgrāhya cakrasyāntena saṃyutam gadāvāyostukaṃ dvitīya sthānena samanvitam puruhūtadvitīyaṃ tu pūrvoktena samanvitam mārutādyaṃ samuddhṛtya cakrāmudrā * * * * mārutasya dvitīyāntaṃ vahnāvāsava saṃyutam anilasya paṃcamenaiva vāsavasya dvitīyakam dhanadasya caturthena yuktaṃ cakratrayodaśam śaṃkarasya dvitīyāntaṃ varuṇādyena saṃyutam dvitīyāntavāsavasyāntaṃ vāsavasya trayodaśam somāntaṃ tu daśāntena pavanasya caturthakam

īśānasya tṛtīyaṃ tu vāsavena samanvitam vahnibījordhva * * * dvāsavena samanvitam ekādaśena saṃyuktaṃ mārutasya caturthakam jalādhipa caturthāntaṃ vāsavennaṃ samanvitam īśānasya tṛtīyaṃ tu vāsa * * * śāntakam vahnibīja samāyuktaṃ vāsavena samanvitam anilaṃ tu samuddhṛtya vāsavaikādaśena tu ṣoḍaśena samāyuktaṃ ghoraṃ sarvārthakāmadam dhanadasya ca caturthaṃ tu vajrāntena samanvitam varuṇāntaṃ samuddhṛtya vāsavaikādaśena ca gadāyudhaṃ samuddhṛtya vāsavena samanvitam pavanaṃ gṛhya * * * * * nte naiva bhūṣitam śūlasyāntaṃ samuddhṛtya khaḍgāntasyādadhastataḥ varuṇasya paṃcamaṃ gṛhya vāsavena samanvitam gadāntāntāṃ samuddhṛtya vajrapaṃcamabhūṣitam vajrāntena tu saṃyuktaṃ gadāvāsava saṃyutam pavanasya paṃcamaṃ grāhya ṣoḍaśena samāyutam somāntāntaṃ samuddhṛtya vajrāntena samanvitam īśasya paṃcamaṃ grāhya vajreṇaiva samanvitam vahniṃ caiva samuddhṛtya vāsavena samanvitam kuberasya caturthaṃ tu * va tasya tṛtīyakam candrāntaṃ tu samuddhṛtya cakreṇaiva samāyutam kuberāntaṃ samuddhṛtya indrādyena samāyutam aṃkuśasya tṛtīyaṃ tu vajreṇaiva samāyutam candrasyaiva caturthaṃ tu vajrāntena samāyutam

kuberāntaṃ vāsavenaiva khaḍgaṃ caiva tu paṃcamam pāśasya paṃcamaṃ grāhya vāsavena samanvitam vāsavena samāyuktaṃ vāyupaṃcamameva ca varuṇasya paṃcamaṃ paścād vajreṇaiva samāyutam īśānāntaṃ samuddhṛtya vajreṇaiva vibhūṣitam agnibījaṃ tatordhvaṃ tu vāsavena samāyutam analasya paṃcamaṃ paścād vajreṇaiva samāyutam pavanasya caturthaṃ tu vāsavena samanvitam sadyādīśānāṃ ca dharmakāmārthamokṣadam brahmoddhāramidaṃ proktaṃ vijayaṃ maṇḍalaṃ śṛṇu iti vīratantre brahmoddhāravidhirekonaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ vijayamaṇḍalamevaṃ tu brūhi me śaśibhūṣaṇa ! sarvapūjāphalaṃ caiva sarvayajña pitāmaha ! sṛṣṭuvanāmanuṣṭhābhiḥ brahmaṇaḥ padadāyikā vijayāpatimanuṣubhiḥ sarvānisya sādhanam viprakṣatriyaviṭchūdrairanyajātistu varjayet paṃcagavyena saṃsnāpya mahā havirnivedayet prāsādasya purobhāge gomayenānulepayet vaiśyasyāṣṭāṃgulaṃ caiva śūdrāṇāṃ ca ṣaḍaṃgulam maṇḍalaṃ tatra madhye tu padapuṣpaṃ tu vinyaset maṇḍalaṃ tatra vinyasya sahasraṃ vā tadardhakam nityaṃ triṃśapaścatamā vāṣṭottaraṃ śatam evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā pūrvarukṣaṃ samuddharet yathā śraddhānukālasya nityaṃ maṇḍalapūjanam pālikā ghaṭikā caiva śarāvaṃ ca yathākramam

aṣṭadroṇena śālīnāṃ tadardhaṃ taṇḍulaṃ bhavet aṃkurānarpayitvā tu jvaladbhirdīpasaṃyutam adhamaṃ caikasandhyāyāṃ nityaṃ dīpasamāyutam evaṃ saptadinaṃ kuryād rātrau caivādhivāsayet ṣoḍaśastambhasaṃyuktaṃ caturdvāra samanvitam umā maheśakumbhaṃ tu mūla bimbaṃ tu pūjayet sthaṇḍilaṃ tu tadūrdhve tu kuṃbhaṃ caiva tu vinyaset uśīraṃ candanaṃ caiva karpūraṃ caiva kuṃkumam homayettu viśeṣeṇa sarvadravya samāyutam sa sūtra kūrcasaṃyuktaṃ pūjayettu viśeṣataḥ prabhāte vimale kuryātsnānaṃ kṛtvā tu deśikaḥ nṛttageyasamāyuktaṃ stotramaṃgalavācakaiḥ snapanaṃ tu tataḥ kuryādyathā śāstroktamārgataḥ devānāṃ svarṇapaṭṭaṃ tu umāhe matsya maṃgalam sthalikā daṇḍighaṇṭā ca mahāghaṇṭāṃ tu dāpayet saptamaṇḍalamālikhya saptalokānsupūjayet maṇḍalaṃ tu pṛthakkuryāt pratyekaṃ prasthaśālinā svarṇaparvatamevaṃ tu lavaṇaṃ parvameva vā mudgaparvatamevaṃ tu saptaparvatameva vā ācāryaṃ pūjayetpūrvaṃ vastrāṃgulīyakādibhiḥ uttamaṃ tu triniṣkaṃ tu ācāryasya tu dakṣiṇā sarvaṃ māheśvarairyuktaṃ bāhujānāṃ tu pūjayet vastraṃ dhānyaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ candanaṃ dāpayettadā sarvānamāvṛtaṃ kuryāttadgṛhaṃ praviśettataḥ ārdrāyāṃ caiva nakṣatre deveśaṃ pūjayettataḥ

kulaikaviṃśamuddhṛtya śivalokaṃ sa gacchati iti vīratantre vijayamaṇḍalavidhiḥ ṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ tatsarvaṃ brūhi me nātha ! śrotumicchāmyahaṃ prabho śailajaṃ ratnajaṃ caiva dhātujaṃ dārujaṃ tathā caturvidhaṃ tu śailaṃ syātsaptadhā ratnajaṃ tathā mṛṇmayaṃ dvividhaṃ proktaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ saptadhocyate śailajaṃ liṃgamākhyātaṃ dravyasya lakṣaṇamucyate suśvetaṃ ca samākhyātaṃ jayadaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam śilālakṣaṇa saṃyuktaṃ dhanadhānya sukhapradam bhṛṃgamudgasamākāraṃ pūja * * karī smṛtā viprakṣatriyavaiśyānāṃ api dhānyasamṛddhidā śvetā prātipadā proktā brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ marakataṃ puṣparāgaṃ ca nīlaṃ caiva tu ratnajā ākarṣaṇe tu vaiḍūryaṃ sphaṭikaṃ putravṛddhidam nī * * * raṇe kārye ratnajānāṃ phalaṃ bhavet tāmraṃ putrasamṛddhyarthaṃ kāṃsyaṃ vidveṣakārakam sīsakaṃ rogakaraṇaṃ * * māyuṣyavardhanam devadāru śamīvṛkṣaṃ pippalaṃ candanaṃ tathā madhūkapadmaḍuṇḍūka karṇikārastathaiva ca ete vargāstu catvāro dvijātikramayogataḥ saikataṃ gomayaṃ cānnaṃ paiṣṭaṃ gaulaṃ phalaṃ tathā saikataṃ mokṣakāmānāṃ gomayaṃ roganāśanam gaulaṃ prītipradaṃ proktaṃ phalamiṣṭārtha siddhidam kṣaṇikānāṃ tu liṃgānāṃ na kuryātpīṭhabandhanam prayāṇakāśakra nānāntu śubhāśubhaparīkṣakāḥ

dhvajaṃ ca bherī murajaṃ śubhāni sarvaśatru patitākṣaya pīḍā yātragaśubhaṃ satatā sunimittaṃ bhavedgacched durnimittamahe sthitiḥ yasmindeśe tathā kṛtvā prāṅmukhaḥ sa pathi sthitaḥ yātatapāsthigandhāṃśca saṃkṣinnākṣara vāriṇi vakrāścarkarāpyaṃ ca ka ikṣāṃ jharjharīdarīm sūtra pādavadākāro rekhāmiva tridhā smṛtā veṇuṃkaravadākāraṃ lūtāpādasamāyutā kalaṃka kṛṣṇarogābhaṃ kṛṣṇābhūka sannibham trāsaṃ sphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ śuktibhyānnarasannibhā jambūphalasamākārā snānacūccakasaṃnibhā vimalaṃ hemasadṛśaṃ kāṃsyaṃ lohasya saṃnibham kṛṣṇe kṛṣṇāni naśyanti śvete kṛṣṇa sugandhitā kharjūrapatra * * * dūrvāstambākṛtiḥ śubhā kālakaṃ rogadaṃ jñeyaṃ trāsaraṃ rāṣṭravardhanam darī vināśayordhānyaṃ hanti tanmale * * * ekavarṇāśilā grāhyā bhuktimuktipradāyikā strīpuṃ napuṃsakā śailā bālā vṛddhā tu madhyamā ghaṇṭāśabdāttu pulliṃgāḥ svarahīnā napuṃsakāḥ dīrghaśabdata yā vṛddhā hṛsvā bālā iti smṛtāḥ pādādhānaśilāṃ kuryānnapuṃsakena viśeṣataḥ yasyagarbha gṛhārdhaṃ tu liṃgaṃ kanyasamucyate paṃcabhāgaṃ tribhāgaṃ tu uttamaṃ liṃgamucyate śrīpradaṃ caiva sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ rājyadaṃ bhavet roganāśamidaṃ jñeyaṃ paittalaṃ liṃgamucyate

aṃgulyādīva tasyāntaṃ sarveṣāṃ jātirucyate sphaṭikaṃ marakataṃ caiva māṇikyaṃ padmarāgakam indranīlaṃ puṣparāgaṃ vajraṃ caiva tu kārayet svayoniṃ pauṣṭikaṃ jñeyaṃ anyoktaṃ mokṣakāmadam ratnānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ dhātujaṃ pīṭhamucyate liṃgatāratribhāgaṃ tu pīṭhavistāramucyate vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā ṣoḍaśāṃśena bhājitam padmatuṇḍaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ dvayaṃśaṃ valayaṃ bhavet evaṃ pīṭhaṃ samākhyātaṃ stvānāṃ phalamucyate māṇikyaṃ muktidaṃ jñeyaṃ padmarāgaṃ dhanārthakam vaiḍūryamāyurvṛddhiḥ syādrāṣṭravaśyaṃ pravālakam evameva krameṇaiva jñeyaṃ ratnasya lakṣaṇam evaṃ dvividhamākhyātaṃ calasthāpanakaṃ śṛṇu hastā ca revatī caiva svātī caiva triruttarā prāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryānmaṇḍapaṃ caturaśrakam śālināsthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā tasyordhve pālikā nyaset navāhairvāpi saptāhaiḥ paṃcāhairvā viśeṣataḥ pratiṣṭhā maṇṭapaṃ kṛtvā pūrvakalpaṃ tu vittamaḥ udyāne śuddhadeśe tu gṛhe vāpi viśeṣataḥ ṣoḍaśastambha saṃyuktaṃ madhyame vedikā bhavet yāvadaśraṃ bhavetpīṭhaṃ tāvadaśraṃ tu kuṇḍakam maṇṭapaṃ bhūṣayedvidvān pūrvoktena vidhānataḥ puṣpamālyairalaṃ kṛtya kuryādgrāmapradakṣiṇam praviśenmaṇṭapaṃ tatra jale caivādhivāsayet savastrānsahiraṇyāṃśca vidyeśvara samanvitān

jalāduttīrya pūrvedyuḥ liṃgaṃ prakṣālayettataḥ śuddhiṃ kṛtvā viśeṣeṇa puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ tadardhaṃ taṇḍulaṃ nyasya taṇḍulārdhaṃ tilaṃ nyaset śayanaṃ paṃcadhā kalpya yathā pūrvoktamārgataḥ muṇḍajaṃ tu dukūlaṃ vā kārpāsikamathāpi vā vṛkṣatvacāca kartavyaṃ carmajaṃ tu vidhīyate śayane śāyayeddevaṃ prāsādena tu mantrataḥ prākāraṃ paścime pīṭhaṃ śayane śāyayeddhṛdā śuddhodakena saṃpūrya śarāveṇa pidhāya ca dvārakalaśaṃ vinyasya dvārapālānsamarcayet sthāpayedvidhinā vipra ! svasvanāmnā viśeṣataḥ vardhanīṃ gauribījena vinyaseddeśikottamaḥ daśāyudhaṃ prakartavyaṃ svarṇenaiva tu deśikaḥ vidyeśvarānnyasettatra svasvanāmnā ca mantrataḥ naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ dadyād hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ samidājya caruṃ lājānsarṣapāṃśca yavāṃstilān samidho hīśamantreṇa puruṣeṇājyameva ca sarṣapaṃ sadya mantreṇa hṛdayena yavaṃ tathā ghṛtamikṣetiṃ mantreṇa ghṛtaṃ caiva tu hūyate rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ tatra svapnāni ca parīkṣayet ekāgniṃ vātha paṃcāgniṃ kuryādvai deśikottamaḥ homaṃ na kārayedvidvān samidājya caruṃ vinā sarvadravya samāyuktaṃ havyavāhaṃ samuccaran hutvānte tu yadasyeti juhuyāttu viśeṣataḥ mantranyāsoktamārgeṇa nyāsaṃ kṛtvā tato budhaḥ

snāpayecchivakumbhaṃ tu vardhanīmapi piṇḍikām snapanaṃ kārayettatra śatāṣṭaṃ paṃcāśadeva tu paṃcavarṇahavirdadyāt tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥ evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokamavāpnuyāt calaliṃga sthāpanaṃ proktamumayā sahitaṃ śṛṇu iti vīratantre calaliṃga pratiṣṭhāṃvidhiḥ eka ṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ sṛṣṭimūrtipratiṣṭhāṃ tu brūhi me parameśvara ! umāskandahitaṃ caiva sukhāsanaṃ tathaiva ca gaṃgādharaṃ ca paṃcaite sṛṣṭirūpamihocyate pratirūpasargaṃ pūjā ca tiṣṭhā gati nivṛtti ca yamarohiṇyāditya puṣyendu hasta pauṣṇa triruttarā sthirarāśau prakartavyaṃ ubharāśāvathāpi vā pratiṣṭhā nakṣatra pūrve tu aṃkurānarpayettataḥ prāsādasyāgrataścaiva maṇḍapaṃ kārayettataḥ ekādaśa dvādaśakaraṃ trayodaśakaraṃ tathā ṛṣicchando devatānāṃ vakṣyāmi surasattama ! bhāradvājo bhṛguścaiva tathāṃgirasagautamāḥ tṛṣṭup cānuṣṭup ca * * * * * prakṛtistathā uttamottamamevaṃ tu chandasānāṃ vidhīyate vighneśaśca kuberaśca brahmā viṣṇurmaheśvaraḥ kramād jñātvā tu viprendra ! kārayedvidhi pūrvakam dāruṇā ca prakartavyaṃ śilpinā lakṣaṇairyutam āsanaṃ cāpi vṛkṣaṃ vā kramukaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tu vā avakraṃ nirvraṇaṃ caiva puṣakoṭara varjitam kūṭaṃ vā maṇṭapaṃ vāpi prapāṃ vāpi ca kārayet

evaṃ vai maṇṭapaṃ kṛtvā madhye vediṃ tu kalpayet caturaśrārdhacandraṃ ca vṛttaṃ padmaṃ tathaiva ca īśāna indrayormadhye ṣaṭkoṇamiti kathyate umāsahitamevoktaṃ ekāsanasthite'pi ca caturaśraṃ ca yoniṃ ca trikoiṇaṃ vṛttameva vā īśāna indrayormadhye saptakoṇaṃ tu kārayet pūrvādīśāccaturdikṣu vedāśraṃ kuṇḍamucyate kalyāṇa sundaraṃ proktaṃ candraśekharamucyate koṇeṣu vṛttakuṇḍaṃ tu śivāgniṃ cāṣṭakoṇakam sukhāsanavaddikṣvaṣṭau śivāgniṃ cāṣṭakoṇakam ekāsanasthitādevyā yonyākāraṃ vidikṣu vai vitānaiścordhvamācchādya aṣṭadikṣu dhvajānnyaset dhvajamadhye likhitvā tu aṣṭadikṣu ca vinyaset tṛtīyaṃ pratimāśuddhiḥ caturthaṃ grāmapradakṣiṇam saptamaṃ śayanaṃ caiva aṣṭamaṃ homameva ca daśarimaṃmiha proktaṃ teṣāṃ bhedaṃ śṛṇuṣvatha gomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā śālinā vikirettataḥ paristarettu darbhaiśca navavastreṇa chāditam brāhmike tu nyasedvajraṃ indranīlaṃ tu pūrvataḥ nair-ṛtyāṃ puṣparāgaṃ tu mauktikaṃ vāruṇe nyaset īśānyāṃ tu mahānīlaṃ evaṃ devasya vinyaset caturdikṣu ca madhye ca svarṇāni nikṣipettataḥ pratimāṃ kṣālayettatra āmvenaṃ vāriṇā punaḥ ādityasya pade caiva netramokṣaṇamucyate taṇḍulaṃ ca tadardhaṃ ca tadardhaṃ tilameva ca

umā skandasahitaṃ nyasya tasyopari viśeṣataḥ tāmrapātre'thavā kāṃsye madhvājyaṃ caiva nikṣipet abhitaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau pūrvādīśāntaṃ vinyaset sasūtrānsāpidhānāṃśca lokapālādhidevatān kṛṣṇamaṇḍalamālikhya jyotirmaṇḍalamālikhet suvarṇanakha saṃyuktaṃ hemadūrvā samanvitam akṣihomaṃ tataḥ kuryāt tasyāgre tu viśeṣataḥ pūrvoktenaiva mārgeṇa agnimukhaṃ ca kārayet aṣṭottaraśatenaiva pratyekaṃ hūyate kramāt madhyame skandamevaṃ tu skandamantreṇa hūyate svarṇena nakhadūrveṇamadhvājyaṃ tu tarpayet ghṛtamikṣeti mantreṇa ghṛtaṃ caivaṃ tu tarpayet brāhmaṇāndarśayettatra brahmajajñānamantrataḥ darśayedbrahmacārīṃśca skandasyaiva tu deśikaḥ āpohiṣṭheti saṃprokṣya arghya saṃyutameva ca paṃcagavya samāyuktaṃ abhiṣekaṃ tu kārayet śuddhairuttheti mantreṇa śuddhodakena snāpayet grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt sarvālaṃkārasaṃyutam gītavādya samāyuktaṃ śaṃkhakāhala saṃyutam nānābhaktajanaissārdhaṃ kuryādgrāmapradakṣiṇam nadītaṭākatīre vā hrade gatvā viśeṣataḥ śālinā sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā pratimāṃ tatra vinyaset navavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya kūrcenaiva samanvitam caturdvāra samāyuktaṃ prapāṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥ sa vastrānsāpidhānāṃśca vidyeśvara samanvitān

ekarātraṃ tritātraṃ vā paṃcarātramathāpi vā vāstuhomaṃ divā kuryāllakṣaṇena samanvitam ālayaṃ praviśettatra puṣpadantapade sthitaḥ gaurībījena devyātha guhaṃ vai skandabījataḥ uśīraṃ candanaṃ caiva elālavaṃga saṃyutam tato'dhivāsanaṃ kuryāllakṣaṇena samanvitam tadardhaṃ taṇḍulaṃ nyasya taṇḍulārdhaṃ tilaṃ nyaset toraṇānarcayettatra dvārakumbhāṃśca vinyaset savastrānsāpidhānāṃśca lokapālādhidevatān śayanaṃ paṃcabhiḥ kalpya aṇḍajādyairanukramāt kṣaumaṃ kārpāsajaṃ vāyaṃ muṇḍajasyeti kīrtitam vṛkṣatvacānukartavyaṃ carmajaṃ tadvidhīyate paṃcabrahmeṇa mantreṇa śayanaṃ paṃca kalpayet pracchādanena saṃyuktaṃ śayane śāyayecchivam prākśiraḥ paścime pādaṃ vinyaseddeśikottamaḥ navakumbhānsamādāya trisūtrairveṣṭayettataḥ paṃcaratna samāyuktaṃ vastrayugmena veṣṭayet paṃcabrahmeṇa saṃyuktaṃ śivakumbhaṃ ca vinyaset skandakumbhaṃ nyasenmadhye skandamūlena mantrataḥ sa vastrānsāpidhānāṃśca sahiraṇyānsakūrcakān ambikāṃ ca umādevīṃ īśapatnīṃ tathaiva ca prajñāṃ cāgasutāṃ caiva pārvatī ca tathaiva ca kumāraṃ ca guhaṃ caiva subrahmaṇyaṃ tathaiva ca śaravaṇodbhavaṃ caiva kārtikeyaṃ ca vinyaset gandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca svasvabījena pūjayet

elālavaṃgakarpūra timbujātīphalaṃ muram vardhanyāṃ sudakumbheṣu evameva kramānnyaset tato homaṃ prakurvīta lakṣaṇena samanvitam paścime cakravṛkṣastu udumbaraṃ tu cottare śamī caiva apāmārgaṃ bilvavṛkṣa samanvitam soma īśānayormadhye palāśa samidhā tathā mudgaṃ māṣaṃ ca viprendra ! navadravyamihocyate aghoreṇa caruṃ hutvā lājaṃ tatpuruṣeṇa tu śirasā ca tilaṃ hutvā śivamantreṇa mudgakam triyambakena mantreṇa caruṃ caiva tu hūyate evaṃ krameṇa hotavyaṃ tattanmantreṇa deśikaḥ dravyaṃ prati viśeṣeṇa hotavyaṃ deśikottamaḥ dravyānte caiva dravyānte pratimāṃ saṃspṛśettataḥ caturdikṣu caturvedaṃ kuryādadhyayanaṃ tataḥ paścime camakaṃ prācyāṃ pavamānaṃ tathottare māheśvara samāyuktaṃ nṛttaṃ kṛtvā tu bhaktitaḥ sviṣṭamagneti mantreṇa juhuyāttadanantare tataḥ prabhāte vimale snānaṃ kṛtvā tu deśikaḥ sṛṣṭirūpa pratiṣṭhāyāṃ sṛṣṭinyāsamudāhṛtam samidājyacaruṃ lājān datvā paṃcadaśāhutiḥ ājyaṃ sadyena hotavyaṃ hṛdayena caruṃ hunet anyairhomaṃ na kartavyaṃ ācāryeṇaiva hūyate hutvānte tu yadasyeti pūrṇāhuti mathācaret ācāryadakṣiṇāṃ dadyādyathā śāstrokta mārgataḥ paṃcāṃgabhūṣaṇaṃ dadyāt śikhākarṇe gale tathā

adhamaṃ daśaniṣkaṃ tu madhyamaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet tadardhamupadeṣṭā ca vāstuhomaṃ tadardhakam daivajñadviguṇaṃ tasya dakṣiṇāṃ dāpayettataḥ paryaṣṭi parivārāṇāṃ yathā śaktyā tu dakṣiṇā sumuhūrte sulagne ca devamutthāpayettataḥ ghṛtaṃ śirorpaṇaṃ kṛtvā hemadūrvāṃkurākṣataiḥ mantranyāsoktamārgeṇa paṃcabrahmeṇa saṃyutam brahmamaṃgena saṃyuktaṃ snāpayecchiva kumbhakam skandamūlena viprendra ! skandakumbhābhiṣecayet vardhanīṃ sthāpayeddevyāḥ sahāsanagate yadi snapanaṃ kārayettatra naivedyaṃ dāpayettataḥ bhojayetsaptakanyāśca brahmacārīṃśca bhojayet kāpālaṃ pāṃcarātraṃ ca ṣaḍaite samayāḥ smṛtāḥ śaivānsaṃbhojayettatra samayānbhojayettataḥ evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokamavāpnuyāt pratiṣṭhākaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ ācāryāya pradāpayet iti vīratantre sṛṣṭimūrtipratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ dvāṣaṣṭhitamaḥ paṭalaḥ vaktumarhasi deveśa anugrahārthaṃ prabho ! mama rohiṇī ca punavasve tiṣye mṛgaśirastathā sthirarāśau ca kartavyaṃ ubhayorapi kārayet ṛṣabhaṃ vāhanaṃ caiva ardhanārī tathaiva ca ete tu paṃcamūrtiśca sthitimūrtirudāhṛtā paṃcaṣaṭ saptahastaṃ vā aṣṭahastaṃ navaṃ tathā avakraṃ nirvraṇaṃ kṛtvā paṃktimānamathocchrayam dhvajamadhye likhettatra lokapālasya vāhanam

darbhamālābhirācchādya muktādāmairalaṃkṛtam pūrve tu caturaśraṃ tu agneraśvatthapatravat vṛttaṃ tu vāruṇe caiva vāyavyāṃ paṃcakoṇakam indraīśānayormadhye aṣṭakoṇaṃ tu kārayet īśāna indrayormadhye ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ nyaset pūrvādiṣu caturdikṣu kuṇḍaṃ syāccaturaśrakam ardhanārīśvaraṃ proktaṃ kirātārjunamucyate vṛttapaṃcāśrapadmaṃ ca saptakoṇāṣṭakoṇakam sahāsane tu viprendra ! āgneyādiṣu yonikam kirātārjunamevoktaṃ vīreśaṃ śṛṇu tatvataḥ aśvatthaṃ ca trikoṇaṃ ca paṃcāśraṃ cāṣṭakoṇakam saptakoṇaṃ bhavetkuṇḍaṃ vīreśamadhunocyate soma īśānayormadhye hariṇāṃ vṛttakuṇḍakam evameva krameṇaiva kuṇḍaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ratnanyāsaṃ prakartavyaṃ satyakasya pade'thavā navavastra samāyuktāṃ pratimāṃ tatra vinyaset indranīlaṃ ca vaiḍūryaṃ sphaṭikaṃ marakataṃ tu vā pūrvādiṣu nyasedetān paṃcabrahma samuccaran ardhanārīśvaraṃ caiva śivabhāge tu vinyaset nayanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ kuryān netrayugmayute dine śālyopari nyased devaṃ pracchannapaṭasaṃyutam śilpinaṃ pūjayet tatra śilpinaṃ tu visarjayet pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ kalaśānaṣṭa vinyaset hiraṇya nakhadūrvā ca ghṛtapātramapātrakam paṃcāṃgabhūṣaṇairyuktaḥ prokṣayet pratimāṃ tataḥ

ājyena caruṇā caiva netreṇaiva śatāhutiḥ madhvājyaṃ tarpayed dhīmān netramantrasamanvitam ghṛtamikṣe ghṛtaṃ tarpya savatsāṃgāṃ pradarśayet pracchannapaṭamāvarjya janān sarvān pradarśayet pavamānaṃ samuccārya paṃcagavyābhiṣecanam grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryād rathe vā śibike'pi vā nadītaṭākatīre vā gomayenānulepayet snāpayet paṃcagavyena vyomavyāpi samuccaran sa vastra paridhānena kūrcenaivacchādayet prapāṃ kṛtvā tu viprendra ! kalaśānaṣṭa vinyaset ekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā paṃcarātramathāpi vā vāstuhomaṃ divā kuryāllakṣaṇena samanvitam vyomavyāpi samuccārya snāpayedgandhatoyakaiḥ sarvagandhaṃ samāloḍhya lepayet pratimāṃ tataḥ śālinā vikiredbediṃ bhāradvaya samanvitam lājairdarbhaiśca vikired aṇḍajādīni kalpayet vastreṇaivordhvamācchādya vyomavyāpi ṣaḍaṃgakaiḥ sthāpayecchivakumbhaṃ tu vardhanīṃ sthāpayecchivam pūrvādīśāna paryantaṃ aṣṭakumbhānnyasettataḥ tasya bāhye tu parito lokapāla ghaṭānnyaset ekāsanastha devyāśca antarālāśca vardhanī aśvatthodumbaraplakṣavaṭaṃ pūrvādidikṣu ca gaurī vṛṣabha kuṇḍābhyāṃ palāśenaiva hūyate yavasarṣapa saṃyuktaṃ navadravyaṃ ca hūyate puruṣeṇa caruṃ hutvā lājānghoreṇa caiva hi

tilānvai śiromantreṇa aṣṭottaraśatāhutiḥ ādyākṣaraṃ tu hṛsvaṃ ca dīrghaṃ brahmāṃga mucyate dravyānte vyāhṛtiṃ hutvā sparśayetpratimāṃ tataḥ sthiti nyāya prakāreṇa nyāsaṃ kuryādviśeṣataḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ tato hutvā sarvadravya samanvitam īśānena tu mantreṇa kuryāt pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ upadeṣṭā mūrtipāṃścaiva padārthīn sarvāṃśca pūjayet sthitimārga prakāreṇa aṣṭatriṃśatkalaśān nyaset geyanṛttādisarvāṃśca prāsādaṃ ca pradakṣiṇam prāsādena pratiṣṭhāpya gandhapuṣpādinārcayet gandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya vastrairābharaṇairapi brāhmaṇānbhojayettatra śaivānsaṃbhojayettataḥ sthitimūrtiridaṃ proktaṃ saṃhārasthāpanaṃ śṛṇu iti vīratantre sthitimūrtipratiṣṭhā triṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ kiṃ vā saṃhāramūrtīnāṃ sthāpanaṃ parameśvara ! nṛttaṃ caiva tu kāmāri kāladāhaṃ tathaiva ca ṣaṣṭhe saṃhāramūrtīnāṃ sthāpanaṃ tviha cocyate haste ca revatī caiva svātī caiva triruttarā aṃkurānarpayet pūrvaṃ navāhe saptame'thavā dakṣiṇe cottare cāpi kārayellakṣaṇānvitam maṇṭapaṃ caiva viprendra ! ekāśītipadaṃ kuru tasya bāhye tu parito mānuṣe kuṇḍamucyate vṛttaṃ caiva ṣaḍaśraṃ ca padmaṃ saptāśrameva ca īśāna indrayormadhye aṣṭakoṇaṃ ca kārayet caturaśraṃ ca ṣaṭkoṇaṃ trikoṇaṃ paṃcakoṇakam

īśāna indrayormadhye saptakoṇaṃ tu kārayet tripuraghnaṃ tathā dikṣu catuṣkoṇaṃ trikoṇakam īśāna indrayormadhye saptāśraṃ kārayettataḥ satyakasya pade caiva ratnanyāsaṃ tu kārayet tasyoparinyaseddevaṃ ṣaṇṇavatyaṃ viśeṣataḥ puṣṭikaṃ padmarāgaṃ ca puṣparāgaṃ tathaiva ca māṇikyaṃ madhyame sthāpya śivamantreṇa deśikaḥ susnigdhaśālinā kuryātpuṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ ratnanyāsamidaṃ proktaṃ netramokṣaṇamucyate nayanadvayayukte tu dine lagne śubhe tathā nṛttarūpaṃ tadūrdhve tu vinyasecchiva mantrakaiḥ sthāpayet kalaśānaṣṭau lokapālādhidevatān suvarṇasūcinā vipra ! śilpinā praharettataḥ jyotirmaṇḍalamālikhya netramantra samāyutam netramantreṇa viprendra ! aṣṭottaraśataṃ pṛthak suvarṇadūrvayā vipra ! madhvājyaṃ caiva tarpayet tāmrapātre'thavā kāṃsye ājyaṃ caiva tu vinyaset ghṛtamikṣeti mantreṇa ghṛtaṃ caiva tu tarpayet gordhenurbhavyamantreṇa darśayedgāṃ viśeṣataḥ ṣaṇṇavatyena mantreṇa prokṣayet tu viśeṣataḥ pracchannapaṭamāvarjya darśayenmānuṣāṃstataḥ śuddhiṃ kṛtvā viśeṣeṇa tantrīṇāṃ ca saṃyutam sarvālaṃkāra saṃyuktaṃ kuryādgrāma pradakṣiṇam prapāṃ kṛtvā viśeṣeṇa kalaśān vinyaset tataḥ ekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā paṃca vā saptarātrakam

maṇḍapasyaiśadigbhāge snānavedyupari nyaset ghṛtaṃ śirorpaṇaṃ kuryāt svarṇadūrvāṃkurākṣataiḥ kṣālayecchuddhatoyena * * * nantu kalpayet aṣṭatriṃśat kalānyāsaṃ ṣaḍaṃgenaiva vinyaset sumūhūrte sulagne ca nakṣatrakaraṇānvite ṣaṇṇavatyena mantreṇa abhiṣekaṃ tu kārayet pūrvādīśāna paryantaṃ kalaśe vā bhiṣecayet pūrvokta lakṣaṇairyuktaṃ arcayet tu viśeṣataḥ pratiṣṭhopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ ācāryāya pradāpayet śaivān saṃbhojayet tatra yathā śaktyādi dakṣiṇā yāvad rudrapuraṃ sarve dadhyākṣaye naraḥ ādyeṣu tritayeṣveṣu na dhvajārohaṇa kriyā evaṃ kṛte mahāśānti rājarāṣṭrasukhāvaham evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati iti vīratantre saṃhāramūrtipratiṣṭhavidhiḥ catuṣṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ kathaṃ gaurī pratiṣṭhā ca brūhi me parameśvara ! rohiṇī ca punarvasvo puṣye mṛgaśirastathā sthirarāśau tu kartavyaṃ aṣṭamaṃ grahavarjitam dvinetrāṃ cāruvadanāṃ sustanāṃ ca suyauvanām karaṇḍamakuṭāṃ caiva sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam pādanūpura saṃyuktāṃ devyā rūpamihocyate pūrvoktalakṣaṇairyuktaṃ maṇṭapaṃ kārayettataḥ tasyā vṛtapadaṃ trīṇi madhyame kuṇḍamucyate lakṣaṇena prakartavyaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā saha hemaṃ tatraiva nikṣipya aṣṭadikṣu krameṇa tu

dvitīyavarge viprendra ! tṛtīyākṣara saṃyutam bindunāda samāyuktaṃ mūlamantramihocyate hṛsvā brahma samākhyātā dīrghāhyaṃgāni cocyate ādityasya pade caiva gomayenānulepayet tadardhaṃ taṇḍulaṃ nyasya taṇḍulārdhaṃ tilaṃ nyaset navavastraṃ nyasettatra pratimāṃ vinyaset tataḥ abhitaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau vāmādyādīni vinyaset kṛṣṇamaṇḍalamālikhya jyotirmaṇḍalamālikhet vastreṇāveṣṭya tad devyāḥ pracchanna paṭasaṃyutam abhitaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau vāmādyādīni vinyaset agnimukhaṃ ca saṃkalpya paṃcāśatsaṃkhyayā hunet tāmrapātre'thavā kāṃsye ghṛtaṃ madhu ca pūrayet madhuvātā ṛtāyeti madhunā tarpayettataḥ gaurdhenu bhavyamantreṇa savatsāṃgāṃ pradarśayet netramantrasamāyuktaṃ dhānyarāśīṃ ca darśayet paṃcagavyena viprendra ! abhiṣekaṃ samācaret nadītaṭākakatīre vā gomayenānulepite snāpayet paṃcagavyena jalādhivāsanaṃ kuru jalamadhye nyased devīṃ gaurībījena deśikaḥ savastraṃ sāpidhānaṃ ca vāmādyāścaiva vinyaset ekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā paṃcarātramathāpi vā snāpayet paṃcagavyena navavastreṇa veṣṭayet tadardhaṃ taṇḍulaṃ nyasya taṇḍulārdhaṃ tilaṃ nyaset tasyo parinyaseddevīṃ gaurīmūlena deśikaḥ pracchanna paṭasaṃyuktaṃ puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tataḥ

śuddhodakena saṃpūrṇāḥ pratyekaṃ vastraveṣṭitāḥ gaurībījena mantreṇa sa kūrcaṃ sāpidhānakam pratyekaṃ vastrasaṃyuktaṃ pradhāne hema vinyaset pūrvādīśāna paryantaṃ manonmanīṃ tvīśagocare gandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya gaurīmūlena mantrataḥ tato homaṃ prakurvīta nava vā paṃca eva vā gaurīmūlena mantreṇa samidhā hūyate kramāt śiromantreṇa lājaśca mudgaṃ vāmena hūyate evameva krameṇaiva pratyekaṃ tu śatāhutiḥ devasyatveti mantreṇa annāhutimathācaret havyavāheti mantreṇa sarvadravya samanvitam nṛttageya samāyuktaṃ rātrau jāgaramucyate gaurīmūlaṃ japettatra āgneyādi caturdiśi mantranyāsoktamārgeṇa sṛṣṭi nyāsaṃ tu kārayet samidājyacarūṇāṃ tu homayed deśikottamaḥ hutvānte tu yadasyeti sviṣṭakṛddhūyate kramāt vastrairābharaṇairyuktaṃ gobhūmīkāṃcanādibhiḥ tato muhūrtamudvīkṣya devīmutthāpayet kramāt sṛṣṭinyāsa krameṇaiva devyā aṃgeṣu vinyaset snāpayet tu viśeṣeṇa gaurīmūlamanusmaran snapanaṃ kārayetpaścād yathā vibhavavistaram brāhmaṇān bhojayettatra saptakanyāśca bhojayet gomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā śālinā vikirettataḥ sthaṇḍile sthāpayeddevīṃ diśi dakṣiṇato nyaset tatra viṣṇuṃ samāhūya dadyādudaka pūrvakam

hṛdayenātiṣṭha mantreṇa aśmānaṃ sparśayet tataḥ īśānena tu mantreṇa lājahomaṃ tu kārayet triḥkṛtvā tu viśeṣeṇa hutvā cittādibhistathā bhinnāsanamidaṃ proktaṃ sahāsanamataḥ śṛṇu iti vīratantre gaurī sthāpanavidhiḥ paṃcaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ sauvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ lohajaṃ vāpi kārayet lakṣaṇaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yathā vadanupūrvaśaḥ adhamaṃ saptāṃgulaṃ proktaṃ pādukasya tu dairghyakam aṃgulyādi trayāṃgulyaṃ utsedhaṃ * * * * * evaṃ lakṣaṇa saṃyuktāṃ pādukāṃ kārayet tataḥ ratnānāmapya lābhe tu suvarṇādīni kārayet maṇṭapasya tu saṃskāraṃ vibhavena samanvitam darbhamālābhirāveṣṭya catustoraṇa saṃyutam muktādāmairalaṃkṛtya puṣpamālopaśobhitam aṣṭadroṇena śālīṃśca tanmadhye vinyasettataḥ padmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhya darbhaiścaiva paristaret jalāduttīrya deveśaṃ śuddhiṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥ ācāryaśca śucirbhūtvā navavastreṇa veṣṭayet ācāryasya ca bījena sarvāṃgeṣu ca vinyaset upadeṣṭā śarīraṃ tad ācāryo jīva ucyate mantranyāsaṃ prakartavyaṃ lakṣaṇena samanvitam aṃguṣṭhādi kaniṣṭhāntaṃ paṃcabrahma nyaset kramāt astraṃ karatale caiva vinyaset tu viśeṣataḥ prākṛtaṃ bhāvamutsṛjya śivohamiti bhāvayet svarṇasūtreṇa saṃyuktaṃ kautukaṃ bandhayet tataḥ

samāloḍhya ca sarvaṃ tu lepayet tu samantataḥ pratimaṃ navavastreṇa pidhāya sakalaṃ tataḥ navakumbhaṃ samādāya sūtreṇāveṣṭayet tataḥ sa vastraṃ sa hiraṇyaṃ ca paṃcaratna samanvitam pratimasyaiśa digbhāge sthāpayecchiva kumbhakam vardhanīṃ tasya vāme tu gaurī bījena sthāpayet * * * * * * * * tāmbūlaṃ dāpayet tataḥ tato homaṃ prakartavyaṃ lakṣaṇena samanvitam khadiraṃ ca śamī caiva apāmārgaṃ tathaiva ca sarveṣāmeva homānāṃ madhye pālāśamucyate mudgamāṣaṃ ca viprendra ! navadravyamihocyate caruhomaṃ śikhā caiva lājānvai kavacena tu īśānena tilaṃ hutvā mudgaṃ sadyena hūyate sahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tadardhārdhamathāpi vā ugro'tidhāśrīmo ete homasya daivatāḥ balavikaraṇī balapramathinī sarvabhūta manonmanī dravyānte pratimāṃ spṛṣṭvā paṃcabrahma ṣaḍaṃgakaiḥ vyomaṃ prāsādamantraṃ ca brahmamaṃgaṃ tathaiva ca trāṇi parvāṇi te yaṃ nṛtta samākulaiḥ sviṣṭamagneti mantreṇa juhuyāttadanantare hūyate kramaśo vipra ! vyāhṛtiṃ juhuyāttataḥ paryaṣṭi paricārāṃśca śivadīkṣāvaho viduḥ athā vasānahomaṃ tu pradhānāgnau tu hūyate prabhāte dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād ācāryādi ca sarvaśaḥ paṃcāṃgabhūṣaṇaṃ dadyād ācāryasya viśeṣataḥ

uttamaṃ triguṇaṃ proktaṃ ācāryasya tu dakṣiṇā stotrādadhvayīnādīnāṃ tadardhaṃ dakṣiṇā śubhe padmasya pūrvadigbhāge vedāśraṃ kuṇḍamucyate pavamānena saṃprokṣya śuddhairutthai tato druvat pādukau vinyasenmadhye navavastrasya copari bhūtavargānta vargeṣu agniṃ saṃyojayet tataḥ śivaviṣṇusamārūḍhaṃ pādukābījamucyate śrībhūmī dakṣiṇā diśi tathā devau prakīrtitau pūrayecchuddhato yena sa kūrcānsāpidhānakān pādukādīśa digbhāge vardhanīṃ vinyasettataḥ manonmanīṃ pradhānasya vinyasettu viśeṣataḥ tato homaṃ prakartavyaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā saha sumuhūrte sulagne ca vardhanīṃ vinyasettataḥ gandhapuṣpādinā''pūjya vinyasecchivamantrataḥ ācāryaṃ pūjayetpūrvaṃ paryaṣṭi paricārakān nityotsavaṃ tu kāle tu pradakṣiṇamathācaret brahmacārī vahitvā tu pādukāvarcayet tataḥ evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokamavāpnuyāt pādukā sthāpanaṃ proktaṃ citrasthāpanakaṃ śṛṇu iti vīratantre pādukāsthāpanavidhiḥ ṣaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ citrapratiṣṭhā kiṃ devabrūhi me parameśvara ! citraṃ ca trividhaṃ jñeyaṃ teṣāṃ bhedaṃ śṛṇuṣvatha mṛṇmayaṃ śūlasaṃyuktaṃ bhitticitre paṭe'pi vā citrasya saṃnidhau caiva pratiṣṭhāmaṇṭapaṃ kuru ratnanyāsaṃ ca kartavyaṃ umādevyā viśeṣataḥ

vedikā brahmabhāge tu mānuṣe kuṇḍamucyate devyāśceddikṣu viprendra ! yoniraśvattha patravat nayanamokṣaṇaṃ kuryān netrayugmayute dine jalādhivāsanaṃ noktaṃ śayane śāyayet tataḥ bhāraśāli samāyuktaṃ vedimadhye paristaret paristaret tu darbhaiśca aṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇakam darpaṇaṃ śāyayettatra pracchanna paṭasaṃyutam devyāścaiva tu vāmādi vinyaset tu viśeṣataḥ * * * * * * * devaṃ devyā vardhanīṃ nyaset gandhapuṣpādinā'bhyarcya pāyasānnaṃ nivedayet samidājya caruṃ lājān sarṣapā * gameva ca sadyena samidhā hutvā hṛdayenājyameva ca sarṣarpaṃ netramantreṇa mudgamīśānamantrataḥ sarvadravya samāyuktaṃ havyavāhaṃ samuccaran tataḥ prabhāte vimale snānaṃ kṛtvā tu deśikaḥ tato vāsāna homaṃ tu ājyena caruṇāyutam caturdikṣu caturvedaiḥ kuryād adhyayanaṃ tataḥ hutvānte tu yadasyeti juhuyāt tadanantaram homīnāṃ tu padārthīnāṃ pūjayet tu viśeṣataḥ tasyordhve darpaṇaṃ sthāpya mūlamantreṇa saṃyutam pradhāna kalaśaṃ caiva snāpayet tu viśeṣataḥ havirnivedayet paścāt tāmbūlaṃ dāpayet tataḥ sarvāsāṃ devatānāṃ ca sthāpana kramameva hi pratiṣṭhopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ ācāryāya pradāpayet iti vīratantre citrapratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ saptaṣaṣṭhitamaḥ paṭalaḥ

vimānasthāpanaṃ kiṃ vā brūhi me parameśvara ! rohiṇī ca punavasvā puṣyo mṛgaśirastathā dvitīyā paṃcamī caiva dvādaśī vā trayodaśī evamādiṣu kāleṣu vimānasthāpanaṃ kuru prāsādasyaiva purataḥ prapāṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥ madhyame vedikāṃ kuryād hastamātrocchrayaṃ bhavet nāgaraṃ drāviḍaṃ caiva vesaraṃ tu śṛṇuṣvatha vṛttaṃ ca paṃcakoṇaṃ ca padmaṃ caivāṣṭakoṇakam caturdikṣu ca īśānyāṃ yathoktaṃ kuṇḍamucyate vitānadhvajasaṃyuktaṃ puṣpamālyairalaṃkṛtam kuberasya vidhiḥ prokto drāviḍasya tu vṛttakam tasya pūrve jalāvartaṃ vastramālyairalaṃkṛtam caturdikṣu nyasettatra hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ ācāryaśca śucirbhūtvā navavastreṇa veṣṭitaḥ prāsādaṃ darbhamālābhirveṣṭayet tu viśeṣataḥ vāstudevabaliṃ dadyāt pūrvokta vidhinā saha lambayennavavastreṇa prāsādena tu mantrataḥ prāsādahomaṃ kartavyaṃ garbhagehe viśeṣataḥ samidhāmīśamantreṇa ājyaṃ vāmena hūyate śāntihomakrameṇaiva caturdikṣu ca homayet prāsādameva homena śivāsanamatha śṛṇu śālinā vikirettatra bhāradvayena saṃyutam padmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhya darbhaiścaiva paristaret śuddhodakena saṃpūrya vastrakūrcasamanvitān navakumbhān samādāya sūtreṇa pariveṣṭayet

caturdaśasvarasaṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam pradhānakalaśe naiva * * * * * vinyaset pūrve tu viṣṇukumbhāsyu dakṣiṇāmūrtidakṣiṇe pūrvādiṣu caturdikṣu śivavidyeśvarasya tu uttare caiva durgāyāṃ vinyaset tu viśeṣataḥ havirnivedayet paścāt tāmbūlaṃ dāpayet tataḥ samidājya caruṃ lājān sarṣapāṃśca yavāṃstilān īśānyādīni sadyāntaṃ hṛdayena trayaṃ yutam vimānabījaṃ sarveṣu hutvā caiva śatāhutiḥ mantranyāsoktamārgeṇa nyāsaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥ tato vāsana homaṃ ca kartavyaṃ deśikottamaḥ vimānabījasaṃyuktaṃ paṃcaviṃśatirucyate sviṣṭamagneti mantreṇa juhuyāttadanantare hutvānte tu yadasyeti pūrṇāhutimathācaret śirasopari viprendra ! kumbhamudvāhayet tataḥ vimānamūlasaṃyuktaṃ vyomavyāpi samuccaran pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ snāpayet svasvamantrataḥ gandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya havirdadyādviśeṣataḥ saptakanyāśca viprendra ! vastrādīni ca dāpayet vimānasthāpanaṃ proktaṃ mānuṣasthāpanaṃ śṛṇu iti vīratantre vimānasthāpanavidhiraṣṭaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ mānuṣasthāpanaṃ ko vā śivajñānābhipūritān tatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva caturānana ! śivaprasāda siddhāṃśca pratimādīni kārayet śailajaṃ dārujaṃ vāpi mṛṇmayaṃ citrameva ca

catvāri paṃcaṣaṭtālaṃ mātrāṃgulena kārayet śivaprasādakāle tu yadrūpaṃ saṃbhavanti vai ṛṣīṇāmṛṣirūpaṃ tu nṛpāṇāṃ nṛpavadbhavet ilā ca piṃgalā caiva suṣumnā ca tathaiva ca alaṃpuruṣā ruhrī ca śaṃkhinī daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ vimalā ghoṣaṇī caiva pṛthivī āvinī tathā śodhanī vyādhinī caiva rasāvatī ca mudvatī sarvagā caiva nāḍyastā viṃśatissahitāṣṭabhiḥ tasya mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana ! saptamasya dvitīyaṃ tu prathamasya caturdaśa hṛsvā brahma samākhyātā dīrghāhyaṃgāni vinyaset devatānāṃ vāhanānāṃ sthāpayedevameva tu navaratnaṃ paṃcaratnaṃ vā vinyaseddeśitottamaḥ madhyame kalpayeddevīṃ paritaḥ kuṇḍamucyate pūrvādiṣu caturdikṣu īśānyādyaṣṭakoṇakam nayanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ kuryāt pūrvoktena vidhānataḥ ekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā adhivāsya tato budhaḥ vāstu homaṃ tataḥ kuryāllakṣaṇena samanvitam śayanaṃ paṃcabhiḥ kalpya kārpāsairvastraveṣṭitam kāye tu vinyasedvipra ! paṃcaviṃśatikaṃ tathā śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca rasogandhaśca paṃcamaḥ śrotratvakcakṣurjihvā ca ghrāṇaṃ caiva tu paṃcamam paṃcaviṃśati tatvāni śarīre vinyaset tataḥ gandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya paścātkumbhāni vinyaset pratimā dakṣiṇe bhāge kuṃbhaṃ mūlena sthāpayet

pūrvādīśāna paryantaṃ sthāpayet kumbhamaṣṭakam nāgaḥ kūrmaśca kṛkaro kumbhe pūrvādi vinyaset dhanaṃjayottare nyasya gandhapuṣpādinārcayet tato homaṃ prakurvīta palāśasamidhā saha samidājya carūnlājānsarṣapāṃśca yavāṃstilān paṃcabrahma ṣaḍaṃgena pratyekaṃ tu śatāhutiḥ caturdikṣu caturvedaiḥ kuryādadhyayanaṃ tataḥ tataḥ prabhāte vimale snānaṃ kṛtvā tu deśikaḥ tato vāsanahomaṃ tu samidājya carūnsaha hutvānte tu yadasyeti sviṣṭakṛddhūyate kramāt upadeṣṭāraṃ saṃpūjya yathā śāstrokta mārgataḥ mantranyāsokta mārgeṇa sṛṣṭi nyāsaṃ tu kārayet paṃcabrahmaṣaḍaṃgena prāṇādatyaya kumbhakān naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ dadyāt tāmbūlaṃ dāpayet tataḥ hāṭakaṃ vastra saṃyuktaṃ sarveṣāṃ dāpayet tataḥ mānuṣaṃ sthāpanaṃ proktaṃ piṇḍikā sthāpanaṃ śṛṇu iti vīratantre mānuṣasthāpanavidhiḥ ekona saptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ piṇḍikā sthāpanaṃ kiṃcit tatsarvaṃ me vada prabho ! prāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryān maṇṭapaṃ caturaśrakam stambhaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryuktaṃ caturdvārasamanvitam vitānadhvajamācchādya digdhvajaiśca pralambitam śālibhirvikirettatra taṇḍulaiśca tilaistathā pīṭhaṃ prakṣālayedvipra ! prāsādena tu mantrataḥ valmīke ca taṭāke ca kuśamūle tathaiva ca śuddhakṣetre tu vai brahma mṛdbhissaṃkṣālayedbudhaḥ

puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tatra svastimaṃgalavācakaiḥ śuddhodakena saṃpūrya vinyaset pīṭhabāhyataḥ vardhanyāṃ nikṣipet tatra pūrvādīśāntameva ca sakūrcaṃ ca suvarṇaṃ ca vastrayugmaṃ pṛthak pṛthak dakṣiṇe caiva raudrī ca kālī nir-ṛti gocare balapramathinīṃ saumye vinyaset tu viśeṣataḥ madhye manonmanīṃ devīṃ nyastvā gandhādinā yajet tato homaṃ prakurvīta kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile'pi vā vṛttapīṭhasya he brahman vṛttakuṇḍamihocyate samidhassadyamantreṇa ājyaṃ vāmena caiva hi veṇumīśānamantreṇa mudgaṃ ca śirasā tathā gaurībījena mantreṇa pratyekaṃ tu śatāhutiḥ sviṣṭamagneti mantreṇa juhuyāt tadanantare upānaṃ pādamityuktaṃ jagatī jaṃghonujaṃ tathā kaṇṭhaśca hṛdayaṃ proktaṃ nābhiścaiva tu paṭṭikā kaṇṭhaśca hṛdayaṃ proktaṃ bāhūcaivordhva vāmanam evaṃ vai padmapīṭhe tu teṣāṃ rūpaṃ prakalpayet tataḥ prabhāte (vimale) sumuhūrte sulagnake paścādgarbhagṛhaṃ gatvā ācāryaḥ śilpibhissaha vṛṣagāyatrimantreṇa prāsādena samanvitam pīṭhaṃ visarjayet tatra jalamadhye tu nikṣipet ṣaṇṇavatyakṣarairyuktaṃ vyomavyāpi samuccaran aṣṭabandhaṃ prakartavyaṃ lakṣaṇena samanvitam vāyuke neṣṭakā cūrṇaṃ sadṛśaṃ ghanatailakam tāmrapātre viśeṣeṇa pācayecchilpinā saha

evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivaloke mahīyate tat tadaṃśāni vinyasya sūtrāgramupakalpanam tanmadhye vedikāṃ kuryādaratnimātramucchritām gātrasaṃveṣṭanaṃ kuryād vitānenordhvaṃ veṣṭayet vedibāhye tu parito navakuṇḍāni kārayet tat tat pīṭhākṛtiṃ brahman tat tat kuṇḍamihocyate tadardhaṃ taṇḍulān nyasya taṇḍulārdhatilān nyaset bālasthānasya cāgre tu yātrāhomaṃ tu kārayet sa sūtraṃ sāpidhānaṃ ca savastraṃ hema saṃyutam abhitaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau vidyeśvara samanvitān ācāryaśca śucirbhūtvā śirasā dhārayed ghaṭam vimāna pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryānvedimadhye nyaset tataḥ gandhapuṣpādinā pūjya pāyasānnaṃ nivedayet samāloḍhya viśeṣeṇa liṃgamāloḍyayet tataḥ tato homaṃ prakurvīta lakṣaṇena samanvitam udumbaramapāmārgaṃ khadiraṃ ca viśeṣataḥ īśāna indrayormadhye śamīṃ caiva tu vinyaset sarveṣāṃ caiva homānāṃ palāśedhyamihocyate samidhaṃ sadyamantreṇa vaktreṇājyaṃ tathaiva ca netreṇaiva tu mudgaṃ syān māṣaṃ hṛdayamucyate prāsādena tu mantreṇa pratyekaṃ paṃcaviṃśatiḥ sarvadravya samāyuktaṃ havyavāhaṃ samuccaran jayādirabhyadhānaṃ ca rāṣṭrabhṛccaiva hūyate caturdikṣu caturvedaiḥ kuryādadhyayanaṃ tataḥ puruṣasūktaṃ japitvā ca stotreṇaiva samanvitam

navavastraparīdhānaḥ soṣṇīṣassottarīyakaḥ praśāntamānaso bhūtvā snāpayelliṃga mūrdhani pūrvādīśāna paryantaṃ vidyeśān snāpayet tataḥ snapanaṃ kārayet tatra yathāvibhavavistaram havirnivedayet paścāt tāmbūlaṃ dapayet tataḥ pīṭhasthāpanamevoktaṃ jalasaṃprokṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu iti vīratantre piṇḍikāsthāpanavidhiḥ saptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ jalasaṃprokṣaṇaṃ kiṃ vā brūhi me parameśvara prāsādakaraṇe caiva śilpinā sparśayet tataḥ patane dūṣite spṛṣṭe pūjāhīne tathaiva ca trirātre paṃca saptāhe aṃkurārpaṇamārabhet pālikā ghaṭikā caiva śarābaṃ ca tridhā bhavet prāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryānmaṇḍapaṃ caturaśrakam ṣoḍaśastambhasaṃyuktaṃ caturdvāra vibhūṣitam samakhaṇḍaṃ vartamānaṃ ca śivādhikyaṃ tathaiva ca kuṇḍānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣye samakhaṇḍasya padmaja ! indra īśānayormadhye aṣṭakoṇaṃ tu kārayet caturaśraṃ ca yoniṃ ca ardhacandraṃ trikoṇakam pūrvādīni kramadṛddhiṃ īśāne saptakoṇakam trairāśikasya kuṇḍāni śrūyatāṃ caturānana ! svayamudbhūtaliṃgasya sthāpitasya maharṣibhiḥ eteṣāṃ prokṣaṇe kāle tat tat pīṭhākṛtiṃ yathā pūrvoktena pramāṇena kuṇḍaṃ kuryāt tu deśikaḥ gomayenopalipyātha toraṇa dhvajasaṃyutam vedyopari nyasecchāliṃ bhāradvayasamanvitam

padmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhya darbhaiścaiva paristaret candanāgarukarpūraṃ uśīraṃ kuṃkumairyutam puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tatra paṃcagavyena snāpayet kautukaṃ bandhayet paścāt hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ tasyāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā śālibhistaṇḍulaistilaiḥ vardhanīṃ tasya vāme tu gaurībījena sthāpayet tasyāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā yātrāhomaṃ tu kārayet samidājya carūṇāṃ tu pratyekaṃ tu śatāhutiḥ īśānena tilaṃ hutvā spṛṣṭvā liṃgaṃ tato budhaḥ daśamudrā ca dātavyaṃ lakṣaṇena samanvitam praviśya maṇṭapaṃ vidvān - yedvedi madhyame bāle sthāne kṛte hyevaṃ kartavyaṃ deśikottamaḥ navakumbhānsamādāya sūtreṇa pariveṣṭitān paṃcaratna samāyuktaṃ vastrayugmena veṣṭitam paṃcabrahmaśivāṃgaiśca śivamantreṇa sthāpayet sa vastrān sahiraṇyāṃśca sakūrcān sāpidhānakān gandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya pāyasānnaṃ nivedayet samidājya carūnlājānsarṣapāṃśca yavāṃstilān palāśaṃ pūrvato bhāge udumbaraṃ cāgnigocare khadiraṃ paścime nyasya vāyavye bilvameva ca palāśasamidhā caiva pradhānāgnau tu homayet stotramantraṃ japitvā tu pavamānaṃ japet tataḥ caruṃ tat puruṣeṇaiva lājānghoreṇa caiva hi tilān hutvā tu śikhayā mudgaṃ tu kavacena tu dravyānte vyāhṛtiṃ hutvā spṛṣṭvā liṃgaṃ tu sarvaśaḥ

sviṣṭamagneti mantreṇa juhuyāt tadanantare āpo rājā idaṃ viṣṇoḥ pratyekaṃ caru hūyate mantranyāsokta mārgeṇa svadehe caiva vinyaset sarvadravya samāyuktaṃ pūrṇāhutimathācaret pūjāparyuṣito liṃgaṃ vyapohya kalaśaṃ tataḥ paṃcāsanaṃ tadākalpya pūrvoktavidhinā saha vyomavyāpi mahāmantraṃ vinyasya liṃgamūrdhani vimāna pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryād garbhagehaṃ praveśayet snāpayecchiva kumbhaṃ tu gaurībījena vardhanīm snapanaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ yathā vibhavavistaram paṃcavarṇahavirdadyāt tāmbūlaṃ dāpayet tataḥ viprādīṃśca dadecchaivān paryaṣṭi paricārakān evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokamavāpnuyāt iti vīratantre jalasaṃprokṣaṇavidhireka saptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ vṛṣabha sthāpanaṃ kiṃ vā tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho ! pūjāṃśocca pramāṇena adhamaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ bhavet pūjāṃśena samāyuktaṃ madhyamaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ bhavet athavā garbhamānena yathāvad garbhamucyate athavā tālamānena tritālamadhamaṃ bhavet sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ mṛṇmayaṃ vā śilā bhavet galamaṃśena kartavyaṃ ṣaḍaṃśaṃ pṛṣṭhadairghikam dvandvayoradhamāṃśaṃ tu gomukhākṛtireva ca karṇadvayasamāyuktaṃ kiṃkiṇīrupaśobhitam pādāccatvāramaṃśaṃ tu caturaṃśaṃ tu bālakam ūrumūlasya vistāraṃ dvayaṃśamiti kathyate

śailaje mṛṇmaye lohe ratnanyāsaṃ tu kārayet indranīlaṃ ca ratnādi pūrvādika caturdiśi vṛṣabhaṃ kṣālayed vidvān puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tataḥ pūrvokta vidhinā kuryād akṣihomādikārayet vṛṣagāyatrimantreṇa jale caivādhivāsayet jalāduttīrya pūrvedyuḥ praviśedālayaṃ prati (tataḥ) madhyame vedikāṃ kuryāt paritaḥ kuṇḍamucyate saptavargāccaturthaṃ tu tadvargāttu tṛtīyakam vṛṣabhamūlamidaṃ jñeyaṃ hutvā brahmamihocyate tadūrdhve vinyasedvipra paṃcabhiḥ kambalairyutam pracchanna paṭa saṃyuktaṃ abhitaḥ kalaśān nyaset vṛṣagāyatrimantreṇa vinyased deśikottamaḥ aṣṭavidyeśvarān bāhya kalaśasyādhi daivatān tato homaṃ prakurvīta palāśasamidhā saha īśānādīni sadyāntaṃ kramān mantramihocyate vṛṣaṃ spṛṣṭvā tu dravyānte vyāhṛtiṃ juhuyāt tataḥ havyavāhādimantreṇa pūrṇāhutimathācaret gāyatryā paṃcabrahmaṃ tu snāpayet kumbhameva ca ācārya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt padārthīn pūjayet tataḥ evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati vṛṣabhasthāpanaṃ proktaṃ athāgnisthāpanaṃ śṛṇu iti vīratantre vṛṣabhasthāpanavidhirdvāsaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ agnipratiṣṭhāṃ deveśa ! tat sarvaṃ brūhi me prabho ! prāsādasyāgni digbhāge agnivimānamucyate athavā garbhamānaṃ vā navadhā bhājite tathā

dvitālamadhamaṃ jñeyaṃ tritālaṃ madhyamaṃ bhavet eka hṛdayaṃ tripādaṃ ca catuśśṛṃgaṃdvayaṃśiraḥ padmāsanasamārūḍhaṃ ūrdhvakeśa samanvitam sruvākṣatomaraṃ caivetyete vāmakareṣu ca evaṃ samāsataḥ proktaṃ pratiṣṭhālakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu marakataṃ dakṣiṇe nyasya paścime tu pravālakam nayanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ kuryān netradvayayute dine bindunāda samāyuktaṃ agnimūla mudāhṛtam nayanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ kuryāt pūrvoktavidhinā saha jalādhivāsanaṃ kuryāt tasya mūlena mantrataḥ prāsādasyāgrataścaiva pūrvoktamaṇḍapaṃ kuru caturdikṣu ca īśānyāṃ trikoṇaṃ kuṇḍamucyate pratisthaika digbhāge agnimūlena vinyaset śayanaṃ paṃcabhiḥ kalpyaḥ pratimāṃ vinyaset tataḥ tasyaiva vāmabhāge tu svāhā bījena vardhanam hutāśanaṃ pāvakaṃ ca analaṃ havyavāhanam pūrvādīśāna paryantaṃ vinyaset tu viśeṣataḥ tato homaṃ prakartavyaṃ palāśasamidhāyutam mudgamāṣaṃ ca nīvāraṃ bilvaṃ caikādaśaṃ bhavet tataḥ prabhāte vimale snānaṃ kṛtvā tu deśikaḥ tato vāsana homaṃ ca samidājya carūn yutam vimāne sthāpayedvidvān pratimaṃ paścimaṃ mukham svasvanāmnaiva mantreṇa snāpayet kumbhameva ca brāhmaṇān bhojayet tatra paryaṣṭiparicārakān agnisthāpanamevoktaṃ mātṝṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ śṛṇu

iti vīratantre agnisthāpanavidhistrisaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ mātṝṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ kiṃ vā tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho ! brāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā vighneśaṃ pratimaṃ kṛtvā sthāpayed vidhipūrvakam caturbhujāṃ dvinetrāṃ ca padmāsanopari sthitam vīrabhadraṃ mayā proktaṃ brāhmī caiva śṛṇuṣvatha dakṣiṇe'dakṣiṇe haste akṣasūtrakamaṇḍalum trinetrāṃ caturbhujāṃ caiva jaṭāmukuṭa dhāriṇīm padmāsanopariṣṭāt tu māheśvarīṃ ca kārayet dakṣiṇe'dakṣiṇe haste akṣamālākamaṇḍulum dvinetrāṃ caturbhujāṃ devīṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharām kārayed vaiṣṇavīṃ devīṃ vārāhīṃ ca tataḥ śṛṇu makuṭena samāyuktāṃ varāha mukha saṃyutām caturbhujāṃ dvinetrāṃ ca śyāmavarṇa samāyutām caturbhujaṃ triṇetraṃ ca vighneśaṃ kārayet tataḥ māyānala samāyuktaṃ bindunāda samāyutam hṛsvā brahma samākhyātā dīrghāhyaṃgāni cocyate nayanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ kuryāt pūrvokte naiva mārgataḥ jalādhivāsanaṃ kuryāt pūrvoktena vidhānataḥ pūrvavanmaṇḍapaṃ kuryāt pūrvokte naiva mārgataḥ caturaśraṃ yonikuṇḍaṃ ardhacandraṃ trikoṇakam pūrvādīni kramān nyasya kuṇḍānyetāni vinyaset puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra pavamānena prokṣayet śayanaṃ paṃcabhiḥ kuryāt tasyopari nyaset tataḥ kaumārīṃ vahnideśe tu vaiṣṇavīṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset

cāmuṇḍīṃ vāyudeśe tu uttare vīrabhadrakam tasyaiva vāmabhāge tu kumbhānvinyasya deśikaḥ vastreṇa veṣṭayed vidvān suvarṇe naiva saṃyutān tato homaṃ prakurvīta lakṣaṇena samanvitam samidājya carūnlājān sarṣapāṃśca yavāṃstilān paṃcabrahma ṣaḍaṃgaiśca pratyekaṃ tu śatāhutiḥ caturdikṣu caturvedaiḥ kuryādadhyayanaṃ tataḥ tato vāsanahomaṃ tu samidājyena saṃyutam hutvānte tu spṛśedbimbaṃ dravyaṃ prati viśeṣataḥ uttarābhimukhīrdevīḥ sthāpayed deśikottamaḥ pratiṣṭhākumbhamādāya snāpayet svasvamantrataḥ brāhmaṇānbhojayet tatra saptakanyāśca bhojayet mātṝṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ proktaṃ kumārasthāpanaṃ śṛṇu iti vīratantre mātṛsthāpanavidhiścatuḥ saptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ kumārasthāpanaṃ kiṃ vā tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho ! pūjābhāgasamutsedhaṃ pratimaṃ socchrayaṃ bhavet catvāraḥ paṃcatālaṃ vā ṣaṭtālaṃ vāpi kārayet varadābhayahastaṃ tu akṣamālākamaṇḍalum jayā ca vijayā caiva devyau pārśva sthite sadā ebhistu lakṣaṇairyuktaṃ pratimāṃ kārayet tataḥ prathamasya caturthaṃ tu bindunāda samanvitam hṛsvā brahma samākhyātā dīrghābhyaṃgāni cocyate vajraṃ marakataṃ caiva vaiḍūryaṃ ca pravālakam susnigdhaṃ kārayettatra nayanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ kuru akṣihomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā netreṇaiva śatāhutiḥ

ghṛtamikṣeti santarpya savatsāṃgāṃ pradarśayet * * * * tṛtīyaṃ tu māyānala samanvitam saptavargāccaturthaṃ tu māyātatva samanvitam brāhmaṇān darśayet tatra puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tataḥ navavastrasamādhānaḥ kuryādgrāmapradakṣiṇam mūlamantreṇa viprendra ! pracchanna paṭasaṃyutam jalāduttīrya pūrvedyuḥ snāpayet paṃcagavyakaiḥ madhyame vedikāṃ kuryātparitaḥ kuṇḍamucyate indra īśānayormadhye kuryātkuṇḍaṃ trikoṇakam śālinā vikiredvedīṃ taṇḍulaṃ ca tilaṃ nyaset śāyayed vedikāmadhye prākśiraskā vidhīyate kautukaṃ bandhayet pūrve hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ jayā ca vijayā caiva dvau pārśvau sthāpayet kramāt pūrvādīśāna paryantaṃ aṣṭakumbhān kramānyaset senāpatiṃ surāgraṃ ca harasūnuṃ tathaiva ca gandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya svasvanāmnā ca mantrataḥ tato homaṃ prakurvīta pālāśasamidhā saha śālinīvāragodhūma mudgaiścaiva samanvitam skandamūlena hotavyamājye naiva śatāhutiḥ tato vāsanahomaṃ tu samidājyacarūyutam caturdikṣu caturvedaiḥ kuryādadhyayanaṃ tataḥ sviṣṭamagneti mantreṇa juhuyāttadanantare utthāpya śayanāddevīṃ sṛṣṭinyāsaṃ tu kārayet snāpayet skandamūlena skandakumbhaṃ viśeṣataḥ āvāhayet tu vāmena sadyena sthāpanaṃ bhavet

gandhādyā hṛdayā caiva puṣpaṃ tu śirasā tathā naivedyaṃ hṛdaye naiva nityotsavaṃ tu kārayet pratimāṃ pūrvato gatvā paścāt tu kṣaṇikaṃ bhavet utsavaṃ kārayet tatra lakṣaṇena samanvitam skandasthāpanamevoktaṃ jyeṣṭhā sthāpanakaṃ śṛṇu iti vīratantre skandasthāpanavidhiḥ paṃcasaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ jyeṣṭhāyā sthāpanaṃ kiṃ vā tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho ! pūjāṃśocca pramāṇena pratimotsedhamucyate catvāraḥ paṃcaṣaṭtālaṃ pratimasyocchrayaṃ bhavet makuṭena samāyuktāṃ raktavastra samanvitām dakṣiṇe putrasaṃyuktāṃ sūkarānanasaṃyutām evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ devyā rūpaṃ prakalpayet mūlamantraṃ pravakṣyāmi dvitīyasya tṛtīyakam bindunādasamāyuktaṃ jyeṣṭhāmūlamiti smṛtam prathamasyaikādaśaṃ yuktaṃ bindunāda samanvitam paṃcamāt paṃcamaṃ gṛhya bindunāda samanvitam ratnanyāsaṃ tu kartavyaṃ paṃcaratnaṃ tu mūlataḥ akṣihomaṃ tataḥ kuryād ājyenaiva śatāhutiḥ jalādhivāsanaṃ kuryān mūlamantreṇa deśikaḥ ekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā paṃcarātramathāpi vā pūrvoktamaṇḍape ramye madhye vedikayā yutam vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā sarvakuṇḍāni kārayet vāstu homaṃ divā kuryāllakṣaṇena samanvitam śayanaṃ paṃcabhiḥ kalpya gandhapuṣpādinārcayet dakṣiṇe vāmapārśve tu putraṃ putrī samanvitam

vāmādi śakti saṃyuktaṃ kākaṃ ca kramān nyaset savastrāṃ sāpidhānāṃ ca sahiraṇyaṃ sa kūrcakam tato homaṃ prakurvīta pālāśasamidhā saha śālinīvāragodhūma mudge naiva samanvitam mūlamantreṇa viprendra ! aṣṭottaraśatāhutiḥ caturdikṣu caturvedaiḥ kuryādadhyayanaṃ tataḥ mūlamantreṇa hotavyaṃ pratyekaṃ tu śatāhutiḥ utthāpya śayanāddevīṃ sthāpayen mānuṣe pade paṃcabrahma śivāṃgaiśca snāpayecchakti kumbhakān brāhmaṇān bhojayet tatra śaivān saṃbhojayet tataḥ aṃganyāsakaranyāsaṃ paṃcabrahmeṇa kārayet āvāhayet tu sadyena vāmena sthāpanaṃ bhavet hṛdayena caruṃ dadyān nityotsavaṃ tu kārayet prāsādasya samotsedhaṃ dhvajadaṇḍaṃ vidhīyate bherītāḍanakaṃ kṛtvā aṃkurārpaṇameva ca tato grāmabaliṃ dadyāt śuddhānnaṃ pratisamāyutam tṛtīyamṛṣirātraṃ tu caturthaṃ gandhamucyate jyeṣṭhāṃśaṃ saptamaṃ rātramityetā rātridevatāḥ snapanaṃ kārayet tatra lakṣaṇena samanvitam evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ sa puṇyāṃ gatimāpnuyāt iti vīratantre jyeṣṭhā sthāpanavidhiḥ ṣaṭsaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ snapanaṃ vividhaṃ kiṃ vā tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho ! grahaṇe viṣuve caiva ayane vyatipādake adbhutānāṃ samutpanne prāyaścittādi saṃbhave prāsādasyāgrataścaiva maṇḍapaṃ caturaśrakam
