ekādaśakaraṃ vātha trayodaśakaraṃ tu vā adhamaṃ pūrvatrayaṃ siddhaṃ madhyamaṃ cāparaṃ bhavet ṛṣicchando devatā vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana ! ādityena samāyuktaṃ uttamatrayamucyate vighneśena samāyuktaṃ madhyamaṃ trayamucyate chandenaiva samāyuktaṃ adhamatrayamucyate maṇṭapaṃ navaṣaṭtriṃśat * * * gātra saṃyutam pūrvoktena vidhānena maṇṭapaṃ kārayet tataḥ proktaṃ tu navabhedena procyate tu mayā dvija ! vitānenordhvamācchādya muktādāmairalaṃkṛtam caturdvāra samāyuktaṃ catustoraṇa saṃyutam sṛkpaṭṭadevāṃgaiḥ netradīpairalaṃkṛtam sahasrakalaśaṃ caiva uttamottamamucyate paṃcāśadadhika dviśataṃ uttamādhamamucyate ekāśītistu madhyaṃ syān madhyamasya viśeṣataḥ sumuhūrte ca sulagne ca sūtrapādaṃ tu kārayet aṣṭādhikaṃ ca viprendra ! catvāriṃśacca saṃyutam uttarāgraṃ tathaiva syādevameva krameṇa tu madhyame paṃcaviṃśattu taddvayāvṛta vīthikān bāhye padadvayaṃ nyastvā paṃca paṃca padāntare evameva krameṇaiva vidhīnāṃ lopayet kramāt vyūhāntare prakartavyaṃ vyūhasthāpanamākramāt puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tatra pavamānena prokṣayet kalaśānprati nikṣipya ardhakaṃ cottamaṃ bhavet evameva prakāreṇa hīnaṃ cāpi na kārayet

śālyardha taṇḍulaṃ nyasya taṇḍulārdhatilaṃ nyaset padmamaṣṭadalaṃ caiva darbhaiścaiva paristaret kalaśānāṃ vidhiṃ vakṣye uttamaṃ droṇapūritam apakvamati pakvaṃ ca hīnaṃ kālaṃ ca varjayet triguṇī kṛtamoraṃ vā veṣṭayet kuṃjarākṣavat śuddhodakena saṃpūrṇaṃ kūrcamadhye vinikṣipet paṃcāsanopariṣṭāt tu sthāpayet kumbhameva ca gandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya vyomavyāpi samuccaran pūrvādīśāna paryantaṃ aṣṭakumbhān nyaset kramāt vidyeśānāṃ suvarṇaṃ ca vinyaseddeśikottamaḥ uttamaṃ daśahastaṃ tu madhyamaṃ cāṣṭahastakam vistāraṃ tu catustālaṃ kalaśānveṣṭayet kramāt cūrṇitaṃ hṛdaye naiva vinyasedeśikumbhake vastrairdhūpaiśca dīpaiśca gandhaiścaiva tu pūjayet madhya vyūhaṃ tu vinyasya bāhya vyūhaṃ padaṃ nyaset ājyaṃ caiva tu pūrve tu āgneyyāṃ dadhi vinyaset vāruṇyāṃ tu madhunyasya vāyavyāṃ tu nalaṃ nyaset evameva prakāreṇa vyūhaṃ prati nyaset tataḥ sarṣapaṃ śālinā caiva vidikṣu vinyaset tataḥ vibhūtiravyayaḥ śāstā pinākī pramathādhipaḥ pūrvādi vinyased vidvān pradakṣiṇakrameṇa tu alābhe caiva viprendra ! yathālābhaṃ vinikṣipet kalaśānpaṃcaviṃśāṃstu vyūhaṃ prati nyaset kramāt kuṣṭhaṃ ca kuṃkumaṃ caiva raghumāṃci tathaiva ca uśīraṃ candanaṃ caiva tṛṇakaccolajambakam

lodhraṃ ca kuṃkumaṃ caiva caturviṃśati saṃyutam agnirudrodbhutāśī ca piṃgalaḥ khātato haraḥ śālinīvāragodhūma priyaṃguṃ caiva saṃyutam lohaṃ ca kuṃkumaṃ caiva caturviṃśati saṃyutam kālarudraśca vikhyātaḥ sarvadharma patistathā lokāntaraḥ sphuṭā lokaḥ tryambako nāgabhūṣaṇaḥ eteṣāṃ devatānāṃ tu vyūhe vyūhe prakīrtitāḥ pūrvābhimukhaṃ saṃsthāpya śivomāṃ caiva deśikaḥ gandhapuṣpādinā caiva kalaśānpratipūjayet tato homaṃ prakurvīta lakṣaṇena samanvitam samidājya carūnlājān sarvadravya samāyutam cittādīni jayādīni homayet tu viśeṣataḥ gandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya śivakuṃbhaṃ ca vardhanīm caturdikṣu caturvedaiḥ kuryādadhyayanaṃ tataḥ mūlaberamanuprāpya nirmālyaṃ ca visarjayet paṃcāsano pariṣṭāt tu śivaṃ dhyāyed vicakṣaṇaḥ tato garbhagṛhaṃ gatvā prāsādena samanvitam sthāpayecchivakumbhaṃ tu vardhanyāṃ pīṭhakaṃ nyaset yathā sthāpanamārgeṇa sthāpayet parameśvaram vastraṃ dadyād hṛdā caiva gandhapuṣpaṃ ca dāpayet ācārya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt padārthīn pūjayet tataḥ evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokamavāpnuyāt iti vīratantre sahasrakalaśasthāpanavidhiḥ saptasaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ ko vā paṃcaśataṃ snānaṃ brūhi me parameśvara ! prāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryān maṇḍapaṃ caturaśrakam

catustoraṇa saṃyuktaṃ darbhamālopaśobhitam muktādāmairalaṃkṛtya maṇḍapaṃ maṇḍayet tataḥ triṃśat sūtra samāyuktaṃ prāgagrāṇi vinyaset madhye navapadaṃ padmaṃ aṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam tadbāhye tu paritaḥ padaṃ paṃca sthitāni tu śālinā vikiret tatra āḍhakaṃ kalaśaṃ prati padmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhya darbhaiścaiva paristaret śuddhodakena saṃpūrya kumbhamādāya maṇḍape vardhanīṃ tasya vāme tu gaurībījena sthāpayet kūrcaṃ tatraiva nikṣipya navaratnāni vinyaset śivakumbhe śivaṃ sthāpya vardhanyāṃ ca manonmanīm vastrayugmena saṃveṣṭya svarṇaṃ tatraiva vinyaset dvitīyāvaraṇe caiva ṣaṭsaptati ca vinyaset aśītikalaśaṃ caiva vinyased deśikottamaḥ tṛtīyāvaraṇe caiva aṣṭāviṃśati vinyaset saptamāvaraṇe caiva śatakumbhāṃśca vinyaset kūrcān kalaśa saṃyuktān śuddhodakena pūritān utkūrcaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ cāhuradhaḥ kūrcaṃ tu śāntikam elālavaṃgatakkola nimbujātī phalairyutam gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ caiva dadhikṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā sarṣapaṃ mudgamāṣaṃ ca priyaṃguṃ ca samanvitam ajaḥ kāpāli buddhī ca vajradehaḥ pramardanaḥ agnīrudro hutāśaśca dvitīyāvaraṇe nyaset tṛtīyāvaraṇe nyasya devatānāṃ śṛṇuṣvatha āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu kramādvinyasya devatāḥ

caturthāvaraṇe nyasya devatānāṃ śṛṇuṣvatha saṃyoktā ca samāyuktaṃ paṃcamāvaraṇe nyaset vyomavyāpiṃ japet tatra brahmāṃgaiśca samanvitam yathā sthāpitamārgeṇa snāpayet kalaśāṃstataḥ ācāryadakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt paṃcāṃgabhūṣaṇaissaha evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokamavāpnuyāt iti vīratantre paṃcaśatasnapanavidhiḥ aṣṭasaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ snapanaṃ kīdṛśaṃ deva ! tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho ! prāsādasyāgrataścaiva maṇḍapaṃ caturaśrakam dvāviṃśatiśca sūtrāṇi pūrvābhimukhameva ca navapādeṣu padmaṃ syād aṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam yadbāhye varaṇādbāhye padadvayaṃ ca hrāsayet śatadvayaṃ ca paṃcāśat padānyatra sthitāni tu darbhaiḥ paristaret tatra gandhapuṣpādinārcayet triguṇī kṛtasūtreṇa veṣṭayet kuṃjarākṣavat jalabhāṇḍaṃ samādāya secayedudakaṃ hṛdā elālavaṃga takkolairuśīra candanairyutam vinyasecchivakuṃbhaṃ tu vyomavyāpiṃ samuccaran abhitaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau vidyeśvara samanvitam vajraṃ marakataṃ caiva vaiḍūryaṃ ca pravālakam vinyasecchiva kumbhe tu vardhanyāṃ paṃcaratnakam bāhyāvaraṇakaṃ tatra ṣaṭtriṃśatkalaśān nyaset kapālīśo vajrapāṇiḥ pinākī tridaśādhipaḥ tṛtīyāvaraṇe caiva kalaśān ṣaṣṭi vinyaset panasaṃ kadalī caiva mātuluṃgaphalāni ca

yāmyaṃ mṛtyuharaṃ caiva dhātā dharmapatistathā paṃcamāvaraṇaṃ caiva ṣaṭsaptatiṃ nyaset tataḥ kālarudro hutāśaśca jvalano dahanastathā dravyaṃ ca devatā yuktaṃ koṇe koṇe ca vinyaset hṛdā ca samidho hutvā hṛtaṃ tu śirasā tathā sarṣapaṃ * * * * * netramantreṇa caiva hi sarvadravya samāyuktaṃ havyavāhaṃ samuccaran diśāsvadhyayanaṃ kuryāt stotramantraṃ japet tataḥ snāpayecchivakumbhaṃ tu prāsādena tu mantrataḥ tṛtīyāvaraṇaṃ paścāt caturthāvaraṇaṃ punaḥ paṃcavarṇa havirdadyāt tāmbūlaṃ dāpayet tataḥ paṃcāśad dviśataṃ proktaṃ uttama trayamucyate madhyama trayake vipra ! aṣṭottaraśataṃ śṛṇu iti vīratantre paṃcāśad dviśatasnapanavidhiḥ ekonāśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥ etat sarvaṃ samāsena aṣṭottaraśataṃ tvatha prāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryānmaṇḍapaṃ caturaśrakam catustoraṇasaṃyuktaṃ darbhamālābhirāvṛtam stambhāni veṣṭayet tatra gomayenānu lepayet dvividhaṃ sūtrapādaṃ tu śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ tathā uttarāgraṃ tathaiva syād sūtrasyaitāni nirdiśet caturdikṣu ca viprendra ! dvārārthaṃ tu padaṃ tataḥ tasya bāhye tu paritaḥ padadvaya sthitāni tu idamanyat pravakṣyāmi cakrasthāpanamucyate uttarāgraṃ tathaiva syāt tālamātreṇa cāntaram tāsāṃ pūrve diśo vipra ! tālamātreṇa cāntaram

caturbhiḥ kalaśānnyasya pauṣṭikaṃ tviha cocyate śālinā vikiret tatra adhikaṃ kalaśānprati paristarecca darbhaiśca puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tataḥ astramantreṇa kṛtvā tu vāmena śoṣaṇaṃ bhavet āḍhakena tu saṃpūrṇān adhamaṃ tu vidhīyate bhinnaṃ kālaṃ ca suṣiraṃ bhedacchedaṃ ca varjayet śarāvaṃ caiva viprendra sūtreṇa veṣṭayet tataḥ pradhāna kalaśaṃ vipra ! śuddhodakena pūrayet kalaśasya mukhe rudraṃ viṣṇuṃ madhyamake nyaset madhyame śivakumbhaṃ tu prāsādena tu vinyaset śivakumbhe śivaṃ pūjya vardhanyāṃ gaurimeva ca pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ aṣṭakumbhāṃśca vinyaset prathamāvaraṇaṃ hyetad dvitīyāvaraṇaṃ śṛṇu pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ payaḥ tṛtīyāvaraṇe caiva caturviṃśat kalā nyaset lājācūrṇa śamī caiva nīvāraṃ nālikerakam karpūraṃ hariberaṃ ca viṃśatiṃ kalaśān nyaset agnīrudro hutāśaśca piṃgalaḥ khātako haraḥ ete'pi daivatāḥ proktāḥ kalaśeṣūdake nyaset catuścatvāri kalaśān caturthāvaraṇe nyaset dāntadūrvā ca takkolaṃ puṃnāgaṃ jāti pāṭalī vyāghranakhīśatāverī maṃjiṣṭhā nāgakesaram bhītā ca sahadevī ca viṣṇukrāntiḥ suvarcalā balabhadrī mahābhadrī apāmārgendu vallikā caturthāvaraṇe caiva vinyased deśikottamaḥ

kālarudraśca vikhyāto dharmādharmapatistathā hantā ca krūradṛṣṭiśca ūrdhvaśepho mahābhujaḥ atiścalaḥ pāśahasto mahābala eva ca vibhīṣaṇo mahāvego laghuvegastathaiva ca kapardī meghavāhaśca jaṭāmakuṭadhārakaḥ dhanuścaiva tu viprendra ! kalaśeṣūdake nyaset itareṣāṃ tu devānāṃ śivābhimukhameva ca prathamāvaraṇe cāṣṭau dvitīye dvādaśa nyaset devatānāṃ ca viprendra ! catvāriṃśadghaṭān nyaset tato homaṃ prakartavyaṃ caturdikṣu palāśakaiḥ sadyādīśānaparyantaṃ kramād hutvā śivavrataiḥ prāsādena tu mantreṇa paṃcāśaddhūyate kramāt hutvānte tu yadasyeti juhuyāt tadanantare ācāryadakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt padārthīn pūjayet tataḥ paścāt paṃcāsanaṃ kalpya sṛṣṭinyāsaṃ prakalpayet vardhanīṃ tasya vāme tu snāpayed gauri mantrataḥ paṃcabrahma ṣaḍaṃgena snāpayet kalaśaṃ tataḥ caturthaṃ paṃcamaṃ snātvā evamevaṃ krameṇa tu evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokamavāpnuyāt iti vīratantre aṣṭottaraśata snapanavidhiḥ aśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥ ekāśītiḥ kathaṃ deva ! tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho ! tatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva caturānana ! pūrvokte naiva mārgeṇa kārayed deśikottamaḥ śuddhodakena saṃpūrya śarāveṇa vidhāyate śālyardhaṃ taṇḍulaṃ nyasya taṇḍulārdhaṃ tilaṃ nyaset

prāsādena tu mantreṇa gaurībījena vardhanīm vinyaseccaiva viprendra ! abhitaḥ kalaśairyutam adhamaṃ tvaṣṭahastaṃ syān madhyamaṃ navahastakam purāṇaṃ putranāśaḥ syāt keśayuktaṃ dhanakṣayaḥ pūrve tu nava kumbhaṃ tu āgneyyāṃ navakumbhakam vāruṇyāṃ navakaṃ vidvān vāyavyāṃ navakaṃ nyaset sa vastrān sāpidhānāṃśca sakūrcān vāripūritān lohaṃ priyaṃgupuṣpaṃ ca lavaṃgaṃ phalamallikā parṇakā śatapatraṃ ca tailaṃ kastūri rocanā rajanī bhadrakoṣṭhaṃ ca saralaṃ kṛṣṇamālikā siṃhī ca śaṃkhapuṣpī ca lakṣmī sthalāravindakam rudraparṇī mahālakṣmīrdhūrdhūreṇa samanvitam nadyāstīre ca goṣṭhe ca balmīke vṛṣaśṛṃgake vidyeśakuṃbhe nikṣipya paṃcagavyena saṃyutam vāruṇyāṃ navake caiva * * saṃ vinyaset kramāt saumyāyāṃ viṣṇumāvāhya * * caṇḍīśagocare samidājya carūnlājānsarṣapena samanvitam vyomavyāpiṃ japitvā tu ājyena paṃcaviṃśatiḥ snāpayecchivakumbhaṃ tu vyomavyāpiṃ samuccaran paṃcabrahmaṣaḍaṃgena snāpayet kalaśān budhaḥ ācārya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt padārthīn pūjayet tataḥ ekāśītiriti proktā ekonapaṃcāśat śṛṇu iti vīratantre ekāśītisnapanavidhiḥ ekāśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥ ekona paṃcāśatkovā tat sarvaṃ brūhi me prabho ! prāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryānmaṇṭapaṃ caturaśrakam

darbhamālābhirāveṣṭya vitāno parisobhitam gomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā sūtrapātaṃ tu kārayet madhye navapadaṃ sthitvā tadbāhyekaṃ tu vīthikā śālinā sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā pūrvoktena vidhānataḥ madhyame'ṣṭa padaṃ kṛtvā gandhapuṣpādinārcayet vastradvaya samāyuktaṃ sa kūrcaṃ sāpidhānakam kalaśān vinyaset tatra savastraṃ sāpidhānakam candanaṃ kuṃkumaṃ caiva meva māṃjī muraṃgulam śatapuṣpaṃ tathā vyāghrī dhātrī pūrvā harītakī haṃsapuṣpā gandhapuṣpā mahādroṇī samanvitam ajaḥ kapālīṃ buddhiśca vajradehaḥ pramardanaḥ agnīrudro hutāśī ca piṃgalaḥ pādako hariḥ yāmyo mṛtyuharo dhātā (vidhātā) karṇakārikā saṃyoktā ca viyoktā ca niyoktā ca prakīrtitaḥ kālarudraśca vikhyāto dhātā dharmapatistathā virūpākṣo dhūmravarṇo lohito daṃṣṭra vā budhaḥ bhūtapālo lokapālaḥ kṣetrapālastathaiva ca etepi daivatāḥ proktāḥ kalaśeṣūdake nyaset aiśānyāmeka homaṃ vā palāśasamidhā saha śālinī vāragodhūma mudge naiva samanvitam hutvānte tu yadasyeti pūrṇāhutimathācaret gaurībījena vardhanyāṃ snāpayecchivakumbhakam paṃcabrahmaṣaḍaṃgena snāpayet sarvakumbhakam evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivaloke mahīyate iti vīratantre ekonapaṃcāśat snapanavidhiḥ dvayaśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥ

snapanaṃ paṃcaviṃśacca brūhi me parameśvara ! prāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryānmaṇṭapaṃ caturaśrakam vitānopari saṃchannaṃ digdhvajaiśca pralambitam gomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā sūtrapātaṃ tu kārayet madhye navapadaṃ sthitvā tadbāhyeka padaṃ tyajet āḍhakaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā prasthaṃ vā śāli vinyaset taṇḍulārdhaṃ tilaṃ nyasya darbhāṃścaiva paristaret paṃcaratna samāyuktaṃ sa kūrcaṃ sāpidhānakam pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ aṣṭakumbhāṃśca vinyaset paṃcagavya samāyuktaṃ savastraṃ sāpidhānakam āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu catvāraḥ kumbha ucyate elālavaṃga takkolaṃ timbujātiphalaṃgulam dāntā dūrvā ca takkolaṃ puṃnāgaṃ jātipāṭalī yathā krameṇa vinyasya pūrvādīśānamantakam vibhūtiravyayaḥ śāstā pinākī tridaśādhipaḥ jvalano dahano babhruḥ bhasmāntakaḥ kṣayāntakaḥ kālarudraśca viprendra ! kalaśasyādhidevatāḥ tato homaṃ prakartavyaṃ pālāśasamidhā saha samidājyacarūnlājān sarṣapāṃśca yavāṃstilān paṃcabrahma ṣaḍaṃgena yathā krameṇa hūyate ācārya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād vastrahemāṃgulīyakaiḥ gaurībījena vardhanyāṃ snāpayet tu viśeṣataḥ paṃcavarṇa havirdadyāt tāmbūlaṃ dāpayet tataḥ paṃcaviṃśatirevoktā ṣoḍaśaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṇu iti vīratantre paṃcaviṃśati snapanavidhiḥ tryaśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥ

kalaśān ṣoḍaśān kiṃ vā brūhi me parameśvara prāsāda syāgrataḥ kuryānmaṇṭapaṃ caturaśrakam vitāne nordhvamācchādya digdhajaiśca pralambitam sarvālaṃkāra saṃyuktaṃ sūtrapātaṃ tu kārayet madhye navapadaṃ sthitvā tasyāvṛta padaṃ tyajet śālinā vikiret tatra pūrvoktavidhinā saha paristarecca darbhaiśca gandhapuṣpādinārcayet gaurī bījena vardhanyāṃ sthāpayed deśikottamaḥ āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu caturaḥ kalaśān nyaset vastrayugmena saṃveṣṭya viṇikābhiralaṃkṛtam gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ caiva kṣīraṃ dadhighṛtaṃ tathā sadyādīśānaparyantaṃ yathā krameṇa vinyaset snāpayecchivakumbhaṃ tu vyomavyāpi samuccaran paṃcabrahmaṣaḍaṃgena sthāpayet kalaśāṃstataḥ ācāryadakṣiṇāṃ dadyād vastrahemāṃgulīyakaiḥ iti vīratantre ṣoḍaśasnapanavidhiḥ caturaśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥ navakumbhāḥ kathaṃ deva ! brūhi me parameśvara ! prāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryānmaṇṭapaṃ caturaśrakam vitānoparisaṃchannaṃ digdhvajaiśca pralambitam sarvālaṃkāra saṃyuktaṃ gomayenopalepayet sūtrapātaḥ prakartavyaḥ ṣaṭsūtraṃ prākśiro bhavet śālinā vikiret tatra āḍhakaṃ kalaśaṃ prati paristaret tu darbhaiśca padmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhet savastraṃ paṃcaratnaṃ ca sakūrcaṃ sāpidhānakam savastrānsahiraṇyāṃśca gandhodakena pūritān

pūrve gomūtrakaṃ caiva gomayaṃ cāgnideśake ājyaṃ cottarataḥ sthāpya nair-ṛte ca kuśāmbujam pūrvādīśāna paryantaṃ aṣṭavidyeśvarān nyaset tato homaṃ prakurvīta palāśasamidhā saha saptadravyeṇa saṃyuktaṃ paṃcabrahmasamāyutam hutvānte tu yadasyeti sviṣṭakṛddhūyate kramāt ācārya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād vastrahemāṃgulīyakaiḥ gaurībījena vardhanyāmanantādi svamantrakaiḥ adhamasyādhamaṃ proktaṃ śītakumbhaṃ tataḥ śṛṇu iti vīratantre navakumbha snapanavidhiḥ paṃcāśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥ etat sarvaṃ samāsena bhagavanvaktumarhasi jvaramārī vināśāya sarvāriṣṭavināśanam triṃśat tanmadhyamaṃ proktaṃ aṣṭāviṃśati cādhamam bimbaprabhānvabhāyuktaṃ bhinnaṃ kālaṃ ca varjayet kṣālayed dhṛdaye naiva darbhairupari vinyaset śālyardhataṇḍulān nyasya taṇḍulārdha tilān nyaset vastrapūtena toyena pūrayedghaṭameva ca uśīraṃ candanaṃ caiva kumbhamadhye hṛdā nyaset vajraṃ ca padmarāgaṃ ca vaiḍūryaṃ mauktikaṃ tathā sakūrcaṃ sāpidhānaṃ ca puṣpamālā samanvitam paṃcabrahmaṣaḍaṃgena arcayed gandhapuṣpakaiḥ pūrvarātre'dhivāsyātha nṛttageya samanvitam evameva nyaset kuṃbhaṃ śivastatrādhidevatā kumbhasya saṃnidhau vipra ! śānti homaṃ tu kārayet evameva prakāreṇa upakumbhaṃ ca vinyaset

mantranyāsoktamārgeṇa sṛṣṭinyāsaṃ tu kārayet liṃgasyopari viprendra ! hastamātroccamucyate abakraṃ nirvraṇaṃ kṛtvā viṣṭharatrayasaṃyutam dvau pārśvau pṛṣṭhataścaiva vinyaset tu tripādikān nālaṃ tatraiva vinyasya caturaṃguladairghyakam vyomavyāpiṃ samuccārya kumbhamāropayet tataḥ aho rātraṃ sravan mūrdhni sarvadoṣanikṛntanam sandhyāyāṃ pūjayet paścāt pūrvoktavidhinā saha dinānte'pi ca viprendra ! kumbhāvarohaṇaṃ kuru ācārya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād vastrahemāṃgulīyakaiḥ śaivān saṃbhojayet tatra samayān bhojayet tataḥ śītakumbhavidhiḥ prokta adbhutānāṃ vidhiṃ śṛṇu iti vīratantre śītakumbhavidhiḥ ṣaḍaśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥ adbhutānāṃ vidhiḥ ko vā tat sarvaṃ brūhi me prabho bhūmikampe diśādāhe dhūmaketānupasthite anāvṛṣṭyādikāle tu grahaśāntiṃ samācaret śālinā sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā taṇḍulān vinyaset tataḥ sthāpayeccaiva viprendra ! trayaṃ caiva tu madhyame trayāṇāṃ madhyame caiva grahāṇāṃ caiva vinyaset candramāgneya digbhāge aṃgārakaṃ tu dakṣiṇe ketuṃ ca vāyudigbhāge uttare tu bṛhaspatim bhāskarasyeśvaro devaḥ pūrvābhimukha eva ca rāhoḥ kāliṃga devastu yamodevaśśanestathā budhaśca viṣṇudaivatya ityetā grahadevatāḥ indrāṇī ca prajāpatyaḥ sarpā brahmādhidevatāḥ

teṣāṃ pūrve tu viprendra ! sikataiḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ kuru ādityasya ca vṛttaṃ syāśukrasya paṃcakoṇakam rāhoḥ śūrpākṛtiścaiva dhanuścaiva śanaiścare bṛhaspatestu vijñeyaṃ budhasya bhagavān bhavet tattadvarṇāni puṣpāṇi pūjayed deśikottamaḥ aṃgārakasya khadiraṃ apāmārgaṃ budhasya ca śamīṃ śanaiścare vidyād rāhoḥ dūrvāhutirbhavet aṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi aṣṭāviṃśatireva vā evaṃ lakṣaṇa saṃyuktaṃ homayecchivadīkṣitaḥ eṣāmīśeti mantreṇa ādityasyaiva hūyate śukrahomamiti proktaṃ āpyāyassomamabravīt agnirmūrdhā ca sometā aṃgārakasya hūyate śanno devī prajāpate śanihomaṃ prakīrtitam ādiyasyo bṛhatsāmajñānamācāryaṃ homamucyate paṃcabrahmaṣaḍaṃgena prāsādena samanvitam kṣīrasnānaṃ prakartavyaṃ śrīrudreṇa viśeṣataḥ ativṛṣṭirbhavet tatra subhikṣaṃ kurute tataḥ mahāmārī pravṛtte tu snapanaṃ tu sahasrakam raktakanyā samutpanne śṛṇu tatvaṃ pitāmaha rājñāṃ grāmaṃ kṣetraṃ vā vināśaṃ vrajati dhruvam vāhanānāṃ kṣayo yāmye bhāryānāśastu nair-ṛte jvarāpasmāraṃ vāyavyāṃ saumye vyādhimavāpnuyāt nirmālyakuṇḍe dṛśyeta rājarāṣṭravināśanam dhānyaśālāya nāśaḥ syādvāre dveśmagṛnyakam brāhmaṇakṣatriyāṇāṃ ca antarmaṇḍalake bhavet

madhyahāre'pi dṛśyante śūdrāṇāṃ kṣayamāpnuyāt agnijādikṣayaṃ caiva mahāmaryādibhittike evameva prakāreṇa adbhutaṃ dṛśyate bhayam vyapohya sakalaṃ tatra paṃcagavyena prokṣayet ghanaṃ kṛtvā tu taddeśe śāntihomaṃ tadūrdhvataḥ pūrvavadvidhinā yuktaṃ homaṃ kuryāt tu deśikaḥ evaṃ kṛtvā mahāśāntiṃ sarvadoṣaharāya ca vyapohya sakalaṃ tatra diśāhomaṃ tu kārayet snāpayed devadeveśaṃ mahāhavirnivedayet puṇyāhaṃ kārayet tatra pavamānena prokṣayet anyevācādbhutotpanne snapanaṃ kārayet tataḥ adbhutānāṃ vidhiḥ proktaḥ kṛttikādīpa ucyate iti vīratantre adbhutaśāntividhiḥ saptāśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥ ko vā tu kṛttikādīpaḥ tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho ! kārtike tu tathā māse nakṣatre kṛttikāyute kṛttikādīpahīne tu jvaramārī pravartate navavastreṇa kṛtvā tu vartiṃ kārpāsa saṃyutam śiva prapūrite pātre vinyased dhṛdayena tu prāsādamūrdhni vinyasya hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ jātī vā campakaṃ vāpi kramukaṃ vaiṇavaṃ tu vā prāsādasadṛśaṃ vāpi galāntaṃ vāpi kārayet etaddīpena saṃyojya paṃcāśatpaṃcaviṃśatiḥ vastreṇa veṣṭayet tatra ghṛtena ca pariplutam dīpaṃ saṃyojya viprendra ! sadyojātena mantrataḥ vimāna pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryādgarbhagehaṃ praveśayet

ācārya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād vastrahemāṃgulīyakaiḥ dīpadaṇḍaṃ tu viprendra ! viṣṇudīpena yojayet prāsādena tu mantreṇa dīpān sarvatra yojayet nānādīpa samāyuktaṃ rātrau mahotsavaṃ kuru anādiveśyā saṃyuktaṃ gaṇikādāsibhissaha evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokamavāpnuyāt kṛttikādīpa evoktaḥ agrāśanamataḥ śṛṇu iti vīratantre kṛttikādīpavidhiḥ aṣṭāśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥ agrāśanaṃ kathaṃ deva ! tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho ! śubhe muhūrte maṃgalye bhūmi saṃgrahaṇaṃ bhavet caitre cāryāpabharaṇī kuryāt bhūmipraveśanam dvitīyā daśamī grāhyā vṛṣavṛścika karkaṭāḥ bhūmipraveśanaṃ proktaṃ kṛṣikarma tvathocyate mūlā punarvasuścaiva rohiṇī cottaratrayam navamīṃ caiva viprendra ! varjayet kṛṣi karmasu vṛṣabhe karkaṭe mīne mithune siṃhalagnake śvetau raktau ca kapilau nāgacchinnau vṛṣau tathā gocarmarajjunā caiva halaṃ caiva tu bandhayet prāgukta vasayedbhūmiṃ sadyojātena mantrataḥ mūlānurādhā hastā ca maghārauhiṇi revatī śatabhiṣak ca nakṣatraṃ praśastaṃ bījakarmasu ekādaśī tṛtīyā ca praśastā bījakarmaṇi yamakumbha tulā madhyāḥ śeṣāṃstu parivarjayet evameva prakāreṇa bījāvāpanamucyate bhūmi praveśanaṃ kṛtvā pūrvābhimukhamāsthitaḥ

mṛdena bhūmirūpaṃ tu prākśiraḥ kārayed budhaḥ puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tatra tāmbūlaṃ dāpayejjanān bindunāda samāyuktaṃ mūlamantramihocyate naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ dadyāllājāpūpa samanvitam aṃjaliṃ śālicūrṇaṃ tu mūlamantra samanvitam namo'stu subhage ! nityaṃ kṛṣikarmedhyatāmiha ācāryaṃ pūjayet paścād daivajñaṃ pūjayet tataḥ tato bhaktajanaissārdhaṃ praviśedālayaṃ prati caṇḍeśa pratimāyuktaṃ sarvātodya samanvitam hastatrayottarāyāṃ ca rohiṇyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ śukaṃ grāhyāstramantreṇa śirasā dhārayet tataḥ raviraśmisusaṃtaptaṃ prabhinnaṃ kṣipalūkhale hastaṃ ca śravaṇaṃ caiva revatyaśvatireva ca śraviṣṭhā śatabhiṣak caiva anūrādhā triruttarā meṣavṛścikamīnāstu varjyāḥ śeṣāstu pūjitāḥ taṇḍulaṃ śarkarāyuktaṃ nālikeraphalairyutam pratimānāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ evamevākṣamaṃ dadet evaṃ nivedayet paścāt tāmbūlaṃ dāpayet tataḥ agrāśanamidaṃ proktaṃ bālasthāpanamataḥ śṛṇu iti vīratantre agrāśanavidhirekonanavatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ bālasthānaṃ kathaṃ deva ! tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho ! dvāramānena vā ku * bhittimānena vā punaḥ śailajaṃ dārujaṃ vāpi bālaliṃgaṃ karoti hi pūjāṃśoccaṃ nava kuryādviṣva? māgānvitaṃ tu ? tritālaṃ madhyamoktaṃ adhamaṃ tu dvitāla * * ?

tena mānena kartavyaṃ liṃgasya bhāgamuttamam adhamo brahmabhāgaḥ syān madhyamo * ṇu? ucyate liṃgasūtraṃ tu kartavyaṃ nālaṃ caiva tu kalpa * ? bālaliṃgaṃ prakartavyaṃ evameva krameṇa tu vāruṇe vāpi kartavyaṃ bālasthānamihocyate trihastaṃ paṃcahastaṃ vā saptahastamathāpi vā bālasthānasya vāme tu prapālitvā * * * *? vṛttaṃ vā caturarthaṃ vā a * *?ni * * * *? sthā *?lopari vinyasya śivakumbhaṃ ca vardhanīm āvāhya devadeveśaṃ gandhapuṣpādinārcayet pūrvavat sthaṇḍile vipra ! atrāhyeva? tu kārayet
